system.description: Produces one duplicate of the caster per 5 Aura points cast into the spell. An Illusion Resistance will not cause the duplicate(s) to vanish as the caster projects actual light to create each duplicate. The caster may move each duplicate independently, as long as it remains within sight. Any duplicate that is physically struck vanishes. Duplicates appear in the current form of the caster. The caster can cast a spell through anyone of the duplicates. The caster must concentrate to specifically move the duplicates, and cannot cast spells while this is occurring. The other duplicates can only walk and move enough to make it appear as if they are casting.
Allows the being affected to be immune to the effects of all forms of fire and heat, magical or otherwise. Protects all materials carried within 6“ of the affected being.

Causes one being to have enhanced speed. For every 4 Aura points cast in the spell the affected being gains 1 second of event time per 10 second combat round. At 20 Aura this jumps to a full 10 extra seconds of action per round. In addition, the affected being will be -1 to be hit by other beings per 4 Aura cast into this spell. This spell in no way effects the speed it takes to cast a spell or activate a magical item.

Creates a bolt of lightning, emanating from the caster's finger. The Finger of Electricity strikes the body area desired if an Intelligence save is made. The Finger of Electricity does 1d8 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. Beings and objects which are immune to electricty are unaffected by this spell. The spell Endure Electricity is one such example. Leather armor reduces damage taken on a point per point basis, so 5 points of leather will stop 5 points of ice damage. Metal armor causes +1 damage per dice rolled. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor.

Allows the caster to create any illusions of touch in the area affected. The caster must concentrate to produce the illusion, and may cast no other non-illusion spells while concentrating. Illusions involving feelings may cause damage but may never kill directly.

Causes the being affected to be rendered invisible. This spell is not technically an illusion as it causes light waves to bend around the affected being's body, making it appear as if they were not there. This functions on Infravision and other forms of sight. Each time the affected being makes an offensive action or attacks, there is a 10% chance of appearing. This effect is cumulative; thus, the third such action would have a 30% chance of dispelling the Invisibility. Detect Invisibility and Divine Sight will see through the effects of this spell, and Dispel Invisibility or Dispel Magic will dispel it.

Summons a being of will that will attempt to destroy the mind of one opponent. The caster releases the monster in the direction of the chosen victim and points at the target and the monster appears in the victim's mind. Mental combat ensues. The Mind Monster is given 1 Will Force point plus 1 per point of Aura used. The Mind Monster can use any mental combat attack, with the purpose of destroying the victim's mind. If the Mind Monster wins, the victim's mind is destroyed. If the victim wins the mental combat, the Mind Monster turns and mentally attacks the caster with its Will Force renewed, and attacks with the purpose of destroying the caster's mind. Beings that have Mind Set or Mind Change, Thought Projection or who are immune to mental control will be unaffected by this spell.

Protects one being from all forms of mental attack or control by skill, power or spell. The protected creature is unable to be scryed upon or have their mind read through Telepathy, Improved Telepathy or Thought Projection. Likewise, the affected being may not initiate mental combat while Mind Set is active. The protected being is immune to any and all forms of mental control. A Dispel Protection or Dispel Magic will remove this spell.

Each Mirror Wall created is 10' x 10' x 3“ and has the following properties: Indestructible (save Dispel Magic or Disintegrate) and causes all spells cast at the wall to bounce back, and has the same effect with missile weapons (same as Reflection). Beings may Phase or Teleport through the Mirror Wall.

Causes one being, object, or area to be immune to all forms of detection, whether by spell, power or skill. It also makes the affected beings, items or area immune to be located or scryed upon. This will cover an area no more than 10 cubic feet per Aura point. A Dispel Magic or Dispel Protection may remove this spell.

Causes one thrusting weapon to do more damage, and have a greater chance to hit. For each 5 Aura points put into the spell, the piercing weapon will be +1 to hit and +1 to damage, and will grant an additional 1d6 to damage as well. In addition, the weapon will do double damage on a natural roll of 21 minus 1 per 5 Aura points cast into the spell. So, at 15 Aura, the weapon would be +3 to hit, do an additional 3d6+3 damage, and do double total damage on an unmodified roll of 18 or higher. Weapons that are already magical are subject to the magical cumulative effects.

Produces a magical shelter the caster envisions. The type of shelter possible is based on the amount of Aura used at the time of casting. AURA 5: 1 room shack (wood and thatch). AURA 6-9: 1 room cottage (wood and thatch). AURA 10-14: 3 room house (stone and wood). AURA 15-16: 5 room house/tower (stone or wood). AURA 17-18: 6 room house/tower (stone or wood). AURA 19-20+: 10 room house/tower (metal, stone, or wood). The maximum area affected is 100' x 100' per 5 Aura put into the spell. The shelter will only appear if there is sufficient space for it.

Protects 1 being per 4 Aura from any and all attacks from summoned servants or any other being not from the caster's plane of origin. Supernatural beings with a 16 or higher Intelligence rating will sense the caster but must make a Control Resistance to attack them (for each attack), whereas those with a lower Intelligence rating won't even sense the practitioner.

Causes all missile weapons and missile spells that are targeted at the spellcaster to be reflected back to the point of origin. The missile or spell will hit a random location. If Reflection is cast at a caster who is protected by Reflection, see the section at the beginning of this chapter to determine the results. This will reflect back any number of spells and missiles at any time and takes no concentration on the part of the caster once cast. Missile spells are considered to be spells which contain “displacement” as one of their types and are cast at the spellcaster, not onto the spellcaster.

Causes one cutting weapon to do more damage, and have a greater chance to hit. For each 5 Aura points put into the spell, the cutting weapon will be +1 to hit and +1 to damage, and will grant an additional 1d6 to damage as well. In addition, the weapon will do double damage on a natural roll of 21 minus 1 per 5 Aura points cast into the spell. So, at 15 Aura, the weapon would be +3 to hit, do an additional 3d6+3 damage, and do double total damage on an unmodified roll of 18 or higher. Weapons that are already magical are subject to the magical cumulative effects.

Creates a whirlwind of fire and heat which has a fixed height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects:  1) Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d6 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to all exposed areas. (All body areas protected by less than five points of armor are considered exposed). Beings in metal armor take 2 points of damage per 10 seconds to the upper, mid and lower torso due to heat exhaustion. 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be blinded. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Fire always miss their target. 6) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Grants the being the ability of Telekinesis and allows the caster to move an object(s) at 30' per second, if the object(s) weighs less than 50 pounds per Aura point of the spell. An Object can be thrown with the same weight requirement as the spell Throw. The caster can also move themselves by pushing away from the ground but may move no faster than 30' per second and go no higher than 10' per Aura point per move. The caster can do these feats as many times as desired as long as the spell is going. Moving objects requires concentration. Setting an object in motion in a particular direction or causing an object to float without movement requires no extra concentration once begun. Beings and magical items that wish to avoid being moved via Telekinesis are allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid these effects.

Causes a being that has been transformed to another substance to return to original form, or an object no bigger than 5 cubic feet per Aura point to turn to flesh. The spell does not heal any chips, shavings or breakage caused while the being was in the other form, and appropriate damage applies. If the being is returned to original form, then duration is disregarded, and the effect acts like a dispel.

Each fire wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The fire walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall must touch another or an existing surface. Touching the wall with exposed flesh does 1d6 per 2 Aura points to 2d4 random areas. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If the roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. The wall will catch combustable materials on fire. The wall itself will be impossible to extinguish for the entire spell duration, and can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic. If the wall cannot fit into the desired casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then that particular section of the wall will fail.

Each stone wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The stone walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but all the walls must touch another wall or be fixed onto a solid surface. As with all wall spells, any living being that is in the way of a the wall will cause that section to fail. The wall has an object threshold of 100 and an object strength of 200.

Causes objects that weigh less than 20 pounds per Aura point (individually) to become animated. These include weapons, armor and other non-magical, non-organic objects. Weapons will do their normal damage and attack using an unmodified weapon speed. Armor will take damage just as if it was protecting a being. Non-weapon blunt objects used to strike with will inflict 1d4 damage per 20 pounds of weight and swing only once per round. There is a 5% (fumble) chance per 10 second period that one of the objects will accidentally inflict harm on the caster, if they are within 10' of the caster. Intelligent magic items are granted the ability to move under their own power at the rate of 5' per Intelligence point, and are only required to move if they fail a Magic Resistance. This spell must be concentrated on to function initially (first attack) but then weapons will mimic attack motions of the caster, acting a secondary attack, and armor will block attacks to the area covered by the initial attack.

Causes all affected beings to wander confused and disoriented for the duration of the spell, or until attacked or disturbed in some way. Does not work against beings that are immune to control, have Mind Set, Mind Change, or Thought Projection.

The caster can change the temperature up or down a maximum of 5° difference per Aura point used in casting the spell. It takes 10 seconds per 10° change. When the spell's duration expires, the temperature will return to normal at the same rate.

Allows the caster to see the nature and Aura of all protection type spells, effects or invocations within the caster's sight. If the caster views something protected by Non-Detection, they will see only that the object/being has Non-Detection upon it, but nothing else. The Non-Detection must first be dispelled before any other protections can be sensed.

Creates a metaphysical field that will sense and attempt to dispel all invisibility spells within a 5 foot per Aura point sphere around the caster. The chance for anyone Invisibility spell to be dispelled is determined through a contest of magics, where the amount of Aura put into the Invisibility spell is compared to the amount of Aura put into Dispel Invisibility. Each amount is multiplied by 5%, and percentage dice are rolled for each. The roll which succeeds by the most wins. If the Dispel Invisibility roll wins, the invisibility spell is dispelled, otherwise the Dispel Invisibility fails. Permanent spells and effects have a -75% chance to be dispelled. Non-detection will prevent this from affecting the Invisibility spells unless it is dispelled first.

Extends the duration of one previous spell one times its duration per Aura point. For example, a spell with a duration of one hour will be extended one hour for each Aura point of the extend spell. A spell must have a non-permanent and non-instantaneous duration to be affected by this spell. Extend cannot be cast upon an Extend spell. May only be used three times on the same spell; after the third use, the Aura is too unstable to be extended without Will Force (see Permanency).

Allows the caster to change the appearance and strength of one being's Aura. The caster may alter one being's Aura to appear any shade and strength the caster desires. Dispel Illusion or Dispel Magic is required to remove this effect. A simple Illusion Resistance will not see through the Mask Aura.

Causes one being per 4 Aura points to make a Control Resistance or fall to the ground paralyzed for the duration of the spell. Autonomous functions will still work, such as breathing, digestion, etc. This spell only works against humanoid beings, and has no effect against undead and supernatural beings.

Rejoins and repairs any broken object. All missing parts will be re-formed as long as they are within the size of the area affected and the object has not lost more than half of its original composition. Unlike the spell Mend, the object has been truly repaired, and does not need magic to hold it together.

Use a reflective surface, clear still pool, mirror, crystal ball, etc to see the image of a person, place or item named aloud by the caster. The image will show the exact condition of the person, place or item and its general surroundings. If the scryed upon person, place, or thing is moving, the image will show the movement. The maximum distance equals 25 miles per Aura point. However, if the spell is cast at higher than 15 Aura, there is no limit to the distance. If the spell is cast at 20 Aura, it will have a 3% chance per Will Force point of the caster in extending the scrying ability into other dimensions. If that which is scryed upon is protected by any of the following, they will not be able to be detected: Non-Detection, Sphere of Protection (Wall of Protection if between scryer & scryee), Mind Set, Mind Change, Invisibility or the skill Thought Projection. (Beings with Thought Projection, Improved Telepathy, Life Sense or Sense Projection or the like are given an Intelligence save to feel the scrying). Beings who peer into the scrying image will see nothing, unless the caster wants them to or can make an Illusion Resistance, in which case they will see a dimmer view of what the caster sees.

Allows the caster to temporarily reduce personal attributes of the target. For every 6 Aura put into the spell, all personal attributes (except Social Class) are reduced temporarily by one point. If the caster designates one attribute (Appearance or Charm) to be affected, then that attribute is reduced 1 point per 4 Aura put into this spell. The effects of this spell are cumulative with multiple castings.

Causes arrows of Aura to shoot from the caster's hand. One arrow is created for every 2 Aura points used in the spell, and each new arrow will be created 2 seconds after the last one setting the casting time of 2 seconds per arrow. Each arrow must be rolled to hit against the opponent as a missile weapon. Each arrow does 1d6+1 and will pass through all forms of armor or protection, with no save at all except for magical armor (determined by a Magic Resistance). These missiles can be dodged with the skill Dodge. The caster must concentrate until all the arrow have been thrown.

The recipient of the True Flight spell can fly in any direction at 3' per Intelligence point per second. The being does not need to maintain concentration while flying, but still must make Intelligence saves to successfully change directions or make any difficult moves. Thus, fighting can be accomplished if the being makes Intelligence saves for swinging, etc. If the being crashes into something, they will take damage (as falling). Unlike Levitate, the being is not weightless, and will take normal damage from a fall or crash.
Allows the caster to target one completely phased being or object and force it (or them) to return to the earthly plane (assuming that it (or they) phased from the earthly plane).

Each metal wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The metal walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but all the walls must touch another wall or be fixed onto a solid surface. As with all wall spells, any living being that is in the way of a the wall will cause that section to fail. The wall has an object threshold of 200 and an object strength of 400.

Each protection wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and has no measureable thickness. The protection walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but all the walls must touch another wall or be fixed onto a solid surface. As with all wall spells, any living being that is in the way of a the wall will cause that section to fail. Magical items, powers, skills, and all spells that pass through the barrier in either direction are automatically negated as the magic is absorbed. The magic will return if the being, or item is passed back through the wall again in the opposite direction, or if the duration of the wall ends, or the wall is destroyed. The wall is immune to physical damage and can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic or Dispel Protection.

Allows the caster to conceal the overall Aura of a being, object or place, and its powers and abilities. The area affected can be no bigger than 10 cubic feet per 2 Aura. This can completely erase the sense of magic that comes from the affected focus, or change it such that it would feel completely different to skills and effects like Detect Magic, Detect Aura, Identify, Empower, etc. Beings could be made to appear very magical or not at all. Unlike Non-Detection, the being, object or area could still be detected or scryed upon with other means than Detect Magic. Detect Aura, etc. Non-magical items or beings can also be enhanced by this glamour to appear to be magical. Dispel Protection or Dispel Illusion will remove this glamour.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one Fire Elemental if it fails its Control Resistance. If the Fire Elemental is already controlled by another caster who used this spell at a higher Aura, then the new control spell fails automatically. If the amount of Aura for both spells are equivalent, then the spell works for the new caster and the previous caster loses control of the Fire Elemental. Unlike some forms of control, this spell is absolute. The Elemental is controlled completely and may even be sent to its death without benefit of a second Control Resistance.

Causes all illusions in the area affected which lose a contest of magics to be nullified. The chance for the each illusion to be dispelled is determined through a contest of magics, where the amount of Aura put into the illusion spell(s) is compared to the amount of Aura put into Dispel Illusion. Each amount is multiplied by 5%, and percentage dice are rolled for each. The roll which succeeds by the most wins. If the Dispel Illusion roll wins, the illusion spell is dispelled, otherwise the Dispel Illusion fails.

Causes the caster to transform into a Water Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Water Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.
Allows the being affected to be immune to the effects of all forms of electricity, magical or otherwise. Protects all materials carried within 6“ of the affected being.

Causes up to 2 beings per Aura within sight of the caster to become transfixed by the caster for 1 minute per Aura point, provided they fail a Control Resistance. All victims who fail their save must stare at the target or caster for the duration, having no other action. They do however, get a new Control Resistance each 10 seconds. If line of sight contact is broken, the affected beings are freed from Entrancement, but the released creature must make another Control Resistance if they look at the caster again or be entranced anew. This spell requires concentration. If the caster's concentration is broken, then the spell will fail to affect all of its victims immediately. Beings that are immune to control are unaffected by this spell.

Allows the caster to temporarily reduce mental attributes of the focus. For every 7 Aura put into the spell, all mental attributes are reduced temporarily by one point. If the caster designates a single attribute (Intelligence, Wisdom or Knowledge) to be lowered, then that attribute is reduced one point per 5 Aura put into this spell. Attributes return at a rate of one point per hour. The effects of this spell are cumulative with multiple castings.

system.description: Creates a narrow black bolt of immense power that shoots from the fingertips of the caster, consequently aging the the being struck if their Magic Resistance fails. PLANT(SMALL): instant death. PLANT(MED.): 1/2 END. PLANT(LARGER/INTELLIGENT): 1d4 END/2 AUR. ANIMAL(SMALL): instant death. ANIMAL(AVERAGE): 1d4 END/2 AUR. ANIMAL(INTELLIGENT): Age 1d6 years/4 AUR. ELF: Age 10-60 years/4 AUR. DWARF: Age 2d6 years/4 AUR. AVIAN: Age 1d10 years/4 AUR. MIDFOLK: Age 1d8 years/4 AUR. HUMAN: Age 1d6 years/4 AUR. GOBLIN/WILDONE: Age 1d4 years/4 AUR. STONE: -1 object strength/AUR. METAL: -1d4 object strength/4 AUR. WOOD: -1d6 object strength/4 AUR. LEATHER: -1d10 object strength/4 AUR. In the case of armor, the points are removed from the armor value.

Makes a relatively smooth surface completely frictionless, but only up to 10 square feet per Aura. Objects and beings in motion will not be slowed by passage against or upon it. All beings on the surface will have extreme difficulty remaining upright. Even the slightest motion can cause them to slide in one direction or another. Subtle motions require a -30% Agility save or the unfortunate being falls prone. Standing up from a prone position requires a -50% Agility save. Even if the being doesn't fall over, they will slide in the direction of movement at a constant velocity. With other spells such as Propel, Repulsion, Control Gravity, etc. Frictionless can create a perpetual-like motion. The uses of perpetual motion machines are limited only by the movement and duration of the spells involved. If this spell is cast on a bladed weapon, it causes the blade to become frictionless (not the handle) allowing for a deeper cut and with better general cutting ability. This produces +1 per die of damage for the weapon.

Allows the caster to create sensations of emotions and magical sensing in the area affected, allowing the caster to create the feelings of fear, dread, doom, unease, calm, peace, hatred, love, pain, bliss, life, magic, enemies, etc. The list is endless, but the emotions can be made to be felt within the area affected, or can be made to appear to come from an individual. Thus, one person can be made to feel that hatred is coming from another being, and this may or may not cause strife. Also, this spell can give the illusion of internal pain which, combined with Illusion of Touch and the other illusions, can be devastating. The spell does not force true sensations, but illusions of them from the focus or within the area. Cannot alter magical senses that see through Illusions (Detect Illusion, True Sight, etc.).

Creates a maze composed of individual mirror walls. A number of mirror areas equal to 2 per Aura point, each with a dimension of up to 5' x 30' may be created. Each area may have no more than three of its four walls be mirrors. Each mirror wall has the following properties: 1) Highly reflective, causing characters to see high quality images of themselves and others in the maze. 2) Each mirror reflects all spells and missiles to the point of origin as the spell Reflection. 3) Each panel has an object threshold and object strength of 100. Dispel Magic or Disintegration will cause the wall to shatter. Mirror walls will not appear where there is not room for them, however, they will conform themselves around contours if necessary. The caster must imagine the layout of the maze. There must be a way to get from one end to another or to any portals in the room.

Allows the caster to make a batch of poison created entirely through the process of magic. For every Aura point used in the spell; 3 power points are given to buy the type of poison created. Poisons must have both a type and a potency ranging from type from I to XXV, and potency levels from A through Q. Types I is 1 PP(power point) and +1 more for each level to X. Type XI is 12 PP and +2 more for each type to XXV (at 40 PP). Potency startrs at 1 PP for A, and then is +1 for each higher to J (at 10 PP). Potency K starts at 12 PP, with +2 for each potency higher to Q at 30 PP.

Creates an invisible sphere, surrounding the caster. The outer edge of the sphere stops magic, undead, and all other supernatural beings from passing through it (identical to Wall of Protection). Magical weapons, items, skills, powers and all spells and invocations that pass through the barrier in either direction are automatically absorbed. The magic only returns if the being or object is passed through the sphere in an opposite direction, or if the duration of the sphere ends or the sphere is destroyed. This spell can be moved with the caster as long as movement is at walking speed and the caster continues to concentrate. The sphere will push aside any of the mentioned beings if they are within the area affected when the spell is cast. Magically phased out (or shadow shifted) creatures which pass through the wall will be forced to immediately phase(shift) in.

Creates a field of high intensity electricity that feeds the storm with literally thousands of lightning bolts that dance crazily within a height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects:  1) Make a Magic Resistance (-20% if wearing metal armor) or take 1d8 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to 2d4 exposed areas. (All body areas protected by less than five points of armor are considered exposed). 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be blinded. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Electricity always miss their target. 6) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Summons a Water Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Water Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Causes all creatures caught within the area affected to make a Magic Resistance or be struck deaf for 1 hour per Aura point of the Thunderclap. In addition, there is a 1% chance per Aura point of the spell that the deafness will be permanent, rolled for each being affected. Beings outside the area will hear a loud noise but suffer no ill effects. Those who have Enhanced Hearing via the spell suffer double the aforementioned effects.

Causes one being to make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to stone. All possessions (except magic items) carried by beings who are turned to stone are likewise turned to stone. Chipping away at beings that are stone will cause irreparable damage, and this damage will remain when they are transformed back. Beings turned to stone may be turned back to their true form by Dispel Magic or Transmute to Flesh.

Each electric wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The electric walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall must touch another or an existing surface. Touching the wall with exposed flesh does 1d8 per 2 Aura points to 2d4 random areas. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If the roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. The wall will catch combustable materials on fire. The wall itself can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic. If the wall cannot fit into the desired casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then that particular section of the wall will fail.

Creates a lesser undead skeletal form by infusing the bones of the dead with negative life force. SKELETAL PART: 8 AUR. Bones of hand, leg, skull, etc. ANIMAL SKELETON: 10 AUR. Animal bones. SKELETON: 12 AUR. Humanoid bones. GIANT SKELETON: 14 AUR. Giant humanoid bones. Lesser undead are mindless, and the caster must concentrate on them in order to make them do their bidding. Undead created are not permanent, and must either have Extend or Permanency cast upon them to increase the duration.

Creates a lesser undead form by infusing the dead flesh with negative life force. REANIMATED PART: 8 AUR. Corpse hand, leg, head, etc. ANIMAL ZOMBIE: 10 AUR. Animal corpse. ZOMBIE: 12 AUR. Humanoid corpse. GIANT ZOMBIE: 14 AUR. Giant humanoid corpse. Lesser undead are mindless, and the caster must concentrate on them in order to make them do their bidding. Undead created are not permanent, and must either have Extend or Permanency cast upon them to increase the duration.

Creates a blinding light that will cause all creatures caught in the area affected to make a Magic Resistance or be struck blind for 1 hour per Aura point of the spell. In addition, there is a 1% chance per Aura point of the spell that the blindness will be permanent. All outside the area affected will see the light but suffer no ill effects. Those who have Enhanced Sight or Night Vision suffer double the aforementioned effects.

Destroys one previous protection on a being or object. Any spell of type Warding (“War”) can be affected. The chance for any protection spell to be dispelled is determined through a contest of magics, where the amount of Aura put into the protection spell is compared to the amount of Aura put into Dispel Protection. Each amount is multiplied by 5%, and percentage dice are rolled for each. The roll which succeeds by the most wins. If the Dispel Protection roll wins, the protection spell is dispelled, otherwise the Dispel Protection fails. Permanent spells have a -75% chance to be dispelled. If a magic item is affected by this spell, the protection extended by the magic item will return at a rate of one Aura per day.

Causes one being or object touched to become immune to physical attacks of any kind. All powers, spells or skills that require touch, be they hurtful or helpful, will have no effect upon the protected object/being. Blessed, +1 and +2 weapons will do 1/4 damage to the being or object protected. Weapons with +3 or +4 magic bonus will do 1/2 damage to the protected being/object. A +5 or greater weapon will do full damage as will any artifact. Even Disintegration will not affect the being or object thus protected. Of course, the caster may not use spells, powers or skills of their own that require touch.

Allows the caster to make an object or being shrink down and disappear into a second (host) object or being. The object or being is actually sent to a newly created other space dimension. A living being that is merged has all possessions that are on it merged as well. The being is automatically given the effect Life Sensing at the caster's current Aura as a continuous ability. The merged being is also dimly aware of the passage of time. The caster can extract any object or being from the host object at will. One object or being may be extracted per second. Beings or living things trapped within the destroyed item or deceased being can make a Magic Resistance. If successful an object or being returns to its true size and shape. Otherwise, it is lost forever in the weird other space dimension with no hope of escape, save by a Wish or Miracle. NORMAL ITEM: 6 AUR (sword). MAGICAL ITEM: 8 AUR (Mithreel sword). ANIMAL: 10 AUR (Dog). HUMANOID: 12 AUR (Goblin). MAGICAL ANIMAL: 14 AUR (Pegasus). MAGICAL HUMANOID: 16 AUR (Giant). MAGICAL CREATURE: 18 AUR (Will O' Wisp). SUPERNATURAL/UNDEAD CREATURE: 20 AUR (Imp/Skeleton). Sapient beings cannot be merged against their will. Animals or magical beasts with no true sapience get a Magic Resistance to avoid the effects of this spell. If the host is transparent, tiny shadow or light forms can be seen swimming around inside the host (this is apparent only if the viewer makes an Illusion Resistance). No more than one object or being can be merged per cubic foot of the target. (An average human has about three cubic feet of space for merging purposes). A caster may target themselves and then extract themselves at will from the host. Any merged being can continue to use mental abilities. A living, merged being can pick up items merged into the host. Also, the being can see and interact with other merged beings (this includes combat, spell casting, etc.). They will simply be able to fly or float as per the spell True Flight and Float within the other space dimension. Artifacts cannot be merged by mortals.

Causes the being, and all carried possessions, to become insubstantial and then enter the Phase Plane. The being appears as a shimmering and transparent version of themselves. All physical actions against the being will have no effect whatsoever, but the reverse also holds true. Entering an Anti-Magic zone will cause the being to phase in. It is hard to move on the Phase Plane and requires some form of magical propulsion unless there are objects to push off of. Should the character drop an object; it will remain phased and can only be retrieved by another phased being. Alternately, the spell can simply be cast on an object causing it to phase out until retrieved by another phased being. All mental powers held by the caster or enemies thereof will freely pass onto the Phase Plane so that mental combat is possible (see also Phase Weapon.) If a living being is killed on the Phase Plane, its body will stay phased and may become a ghost trapped forever between dimensions. However, if the being is merely unconscious, it will return at the end of the duration of the spell.  This spell does not work on planes that are not connected to the Phase Plane.

Causes one touched being or object, including the caster themselves, to increase or decrease in size by Aura spent in the spell (from 1% to 200%). Comparative Strength will be acquired by the increase or decrease in size. Possessions and objects on the being do not change size. Armor worn will do the following damage based on the type before bursting if the being is increasing in size while wearing it. LEATHER: 1d6 to all areas protected. SCALE/RING: 2d6 to all areas protected. CHAIN: 3d6 to all areas protected. PLATE: 4d6 to all areas protected.

Causes the touched being and up to 20 pounds of extra material per Aura point to be teleported from their current location to another location with 25 miles per Aura used in the spell. The being must be touching all objects that are to be teleported. The total weight of all objects and items must be under the weight limit or the spell will automatically fail. While the spell has a failure chance like any other spell, there is a chance that the being (and any additional material) may rematerialize within another object. Use the following to determine success chance. NEVER SEEN: 35%. VIEWED ONCE: 45%. VIEWED (2-3 TIMES): 55%. MEMORIZED: 65%. VISITED OFTEN: 75%. CURRENT SIGHT: 85%. MAGICALLY VIEWED: 95%. HOME: 99%. Add a 1% chance per Intelligence and Wisdom rating over 15. If the roll fails the teleported being (an carried objects) will materialize within other objects at the new location. If failure occurs roll another d100% to determine results. GRAZE: 01-05%, 1 area take 1d6 damage. LIMB: 06-20%, 1-3 areas take 2d6 damage. LIMBS(2): 21-40%, 2-6 areas take 4d6 damage. LEGS: 41-60%, 2-6 areas take 6d6 damage. VITAL+LIMBS(1-2): 61-80%, 3-7 areas take 8d6 damage. HALF BODY: 81-95%, (50/50%) upper half=death, lower half=10d6 to Lower Torso and all leg areas. TOTAL: 96-100%, death. This can be from a light grazing (doing 1d6 damage) to total (causing death).

Causes the affected creature to make a Magic Resistance or take 1 damage per 4 Aura points in the spell to all body areas. If the resistance is made, only the area touched will suffer the damage. The spell causes a withering of the skin and muscle fibers and a burning fiery sensation.

Allows the caster to magically carry 100 pounds of material per Aura point, in any form or shape, be it magical or non-magical. The items will follow 1” behind the caster in a tight bundle. The objects transported will automatically follow the caster, even if they leave the plane or teleport. Alternately, if cast at 20 Aura, this spell may be used to create two special 10' x 10' x 10' areas. A command word is given at that time and upon uttering the command words at one location all goods and beings will be transported to the other specially prepared area. The reverse holds true as well.

Allows the caster to temporarily reduce physical attributes of the focus. For every 8 Aura put into the spell, all physical attributes are reduced temporarily by one point. If the caster designates a single attribute (Strength, Agility or Vitality) to be lowered, then that attribute is reduced one point per 6 Aura put into this spell. Attributes return at a rate of one point per hour. The effects of this spell are cumulative with multiple castings.

Allows the caster to change form into a specific creature type. The new form gives the caster the physical attributes of the creature, but not the magical ones. The forms are based on Aura used and Endurance range. AURA 2, END (1-3), Rat/Bird.  AURA 4, END (1-9), Dog/Pixie. AURA 6, END (1-19), Pony/Human. AURA 8, END (11-29), Horse/Grahl. AURA 10, END (11-49), Tiger/Ogre. AURA 12, END (26-74), Ox/Small Giant. AURA 14, END (51-99), Rhino/Giant. AURA 16, END (51-149), Elephant/Large Giant. AURA 18, END (101-199), Small Dragon. AURA 20, END (101-299), Dragon. AURA 22+, END (201-599), Large Dragon. If the caster stays in the form for more than 1 day they must make an INT save. Failure indicates a loss (or gain) of 1 INT, WIS, KNW, and CHM toward the creature's natural attribute ratings. If the ratings match, the transformation becomes complete, and the caster loses all knowledge of their previous life. Only a Wish spell (or Restore Form) will return the caster to normal after the transformation. The skills Body Control and Exorcism will free the mind of the invading thoughts, but the skill must be used after each failure of the INT save by the caster. A Mind Set spell cast on the conjurer will stop the mental transformation from ever taking place. Damage done is proportional and when the affected being is returned to their true form, the damage is reduced or increased in proportion to the difference in Endurance between the true form and the changed form.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power that effects a single being. SLEEP: 7 AURA, Sleep until Woken, 15+ WIL Immune. FEAR: 9 AURA, Flee for 4d10 min., 17+ WIL Immune. TRUTH: 11 AURA, Answer truthfully for 1d10 min., 17+ WIL Immune. SURRENDER: 13 AURA, Drop weapons and give up for 3d10 min., 17+ WIL Immune. KILL: 15 AURA, Try to kill named individual for 4d4 min., 17+ WIL Immune. PAIN: 17 AURA, 4d6 pain damage to the head until healed, 16+ WIL Immune. DEATH: 19 AURA, Heart attack (6d6 upper torso damage, incapacitated 1d4 min. VIT save or lose 1 VIT permanently), 16+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Sleep) that effects a single being. SLEEP: 7 AURA, Sleep until Woken, 15+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Fear) that effects a single being. FEAR: 9 AURA, Flee for 4d10 min., 17+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Truth) that effects a single being. TRUTH: 11 AURA, Answer truthfully for 1d10 min., 17+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Surrender) that effects a single being. SURRENDER: 13 AURA, Drop weapons and give up for 3d10 min., 17+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Kill) that effects a single being. KILL: 15 AURA, Try to kill named individual for 4d4 min., 17+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Pain) that effects a single being. PAIN: 17 AURA, 4d6 pain damage to the head until healed, 16+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Allows the caster to speak a word of power (Death) that effects a single being. DEATH: 19 AURA, Heart attack (6d6 upper torso damage, incapacitated 1d4 min. VIT save or lose 1 VIT permanently), 16+ WIL Immune. Beings using Body Control or Thought Projection, or affected by Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to this spell. Each command word is a separate spell. If the victim qualifies for a Control Resistance and the roll is made, there is no effect.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one Aura Elemental if it fails its Control Resistance. If the Aura Elemental is already controlled by another caster who used this spell at a higher Aura, then the new control spell fails automatically. If the amount of Aura for both spells are equivalent, then the spell works for the new caster and the previous caster loses control of the Aura Elemental. Unlike some forms of control, this spell is absolute. The Elemental is controlled completely and may even be sent to its death without benefit of a second Control Resistance.

Allows the caster to temporarily reduce mystical attributes of the focus. For every 9 Aura put into the spell, all mystical attributes are reduced temporarily by one point. If the caster designates a single attribute (Aura, Piety or Will Force) to be lowered, then that attribute is reduced one point per 7 Aura put into this spell. Attributes return at a rate of one point per hour. The effects of this spell are cumulative with multiple castings.

Causes the caster to transform into an Air Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Air Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Creates a jet of acid, emanating from the caster's finger. The Finger of Acid strikes the body area desired if an Intelligence save is made. The Finger of Acid does 1d10 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. Beings and objects which are immune to acid are unaffected by this spell. The spell Endure Acid is one such example. All armor reduces damage taken on a point per point basis but 1 armor value is destroyed for each point of damage taken. Remaining damage passes through to the being. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor.

Creates a magical field of hardened Aura totally surrounding the caster. The field is transparent (requires a perception check to see) and cannot be felt by the caster, allowing him to move objects around within the field without penalty. Should anyone else attempt to touch the caster it will prove an impossible task. Force Armor will act as armor, stopping one point of any type of damage per attack per Aura point used in the casting of the spell. All attacks that exceed the Force Armor value are considered to have touched the caster for purposes of determining touch powers, spells or for the effects of poison. The remainder of non-magical damage that penetrates the force armor is applied as smashing damage. This spell applies force in only one direction from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty.

Creates a blast of magical cold and then magical fire that alternately freezes and sears the target area if the caster makes a successful Intelligence save. Targets are allowed two Magic Resistances to avoid the effects of this spell, the first for the frost, and the second for the fire. If either roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. A roll is made for the cold first, and if the target takes damage from the cold, a roll is then made for the fire. If the target takes damage from the cold and then also takes damage from the fire, the fire damage will be doubled from the extreme temperature change. The damages are 1d4+1 per 2 Aura for the cold and 1d6+1 per 2 Aura for the fire. Magical items are allowed a single Magic Resistance to avoid both the effects of this spell.

Gives the affected being the ability to close their eyes, or other visual sense, and sense life forces within 3' per Aura point of the spell. The stronger the Will Force, the stronger the life force the individual will feel.  This also gives a general feeling of class Title or creature level.

Allows the caster to mentally Link with known, willing beings who are in range. The mental link is the equivalent of telepathy, allowing for sharing of surface thoughts and emotions, as well as perceptions. Those who leave the range break their link with the caster and cannot be rejoined except by a further casting. The caster cannot use Mind Link to mentally attack a being or to combine Will Force during a mental attack. Any form of mental attack, either by the caster or an outside party, breaks the Mind Link. A group of mind linked beings could connect to a second group of mind linked beings, as long as the number of beings limited by the area affected was not at its maximum. In this manner, a network of mind linked beings could be created. If at any time the total number of beings connected in such a chain exceeds the Will Force of any individual within the mind link, that being must make a Will Force save at -5% per extra being, or the link is broken and the unfortunate victim must roll for an insanity.

Causes the caster to swap minds with a being, animal or sapient plant. Also, sapient objects (such as certain magic items) can be targeted. The entire personas will simply switch places and the two beings will spend the next 1d10 minutes getting adjusted to the new body. If an affected being has a 17 or higher Intelligence, then there is no adjustment period for that being. This spell will not show visible signs of difference unless the two creatures are totally alien to each other (such as a gerbil and a Treewalker). The skill Exorcism will reverse the effects, otherwise only a similar spell or Dispel Magic will change the two back (before the duration's limit).

This complex and powerful spell allows the caster to warp the very spirit of one creature to their own will. No save is allowed to resist the control. However, every time the caster attempts to get the controlled being to do his bidding, the affected being rolls to break free of the spell based on the being's Will Force, the number of Persuasion castings and whether the thing being asked is no risk, risky or deadly risk. If the spell is ever broken, the victim will never be affected by the spell Persuasion again (from that caster). The spell requires 1 Aura point per Will Force point of the being affected. The spell must be recast periodically or it will also fail and render the victim immune to further castings. The caster must be able to speak the language of the creature under persuasion. The caster casts the spell by speaking at length with the affected being, and twisting the victim's own words against them.  WILL (0): Duration(permanent), All Castings(No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=0%).  WILL (1-3): Duration(1 year), 1st Cast(No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=5%), 2+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=0%).  WILL (4-6): Duration(6 months), 1st Cast(No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=10%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=5%), 6+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=0%).  WILL (7-9): Duration(3 months), 1st Cast(No Risk=0%, Risk=5%, Death=15%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=10%), 6+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=0%).  WILL (10-12): Duration(2 months), 1st Cast(No Risk=0%, Risk=10%, Death=20%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=5%, Death=15%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=5%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=0%).  WILL (13-14): Duration(1 month), 1st Cast(No Risk=5%, Risk=15%, Death=25%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=10%, Death=20%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=5%, Death=10%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=0%, Death=5%).  WILL (15-16): Duration(2 weeks), 1st Cast(No Risk=10%, Risk=20%, Death=30%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=5%, Risk=15%, Death=25%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=10%, Death=15%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=5%, Death=10%).  WILL (17): Duration(1 week), 1st Cast(No Risk=15%, Risk=25%, Death=35%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=10%, Risk=20%, Death=30%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=5%, Risk=15%, Death=25%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=0%, Risk=10%, Death=15%).  WILL (18): Duration(4 days), 1st Cast(No Risk=20%, Risk=30%, Death=40%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=15%, Risk=25%, Death=35%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=10%, Risk=20%, Death=30%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=5%, Risk=15%, Death=25%).  WILL (19): Duration(2 days), 1st Cast(No Risk=25%, Risk=35%, Death=45%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=20%, Risk=30%, Death=40%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=15%, Risk=25%, Death=35%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=10%, Risk=20%, Death=30%).  WILL (20+): Duration(2 days), 1st Cast(No Risk=30%, Risk=40%, Death=50%) 2-5 Castings (No Risk=25%, Risk=35%, Death=45%), 6-10 Castings (No Risk=20%, Risk=30%, Death=40%), 11+ Castings (No Risk=15%, Risk=25%, Death=35%).  For every casting after the eleventh, the affected being will lose 1 Will Force point, only to be returned if the being breaks the spell. If the affected being's Will Force ever reaches 0, then the caster is in complete control of the victim. The caster must stay in contact with the affected being, or the being will get 1% cumulative chance of breaking the spell per day the caster spends away from the affected being. If the caster is with the being 2 days, leaves 2, comes back and leaves again, the chance of breaking the spell will then be 3% +1% per additional day for that casting of Persuasion. This effect starts over at each casting of the spell. Unlike other mind control spells, this has no obvious effect on the victim's mind. The spell works against the spirit of the being, so it is not stopped by Mind Change, Mind Set, or Fortitude. This powerful spell is a favorite for using against nobility to get them to do the caster's bidding and yet remain unnoticed, even by Thought Projection. The skill Exorcism will eliminate the effects of this spell.

Summons an Air Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Air Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Causes one being to make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to wood. All possessions (except magic items) carried by beings who are turned to wood are likewise turned to wood. Carving away at beings that are wood will cause irreparable damage, and this damage will remain when they are transformed back. Beings turned to wood may be turned back to their true form by Dispel Magic or Transmute to Flesh.

Allows the caster to change one living thing into another form. The target will gain the natural abilities of its new form but none of the magical ones. The being retains Intelligence, Wisdom, Knowledge, Charm, Aura, Piety, and Will Force and gets the remaining attributes from its new form. It takes 4 Aura for each move away from the Endurance range of the original being. END (1-3): Rat/Bird. END (1-9): Dog/Pixie. END (1-19): Pony/Human. END (11-29): Horse/Grahl. END (11-49): Tiger/Ogre. END (26-74): Ox/Small Giant. END (51-99): Rhino/Giant. END (51-149): Elephant/Large Giant. END (101-199): Small Dragon. END (101-299): Dragon. END (201-599): Large Dragon. EXAMPLE: An average human has 14 END. It will take 16 Aura to turn that human into an insect or 16 Aura to be increased into a Rhino. Both are four moves up or down the chart (4 x 4 = 16). If the being stays in the form for more than 1 day they must make an INT save. Failure indicates a loss (or gain) of 1 INT, WIS, KNW, and CHM toward the creature's natural attribute ratings. If the ratings match, the transformation becomes complete, and the being loses all knowledge of their previous life. Only a Wish spell (or Restore Form) will return the being to normal after the transformation. The skills Body Control and Exorcism will free the mind of the invading thoughts, but the skill must be used after each failure of the INT save by the being. A Mind Set spell cast on the being will stop the mental transformation from ever taking place. Damage done is proportional and when the affected being is returned to their true form, the damage is reduced or increased in proportion to the difference in Endurance between the true form and the changed form.

Allows the caster to create a castle, tower, building, or other structure. In constructing each part of the total layout, a power cost is calculated. The caster receives one thousand power points per Aura point to build this structure. All materials must be within sight of the caster, and the caster must have spent at least 6 hours memorizing all plans for the structure. The caster casts the spell and all materials come together and form the total structure. The time to build (casting time) is 1 hour per 1,000 power points used in this spell. The power point cost for each element of a structure varies from as low as 1 PP for a 2' x 2' window or as high as 75 PP for a trebuchet (see Player's Guide pg. 265). The structure created by this spell is adhered together using materials (such as nails & mortar), so Dispel Magic has no effect.

Allows the caster an attempt to dispel one previous spell in effect or all the magic powers and abilities of one magic item. The chance for anyone spell to be dispelled is determined through a contest of magics, where the amount of Aura put into the focus spell is compared to the amount of Aura put into Dispel Magic. Each amount is multiplied by 5%, and percentage dice are rolled for each. The roll which succeeds by the most wins. If the Dispel Magic roll wins, the focus spell is dispelled, otherwise the Dispel Magic fails. Permanent spells have a -75% chance to be dispelled. When dispelling magic items, the contest is versus the Base Aura Level of the item. Powers are not permanently dispelled, as Dispel Magic merely resets the Base Aura Level to zero. Powers in magic items will return at a rate of one Aura point per day. Note that with some magic items (such as many wands) the Base Aura Level is already zero so the dispel literally has no effect. Spells with an instantaneous duration cannot be dispelled.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost personal attributes. For every 5 Aura put into the spell, all personal attributes are increased by one point (excluding Social Class). If the caster designates a single personal attribute to be increased (Charm or Appearance), then that attribute is increased 1 point per 4 Aura put into the spell. This spell cannot be combined with further castings, nor will it affect the caster if using a magic item that increases any attribute the caster is attempting to raise.

Causes 1 being per 3 Aura used in the spell to desire to complete a task for the caster. It may be cast on anyone whose true name is known and who resides on the same plane of existence. The caster forms a task in their mind and then geases the beings to complete the task. The geased individual must be within the same alignment band (good, evil or neutral) as the caster. The task must be within the alignment of the geased being or there is no effect. The geased being gets a new Control Resistance each time there is danger during the completion of the task. The caster may have only one Geas spell in effect at a time. Information about the task is given as part of the Geas. Beings of 10th or higher Title, those with Mind Set, Telepathy, Improved Telepathy or the skill Thought Projection are immune to these effects.

Allows the caster to cause up to one individual per 2 Aura to make a Control Resistance or be inflicted with a random insanity for the duration of the spell. At 15 or higher Aura the spell can be directed at a single individual and an insanity of the caster's choice can be inflicted upon the victim, if Control Resistance fails. Beings with Telepathy, Improved Telepathy, Thought Projection, Mind Set or Mind Change are immune to the effects of this spell.

Grants the caster or affected being extra luck. In game mechanics this grants 1 luck point per 2 Aura used in the spell. Each luck point can be used to determine rolled effects for or against the affected being by +/- 1 or +/- 5%, whichever is applicable and most favorable. No more than half of a being's current luck points can be used in any one roll. A caster may cast this spell no more than once per day, per individual. No person may be affected by more than one Luck spell per day regardless of the origin. Unused luck points are lost 24 hours after the casting. No skill chance or resistance can be improved by more than 50%. To hit modifiers or Defensive modifiers cap at +6 and -6 respectively. Any roll can never be more than doubled or halved in chance with this spell.

Requires a container before the casting of this spell. The container can be a reflective surface, bottle, box or even a flawless gem. Once this spell is cast, the victim must make a Control Resistance or their entire mind and consciousness will be trapped in the container. The being's body will remain in a state of stasis, and must be fed or it will die. The being can only be released if the container is opened, or broken in the case of a gem or a mirror. If the being is trapped in a gem, mirror, or reflective object, an Intelligence save will show the being trapped inside. More than one being can be inside the object, but in no case can there be more beings than the caster has Will Force. The being can sense life within 5' of the object and can also be contacted by Telepathy. The spell Mind Set or Mind Change will make the being immune, as will the use of the skill Body Control.

Creates a lesser undead spirit, by infusing the dead spirit with negative life force. The type produces is based upon the location where the spell is cast. TRAUMATIC DEATH AREA: 16 AUR, Poltergeist. EVIL BEING DEATH AREA: 16 AUR, Shade. The caster has no control over the undead, and they will only cooperate if they feel they can gain something. Undead created are not permanent, and must either have Extend or Permanency cast upon them to increase the duration.

Causes one being or object to make a Magic Resistance or be held in near null time. An object or being in Stasis is incapable of action (physical or mental), but by the same token, is unable to be hurt or moved physically or mentally. If the caster targets a flying bird. the bird will be held in mid-air, immobile and unaware of events around it. This spell can only be removed by the caster or Dispel Magic. Time for the target is slowed to one second of action per year.

Causes spears of Aura to shoot from the caster's hand. One spear is created for every 2 Aura points used in the spell, and each new spear will be created 2 seconds after the last one setting the casting time of 2 seconds per spear. Each spear must be rolled to hit against the opponent as a missile weapon. Each spear does 1d8+1 and will pass through all forms of armor or protection, with no save at all except for magical armor (determined by a Magic Resistance). These missiles can be dodged with the skill Dodge. The caster must concentrate until all the spears have been thrown.

Causes one being or object to come from anywhere if their true or given name, in its entirety, is spoken aloud by the caster. The summoned being will appear within 1' per Aura of the caster. Summoned beings are free to do as they please, but they must listen to the caster for at least one minute. The being will stay (on the same plane) for one day per Aura point, unless it has been brought to its native plane, in which case it will stay permanently. A Circle of Power can keep summoned creatures at bay (see Circles of Power at the beginning of this section). A Dispel Magic cast on a summoned being will return the being if it was summoned from another plane. Summon will not work on beings with 19 or greater average in personal attributes who wish to avoid being summoned.

Causes the caster to see events that have happened, or will (may) happen, within sight of the area where the caster is. The caster must be in a meditative state, relatively free from danger. The distance seen forward or backard in time varies by the amount of Aura used in the spell. Duration is equal to the amount of time the caster intends to watch. One minute of viewed time is one minute of current duration in the present time. Alternately, the caster can see history or the future moving backward or forward at a high speed, until reaching the maximum time change. AURA 2: +/- 1 hour. AURA 4: +/- 6 hours. AURA 6: +/- 12 hours. AURA 8: +/- 1 day. AURA 10: +/- 5 days. AURA 12: +/- 1 week. AURA 14: +/- 2 weeks. AURA 16: +/- 1 month. AURA 18: +/- 6 months. AURA 20: +/- 1 year. AURA 21+: +/- +1 year per. AURA 41+: +/- +10 years per. AURA 61+: +/- +100 years per. AURA 81+: +/- +1000 years per. All the caster is doing is viewing time. The caster may not alter time. The caster is vulnerable to attack while using this spell because the caster is unaware of their body. Damage will release the caster from the spell at the end of the 10-second period in which the caster was struck. The future seen by this spell is only a possible one.

Each wall of power created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The force walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but all the walls must touch another wall or be fixed onto a solid surface. As with all wall spells, any living being that is in the way of a the wall will cause that section to fail. Each wall will let nothing pass through it, and is invulnerable and impervious to all forms of attack, magical, divine magical or otherwise (save Dispel Magic, Dispel Protection or Disintegration). The wall is also proof against teleportation and mental attacks of any kind.

Causes the caster and up to four other spellcasters to magically link and act as one caster. The caster may link with one caster for every 5 Aura used in this spell. The magical linkage gives the following bonuses and modifiers: 1) All linked spellcasters add their total Aura and Aura Control together. 2) Only one spell may be cast at a time within the group, but any of the linked casters may cast it. The person casting must still be touched by the others in the link, but must have hands free to cast. 3) Aura Regeneration Rate is normal for each individual caster. 4) If one of the linked casters takes damage, all casters must make an Intelligence save to stay linked. All those failing will drop out of the circle and be stunned for 3d4 seconds. 5) If one of the linked members dies, the linkage ceases immediately. Those that were linked must make a Magic Resistance or die themselves. Exorcism may be used to bring back those that die, but it must begin within 5 minutes after the death. Even those who make their save are considered to be in shock. 6) Under no condition may another Combine spell be used to combine more than the original number of linked casters. All those linked must be touching (like a chain) or the spell will fail. Every person linked must make an Intelligence save to link. No one can be forced to become part of this spell. Dispel Magic cast at one of the spellcasters can dispel the link. Spellcasters may not combine to use skills, or cast the spells Wish or Enchantment.

Allows the caster to change the specific gravity as desired in the area affected. NULLIFY: 5 AUR. REVERSE: 10 AUR. SIDEWAY: 5 AUR. DOUBLE: 10 AUR. TRIPLE: 20 AUR. Levitate will nullify the effects of this spell on the being using it. Fly will be at 1/2 speed through a double normal area and 1/4 speed through areas which are at triple normal.

Allows the caster to disrupt another caster's spell, during the time in which that caster is shaping the spell (casting time). The caster of the Disrupt Spell must guess the amount of Aura being put into the other caster's spell and match or exceed that amount in the casting of their Disrupt Spell. If these conditions are met, the caster who is having their spell disrupted is allowed to make a Magic Resistance. Failure indicates the spell is disrupted and fails. Success indicates that the spell is not disrupted. If the caster of the Disrupt Spell manages to end their casting time at the same time as the opposing caster, there is a 50% chance that the focus spell will be disrupted in time.

The caster casts this spell, then concentrates and waits, unable to cast another spell. When another spell is cast within the distance to focus indicated, the caster may pick that spell and make a copy of it. The caster is required to spend the same Aura as the caster of the duplicate spell. The duplicate spell is held and can be cast at any time before the duration has ended, but must concentrate upon it and can cast no further spells until the spell has been released. This in no way prevents the original focus spell from taking its effects. This will allow a spellcaster to cast a previously unknown spell. If the caster has a writing instrument at the time, an attempt may be made to understand the duplicated spell by making a 1/2 Scroll Knowledge (or equivalent) roll. This attempt must be made within 24 hours of duplication of the spell. Failure indicates no further tries to learn the spell without real magic notes or a scroll.

Causes the caster to transform into an Earth Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Earth Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.
Allows the being affected to be immune to the effects of all forms of acid, magical or otherwise. Protects all materials carried within 6“ of the affected being.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost mental attributes. For every 7 Aura put into the spell, all mental attributes are increased by one point. If the caster designates a single mental attribute to be increased (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Knowledge), then that attribute is increased 1 point per 5 Aura put into the spell. This spell cannot be combined with further castings, nor will it affect the caster if using a magic item that increases any attribute the caster is attempting to raise.

Causes one missile to seek its target magically. This affords an additional +1 bonus to the attack roll per 5 Aura placed into the spell, unless the missile is already magical, in which case only an additional +1 to hit is added regardless of Aura used. In addition, the missile will home in on its target, going around comers or obstructions so long as the person who fired the projectile or missile imagined the target correctly (Intelligence save). The standard d20 is used to determine hit and location, as if the projectile launcher had fired directly at the target. All ranges are x1 greater per 5 Aura of the spell; i.e. at 5 Aura missile ranges are each x2, at 10 Aura x3, at 15 Aura x4, etc. Targets protected by Non-Detection or Invisibility are not subject to the aiming effects of the spelled missile. The spells Reflection and Spell Turning will make the projectile seek the being who originally fired it. Targets completely obstructed on all four sides will cause the aiming to seek the target by circling the area where the target is until the range or duration expires. The caster must maintain concentration while the missile is in flight.

Creates a spherical, transparent force field that can be moved with the caster as long as concentration is maintained. The sphere is immune to all forms of attack (magical, mental, or otherwise) and may not be teleported through. Nothing can pass through the sphere, and it cannot be moved through solid objects. If the caster is on a solid surface, then the sphere will conform to that surface when cast, effectively making a shell. In essence, the beings protected cannot be harmed while the spell is in effect. Dispel Magic, Dispel Protection or Disintegration will destroy this sphere. In the case of Disintegration, the effect is automatic.

Creates a storm of whirling, splashing, highly corrosive acid within a height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects:  1) Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d10 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to 2d4 exposed areas. (All body areas). Armor absorbs damage on a 1 for 1 basis but loses armor value for each point absorbed. 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be blinded with a 1% chance per Aura used of permanent blindness. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Acid always miss their target. 6) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Storm of Paralysis is not a true storm, but rather a greater version of Paralysis. The spell affects 1 being per Aura (of the caster's choice) within 10' per Aura. Unlike other storm spells, the caster does not have to concentrate.

Summons an Earth Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Earth Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Causes one being to make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to crystal. All possessions (except magic items) carried by beings who are turned to crystal are likewise turned to crystal. Breaking the crystal will cause irreparable damage, and this damage will remain when the being is transformed back. Beings turned to crystal may be turned back to their true form by Dispel Magic or Transmute to Flesh.

Grants the caster the ability to adversely affect the luck of one other being (or themselves). In game mechanics this grants 1 unlucky point per 2 Aura used in the spell. Each unlucky point can be used to determine rolled effects against the affected being by +/- 1 or +/- 5%, whichever is applicable and most unfavorable. The caster (or GM) determines which rolls are affected and by how much. No more than half of a being's current unlucky points can be used in any one roll. A caster may cast this spell no more than once per day, per individual. No person may be affected by more than one Unlucky spell per day regardless of the origin. Unused unlucky points are lost 24 hours after the casting. No skill chance or resistance can be decreased by more than 50%. To hit modifiers or Defensive modifiers cap at -6 and +6 respectively. Any roll can never be lowered by more than half or more than doubled in chance with this spell.

Allows the caster to disappear and instantaneously reappear anywhere (that is unoccupied) within the caster's sight. All objects carried by the caster are transported as well. After blinking, the caster must spend one second and make a successful INT save to orient themselves, or lose 1d4+1 seconds getting their bearings. The caster may Blink in the next combat round (after just blinking) if a Will Force save is made.

Causes one being to assume the true shape and form of another being. Change True grants all magical powers and abilities of the type of creature whose shape is being assumed. This includes breath attacks, gaze attacks, extra attacks, mental abilities, magical characteristics, etc. The affected being retains all mental, Charm and Will Force attributes. The being does not suffer from the mind-altering long-term effects of staying in another being's shape. For each difference in Title versus creature level, the caster must place a minimum of 2 Aura. Damage done is proportional, and when the affected being returns to their true form, the damage is reduced or increased in proportion to the difference in Endurance between their true form and the changed form.

Increases the interior dimensions of a container or enclosed room. CONTAINER: 1) Inside of the container increases by xl per 2 Aura. 2) All interior dimensions expand equally. 3) The container may only have 1 opening. 4) When open, the container's contents can be seen but miniaturized. 5) The outside of the container can be no larger than 10' x 10' x 10' or it is considered a room. 6) A successful Dispel Magic causes the container to rapidly shrink to normal size, becoming xl smaller per 5 seconds. If the container is overfull, it will burst. All metal objects remove 2d4 points from their object strength. Wooden objects remove 4d6 points of object strength. Flesh takes 4d10 damage to 3d6 random areas. 7) The container will weigh 1/2 half as much for each 2 Aura used in the spell. ROOM: 1) The sides of the room increase by x1 per 2 Aura. 2) All interior dimensions of the room are expanded equally. 3) If a wall is destroyed or a successful Dispel Magic is cast, the room will shrink to normal size, its sides reducing by xl per minute. If overfull, All metal objects remove 4d4 points from their object strength. Wooden objects remove 8d6 points of object strength. Flesh takes 8d10 damage to 3d6 random areas. 4) The dimensions of the room can be seen through an open door and appear impossibly large. 5) The area of the room cannot be more than 100' x 100' x 100' originally, or it will be too large for the spell to be cast. Casting Dimension within another Dimension spell will cause both to fail utterly, destroying all beings caught in the first dimension. Effectively, everything in the dimension simply ceases to exist and the area of the room or container immediately returns to its normal size.
