However. bringing a container on which Dimension has been cast into a room on which Dimension has been cast, merely causes the container Dimension to fail as if a Dispel Magic had been successfully cast upon it (the contents do not vanish). Using this spell with Cache will create a cache that is x1 greater for every 2 Aura in the Dimension spell. This spell can be made permanent with Permanency.

system.spellTypes: Dim, Dis, Meta, Nat, Sen, Tra, War
system.description: Creates a magical area that will increase the caster's magical strength and grant additional powers. The area affected is 4 cubic sections of 10' x 10' x 10' per Aura point used in the spell. All sections must be touching for the bonuses to apply. Effects are based on Aura used in the spell. AURA 10: +1 AC, Sense Presence. AURA 12: +1 AUR, +1 AC, Sense Presence, Teleport. AURA 14: +1 AUR, +2 AC, Sense Presence, Teleport, Animate. AURA 16: +2 AUR, +2 AC, Sense Presence, Teleport, Animate, Warding. AURA 18: +3 AUR, +3 AC, Sense Presence, Teleport, Animate, Warding, Skill Bonus. AURA 20+: +4 AUR, +4 AC, Sense Presence, Teleport, Animate, Warding, Skill Bonus, Spell Failure. SENSE PRESENCE: Allows the caster to sense anyone who enters the enchanted area, even if the caster is not currently in the enchanted area. Beings using the spell or power Non-Detection are unaffected by this. The caster can feel the exact location of each individual at all times as long as they stay within the enchanted area. TELEPORT: Allows the caster to teleport back to the enchanted area at no failure rate from anywhere or any plane (with the spell Teleport). It also allows the caster to teleport to any section of the enchanted area once per 10 seconds without failure, requiring no concentration even if the caster does not have the spell. ANIMATE: Allows the caster to cast Animate Object at double strength (as if double the Aura had been put into it) anywhere in the enchanted area, even if the caster does not have that spell. WARDING: Causes all current or potential enemies to make a Control Resistance at -20% to enter the caster's enchanted area. SKILL BONUS: +5% bonus to all magical skills per 5 Aura. SPELL FAILURE: Causes spells and magical items used in a hostile manner against the caster to fail at 10% per Aura point under 20. This spell may not be combined with Dimension to increase the area affected. It may, however, be cast within a Dimension or a Cache. This spell is an exception to the magical cumulative effects rule. Any and all bonuses can be added to any similar magical effects.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost physical attributes. For every 8 Aura put into the spell, all physical attributes are increased by one point. If the caster designates a single physical attribute to be increased (Strength, Agility, or Vitality), then that attribute is increased 1 point per 6 Aura put into the spell. This spell cannot be combined with further castings, nor will it affect the caster if using a magic item that increases any attribute the caster is attempting to raise.

Allows for direct, deep mental connection with anyone the caster can see, including mental combat, just like the skill Thought Projection. Those protected from mental contact, such as with the spell Mind Set or Mind Change, are immune to the effects of this spell.

Causes the target to burst into flames. The victim suffers the following effects from the intense heat and flame: 1) 4d6 random areas take 1d6 per 2 Aura used in the spell. A successful Magic Resistance reduces the damage taken in each area by half. 2) All flammable objects on the being immediately burst into flame and will be consumed as with a normal fire. 3) Magical wooden objects and magical paper must make a Magic Resistance or burst into flames and be consumed. Beings immune to fire, or with the spell or power Endure Heat, are immune to the effects of this spell, as are their items.

Adds Aura to the original amount of Aura directed into an active spell (or power in a magic item). Spells will gain 1 additional Aura point in power for every 2 Aura points used in the Intensify spell. Magic item powers will gain 1 additional Aura point per 4 Aura points used in the Intensify spell. The number of Aura points added by Intensify cannot be more than the original number put into the spell (or item).

Allows the caster to leave their plane of origin and travel to a distant plane. Additional Aura cost depends on the conditions. PARTICULAR PLACE ON PLANE: +10 AUR. DOMAIN OF A PARTICULAR DEITY: +5 AUR. All beings who wish to plane shift need to be touching the caster. The caster can become lost and unable to return, at a 1% chance per day spent on the other plane (non-cumulative). If the caster or beings die while on the other plane, they lose a WIL point, but will return to their original plane, where they must rest for 1d4 weeks.

Creates a greater undead corpse by infusing a dead body with negative life force. The type of undead is based upon the corpse and the conditions of its death. RITUALLY PREPARED CORPSE: AURA: 17, Mummy. DEATH KNIGHT CORPSE: AURA: 18, Wight. The caster has no control over the undead, and it will only cooperate if it feels it can gain something. Undead created are not permanent, and must either have Extend or Permanency cast upon them to increase the duration.

Allows the caster to merge one or more spells into a single spell. One spell is allowed to be merged per 5 Aura used in the casting of Spell Merge. When this spell is cast, it creates a magical binding field which allows additional spells to be cast into it. Each additional spell cast adds its own casting time to the casting time of Spell Merge. When all spells have been added, the Spell Merge is complete, and the spells are released as a single new spell. The parameters of the new spell are as follows. DISTANCE TO FOCUS: The shortest distance is used of all the merged spells. RANGE: The shortest range is used of all the merged spells. DURATION: The shortest time is used of all the merged spells. AREA EFFECTED: All spells cast to merge must match exactly, or the entire merge will fail. Thus, there is one Area Effected. The Game Master may restrict the use of this spell, or decide a combination spell is impossible due either to the nature of the spells involved, or the fitness of the new combined spell to their world.

Causes ballista bolts of Aura to shoot from the caster's hand. One bolt is created for every 2 Aura points used in the spell, and each new bolt will be created 2 seconds after the last one setting the casting time of 2 seconds per bolt. Each bolt must be rolled to hit against the opponent as a missile weapon. Each bolt does 1d10+1 and will pass through all forms of armor or protection, with no save at all except for magical armor (determined by a Magic Resistance). These missiles can be dodged with the skill Dodge. The caster must concentrate until all the bolt have been thrown.

Creates one 10' x 10' x 10' warped magical zone per 2 Aura used in the spell. A warped magical zone has the following effects: 1) Any additional spells and magic item effects cast or activated have a chance (5% per Aura cast into the Warp Magic spell) of being replaced by a random spell of the same Aura Level. 2) The focus and targets of the spell are determined randomly (if Applicable). Each focus and target in the Warp Magic zone has an equal chance of being struck. This effect happens regardless of whether the spell itself changed (as in 1 above). Any spell cast into the zone from outside the zone, except Dispel Magic, randomly re-targets as in 2 above (Dispel Magic will apply as normal to Warp Magic when cast from outside). If a Dispel Magic is cast within the Warp Magic zone, its focus will be determined randomly.

Allows the caster to create one 10' x 10' x 10' area per Aura used in the spell. All divine magic in the area affected will temporarily lose its divine magical nature. Exiting the area affected or the expiration of the duration will cause all divine magic items, effects and divine magical skills to return to “normal”, No invocations, skills, powers or divine magic effects may be produced in the area affected. The Anti-Divinity area cannot be detected by divine magic. Only one invocation, Anti-Magic, can be invoked or exist in the area affect. Anti-Magic and Anti-Divinity affect everything else except each other.

Creates a very strong negative energy field attuned against a single race, alignment or any qualification that the Game Master deems reasonable. Its effects vary depending on whether its magic is placed on an object or a place. OBJECT: If the object is touched by or touches the attuned being, a Magic Resistance is required, or instantaneous death is a result. Only one save is required per 10 seconds. Beings whom the object is attuned against can feel a sense of danger within 60 feet of the object and can sense the object as the source, if they can see it. PLACE: Beings whom the place is attuned against can feel a sense of danger within 100' of the area and can sense the area as the source, if they can see it. Beings in the area affected make a Magic Resistance once per 10 seconds or perish. Undead beings and beings immune to death magics are unaffected.

Causes one being to make a Magic Resistance or be transported to the astral plane (Plane of Order). Once there, they may attempt to return by whatever means possible. All objects will be transported with the unfortunate being, unless the item is an artifact, in which case it is immune to the effect and will remain behind unless it is somehow bound to the being (Deity artifacts, etc.). The caster may need to know the true name of the being (at the discretion of the GM). If the being is originally from another plane, this spell will return that being to its plane of origin rather than transporting it to the Plane of Order. Banish will also destroy soulless undead who fail their Magic Resistance (at the discretion of the GM).

Charges an Aura around the caster's hands with the power to disintegrate. The caster's hands will be able to disintegrate the next being or object touched if it fails its Magic Resistance. The caster can disintegrate an entire being, but must put a number of Aura points into the spell that equals the Aura Rating of the being. When an object is disintegrated, it turns black the second it is touched by the caster and then is reduced to powder that is 1/1000th the size of the original object or being. A Wish or Miracle are two ways to bring back a person or object who has been disintegrated. If the affected creature has Rebirth cast prior to being disintegrated, and the black powder that comprises the being's remains are gathered and poured over the Rebirth object (see Rebirth), the being will begin the rebirth process. The being cannot be resurrected.

Causes the caster to transform into a Fire Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Fire Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Dim, Lif, Meta, Min, Tra
system.description: Allows the caster to grant sapience to an area, object, or animal. Essentially the spell causes a soul and spirit to choose to inhabit the body and bring it to life. The Intelligence, Wisdom, Charm, Will Force are random, and alignment is either the same as the casters or random. The random sapience roll has 5% added to it per Aura over 20. Aura requirement, casting time, and permanent Will Force cost vary by the what is being granted sapience. ANIMAL/PLANT(SMALL): AURA 10, 10 min., WIL 1/10. ANIMAL/PLANT(MED.): AURA 12, 1 hour, WIL 1/5. ANIMAL/PLANT(LARGE): AURA 14, 6 hours, WIL 1/2. ITEM: AURA 16, 1 day, WIL 1. ROOM: AURA 18, 1 week, WIL 2. STRUCTURE: AURA 20, 1 month, WIL 4. Sapient objects and animals are considered to be at adult level emotionally, and progress from there. The object will usually view its endower with at least respect. All beings or objects can speak the main language of the caster and can learn other languages later. If Random is rolled for alignment, alignment is determined at Game Master's discretion. All endowed creatures gain either a magical voice or limited telepathy (caster's choice).

Allows the caster to temporarily boost mystical attributes. For every 9 Aura put into the spell, all mystical attributes are increased by one point. If the caster designates a single mystical attribute to be increased (Aura, Piety, or Will Force), then that attribute is increased 1 point per 7 Aura put into the spell. This spell cannot be combined with further castings, nor will it affect the caster if using a magic item that increases any attribute the caster is attempting to raise.

Causes a magical concussive force that explodes outward from a target area chosen by the caster (no hit roll is needed). 1) A successful Magic Resistance will reduce all damage by half. 2) 1/2' radius per Aura point; 1d10 damage per 2 Aura to 4d4 random areas. Victim is knocked back from the center of the explosion at a distance = (1' per Aura -1' per 50 lb. of weight.) 4d4 seconds to recover if not already dead. Armor will reduce damage taken by 1/2 but will be damaged as if the attack was a smashing one. 3) 1' radius per Aura point; 1d6 damage per 2 Aura to 2d4 random areas. Requires a 1/2 Agility save to stand. 2d4 seconds to recover. Armor takes damage as #1. 4) 1 & 1/2' radius per Aura point; 1d6 damage per 2 Aura to 1d4 random areas. Requires an Agility save to stand. 2-5 seconds to recover only if the Agility save is failed. Armor reduces damages as indicated. The spell or power Invulnerability will automatically counter the effects of the spell for the individual so protected, as will Sphere of Power or Protection. There is a 1% chance per Aura point used in the spell of shattering a Sphere of Power.

Allows the caster to change their Aura Field into an Aura absorption field that will absorb up to 3 Aura worth of spells thrown at the caster per Aura put into the Spell Absorption spell. This causes all spells cast at the caster to fail if the caster makes a Magic Resistance (regardless if a Magic Resistance is normally called for). If this resistance is successful, then the Aura is removed from the spell and the spell fizzles. The removed Aura is added to the caster's own. If at the end of any 10 second period the caster has more than double his or her normal Aura rating, the excess burns off and does 1d6 to 1d4 random areas per point of excess Aura. When the absorption points have expired, then the Spell Absorption is considered ended, regardless of remaining duration. Partially absorbed spells are reduced by the absorbed Aura in strength. Reflection and Spell Turning have precedence and will affect cast spells before Spell Absorption can.

system.spellTypes: Cre, Dis, Dth, Eng, Meta, Tra
system.description: Creates a dark storm of immense power that covers the area described above, aging all beings/objects in the area affected, if they fail their Magic Resistance. A new Magic Resistance is required every 10 second period to avoid the effects listed for that 10 seconds: PLANT(SMALL): instant death. PLANT(MED.): Wilt. PLANT(LARGE): lose foliage. PLANTS(INTELLIGENT): 1d4 END/3 AUR. ANIMAL(SMALL): instant death. ANIMAL(AVERAGE): 1d4 END/5 AUR. ANIMAL(INTELLIGENT): Age 1d6 years/5 AUR. ELF: Age 10-60 years/5 AUR. DWARF: Age 2d6 years/5 AUR. AVIAN: Age 1d10 years/5 AUR. MIDFOLK: Age 1d8 years/5 AUR. HUMAN: Age 1d6 years/5 AUR. GOBLIN/WILDONE: Age 1d4 years/5 AUR. STONE: -1 object strength/2 AUR. METAL: -1d4 object strength/5 AUR. WOOD: -1d6 object strength/5 AUR. LEATHER: -1d10 object strength/5 AUR. In the case of armor, the points are removed from the armor value.

Summons a Fire Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Fire Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

The hand or similar appendage is held upright. A bolt of pure charged Aura shoots from the hand and strikes the target in the area chosen, if an Intelligence save is made. The spell is the most powerful form of direct spell damage. doing 1d12 per 2 Aura used in the spell. If the being makes a Magic Resistance by less than 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made but was greater than a 1/2 save, then 1/2 damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. If the being is immune to fire, has some form of protection from fire, or is wearing magical armor, then only 1/2 damage will be taken even if the save is failed, and only 1/4 if the save is made by less than half.

Creates an extra-dimensional space. The extra-dimensional space created by the caster will have 5 sections 10' x 10' x 10' per Aura used in casting the spell. The Cache created will appear in any layout desired by the caster so long as it does not go over the number of sections alloted. There are two varieties of Cache, on an object or on the caster. OBJECT: 1) Time in the cache passes equal with time outside the cache. 2) The spell must be cast on a prepared high-quality item. 3) The item must be given a command word (or words) when cast, that will send the holder to the cache. 4) When the item is activated all beings and items touching the object are transported to the cache so long as there is room for them. a) The caster must designate a place (or places) where beings and objects will initially arrive in the cache. b) The caster must also establish a portal or method that will transport beings back. c) All beings and objects that possess sapience are granted a Magic Resistance to avoid being transported to the cache. d) The cache object will remain outside the cache as it is the key to the cache. It will remain wherever it was left when used to enter the cache. It can be stolen, moved. etc. e) If the cache object is destroyed (Disintegrate, Explosion. etc.), all beings and objects in the cache are trapped within it. The cache still exists, but the portal between the caster's home plane and the cache dimension is closed and only a Wish will open it again. f) A Dispel Magic simply destroys the cache, returning all objects to the place where the key was. CASTER: 1) Time in the form of decay within the cache is stopped. No time passes within the confines of the cache: no growth, need for food or air, etc. Beings that are transported there are automatically in stasis (see Stasis) until the caster frees them. 2) To transport objects and beings to the cache, the caster must first be Touching them and then must spend one second per object or being to send them there. The Aura cost to send:(Non-Living: 2, Magical: 4, Animals/Plants: 6, The Caster: 8, Beings: 10, Sapient Items: 15, Artifacts: 20). A Magic Resistance is allowed for an individual to resist being sent to the cache (if the being or object is sapient and wishes to resist). 3) As listed in #1 above, all beings are held in stasis once they arrive in the cache. The caster may send each and every object or being to a different location within the cache. It costs no Aura for the caster to remove the stasis on the being. but the being is then free and cannot be held in stasis again except by an actual casting of the spell (or power) Stasis. 4) The caster calls objects out of the cache by carrying them out when leaving the cache. Transporting out of the cache is instantaneous and takes a mere thought. Beings and objects may be called out of the cache by the caster once the caster is outside the cache. Objects will appear in the caster's hands (or touching them). Beings will appear as near as possible to the caster. The caster may only call 1 object/being per second from the cache. 5) Once beings are released in the cache, they will not need to eat or sleep, And time will have had no effect upon them. 6) Time passes normally outside this type of cache, as compared to the Beings inside. 7) If the caster is killed. everything in his cache is transported to the area where the caster was killed. 8) Dispel Magic cast on the caster, if successful, will have the same effect as #7 above but will appear around the caster. Dispelling the Cache is at -25%. NOTES: The cache dimension is hidden in the Ethereal Plane and can only be reached by the caster or the cache object. Beings and objects in that cache are undetectable from outside the cache and cannot be summoned, scryed upon, teleported to, located or generally affected in any way from outside the cache. Two or more casters can create separate but connecting caches by designating a portal connecting them. Object caches cannot be combined this way. Casters can make an object cache with the spell Combine, but not a personal cache. A cache object can be the target of an Enchantment spell after it is created.

Makes the duration of an already existing spell permanent. If cast on a being, it will grant the abilities that one spell endows permanently to that being. Permanency cast on an object will allow that object to have the power of the spell that is made permanent. It may be cast on an area spell (such as some illusions) to keep the spell going permanently in that area. BLOCKED SPELLS: Combine, Command Word, Corrupt, Create Door, Delay, Discourage, Duplicate Spell, Endow Intelligence, Enhance Mental, Enhance Mystical, Enhance Personal, Enhance Physical, Extend, Far Slumber, Feeblemindedness, Frost Fire, Geas, Inflict Insanity, Mind Beast, Mind Monster, Rebirth, Slovenliness, Slumber, Spell Merge, Any Storm Spell, Time Sight and Weakness, any spell with an instantaneous or permanent duration, any spell of type Control (“Con”) or Summon (“Sum”). GENERAL: All spells not listed above can be made permanent in their area affected at the cost of a 1/2 of a Will Force point to the caster. Spells that affect objects may also be made permanent at the same cost. Dispel Magic will eliminate the effects of the spell but is rolled at -75%. The casting of Delay on a permanent spell will cause the permanent spell's effects to disappear for the duration of the Delay spell. SPECIAL COSTS: Instantaneous Movement: 2 WIL. Special Movement (Fly, Stone Swim): 1 WIL. Enhances Existing Sense: 1/2 WIL. Gives New Sense: 1 WIL. Enhances Combat (Tumble, Enhance Speed): 3 WIL. Grants Ability to Possess/Mental Combat (Improved Telepathy): 5 WIL. Gives New Limb/Attack: 2 WIL. Gives Minor Mental Power: 2 WIL. Hides from Non-sight Sense (Silence): 1 WIL. Hides from Sight (Invisibility): 3 WIL. Hides from a Single Magical Sense (Mask Aura, Mind Set): 2 WIL. Hides from All Magical Senses (Non-detection): 3 WIL. Illusionary (Glamour): 1/2 WIL. Keeps Clean or Fresh: 1/2 WIL. Makes Immuine to Normal Weapons (Invulnerability): 5 WIL. Provides Single Protections (Endure Cold, Fire, etc.): 1 WIL. Provides Multiple Protections (Protection, Reflection): 2 WIL. All Others Spells Not Listed (in the current area of effect, or object): 1/2 WIL. All Others Spells Not Listed (on a person, creating power x per day): 1 WIL. All Others Spells Not Listed (on a person, constant): 2 WIL. NOTES: Combining Permanency and Set can cause programmed spells that will activate every time the condition of the Set is met and will allow even permanency of the restricted spells, GM has discretion.

Creates a greater undead spirit, by infusing the dead spirit with negative life force. The type of greater undead is based upon the conditions when the spell is cast. FEMALE ELF SPIRIT: AUR 17, Banshee. SLAIN CASTER: AUR 19, Spectre. HATEFULL BEING: AUR 20, Wraith. The caster has no control over the undead, and it will only cooperate if it feels it can gain something. Undead created are not permanent, and must either have Extend or Permanency cast upon them to increase the duration.

Allows the caster to enchant a miniature statuette with the ability to absorb the caster's essence upon death, and then slowly grow to full size, returning the caster to life. The miniature statue will cost 200 to 800 gp (2d4x100), more if no sculptor is available. Once the caster is killed, the spirit flees to the statue. During a period of 20 days minus the Will Force of the caster, the statuette begins transforming into the caster's body. At the end of that time, the caster's essence is united with their new body and the caster awakes at full health. A minimum of one day is required to transform the statuette into the caster's body. This spell requires a statuette perfectly mimicking the caster, and permanently drains 1 Will Force from the caster upon death. In order to be activated, the statuette and the caster must be on the same plane. Spells such as Mind Trap or Sphere of Protection will prevent the caster's essence from reaching the statuette.

Allows the caster to cause one being who has died within one hour per Will Force point of the caster to be reincarnated in another form. Roll below for the other form and somewhere within 100 miles that person is reincarnated as an adult in the form listed. The being reincarnated must make a Will Force save or they will not be reincarnated and the caster must spend the required Will Force (1 point) normally paid by the reincarnated. the form is determined randomly by d100%. ANIMAL(SMALL): 01-10% (Birds, Rat), ANIMAL(MED.): 11-20% (Cat Dog), ANIMAL(LARGE): 21-30% (Bear, Horse), HUMANOID(SMALL): 31-40% (Midfolk), HUMANOID(MED.): 41-75% (Elf, Human), HUMANOID(LARGE): 76-95% (Ogre, Troll), SPECIAL: 96-100% Special*. Special result rolls another d100%. ANIMAL(MAGICAL) 01-33% (Griffon, Pegasus, Unicorn), HUMANOID(MAGICAL) 34-66% (Fairy, Giant, Djinn), SELF 67-100%. The caster can add +/- 2% to the above roll(s) per 2 Aura points in the spell. The Game Master will determine which forms in each category are available in their world and allow the reincarnated being some choice in choosing from among the new forms. The reincarnated being retains all Knowledge, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charm, Piety and Aura but loses 1 Will Force Point. The reincarnated being (if not reborn as self) must spend a day learning its new form (-3/-15% to everything during that time).

Creates a magical repulsion field around the caster's body. Any spells cast by anyone other than the caster are turned back on the original caster, regardless of whether the effects are positive or negative. Even large area of effect spells whose area affected touches the caster (such as Storm of Fire) are turned back onto the spell's caster, making them the center of the storm. Reflected spells are turned back by Spell Turning, but two turned spells require a check to see what effect happens.

Empowers the caster's hands with the energy to wither the next living being touched, even through normal armor. The area touched takes 1d4 damage per Aura used in the spell if a Magic Resistance fails. Even if the Resistance is made, the affected being takes one point of damage per Aura from the withering of skin and muscle in the area affected. Appearance is reduced by 1 point per 4 Aura used in any visibly damaged area. Tissues damaged by this spell take twice the normal time to heal and require twice as much magical healing. A being cannot be lowered below 5 Appearance by this spell's effects.

Causes one being to make a Control Resistance or be changed into an alignment of the caster's choosing for the duration of the spell. The caster has no other power over the victim. The spells Mind Set and Mind Change protect a being from this spell, as does the skill Thought Projection. The skills Body Control and Exorcism will remove this effect.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Dim, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sum, Tra
system.description: Allows the caster to attempt to create a being. First, the caster must prepare a body and this can be done in two ways. One way is to carefully sew together pieces from beings and animals (evil or neutral spellcasters only). The other way can create a body made of stone, wood, clay, sand, mud, etc. (The caster can then turn the body to flesh via Transmute to Flesh). Then a point system is used to design the new organism. The PP used will determine how much permanent Will Force it will cost. The caster is given 8 power points per Aura point used in casting the creation spell. See Player's Guide page 279 for more. NOTES: Additional creatures can be created without loss of Will Force provided they are of the same type. Additional creatures take 1/2 as long as the first creature to create. The being created cannot reproduce unless it is flesh and an opposite sex is created, and it still will only have a 65% chance of success (for the first breeding pair).

Causes the caster to transform into a pure Aura Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Aura Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Allows the caster to enchant one item with magical properties. This powerful spell allows the caster to literally weave spells into a permanent magical item. Magic item items can be enchanted with powers, abilities and usages. This spell uses a power point system, starting with 10 power points per Aura point used in enchantment. For more see Player's Guide pages 280-282, and/or Master's Manual pages 263-270.

Summons an Aura Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Aura Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Con, Cre, Dth, Dim, Dis, Eng, Ill, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Sum, Tra, War
system.description: This is by far the strongest spell a mortal spellcaster may cast. It basically allows the caster to state in their common language what they wish to happen and then have that come about with the following rules: 1) No Wish should create a true paradox. Examples of a paradox are two people in the same place at the same time, or an endless time loop. 2) No Wish can result in another Wish. If it is attempted, a time Loop is created and the caster will disappear to be trapped forever in the time loop. 3) A Wish can basically be used to cast any spell or combination of spells at triple the Aura Control of the spellcaster. This does not hold true for Enchantment. 4) Each Wish cast drains 1 Will Force point from the caster. 5) A Wish may harm/help no more than one being per Aura point used in the Wish. 100 Aura or more used in the spell will ignore this rule. 6) May not be used to permanently raise a being's Will Force rating. 7) All targets of the Wish are allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid the negative effects of the Wish. 8) In the statement of the wish, no more than one sentence can be used to utter the wish. That sentence may have no more than two of any of these connecting words: “if”, “and”, “or”, “nor” and “but”. If any wish has more than that, the wish will be accurate up until the point the third connecting word was used. 9) The GM decides upon all outcomes of wishes and their word is final. A Wish will bring someone back from the dead or counter a spell or curse. A GM should never allow a Wish to do serious harm to their world. There should be no limit to the number of different uses of this spell.

Allows one being or object to pass through dirt, earth, and non-hardened sediment as if passing through water. Stone and other harder substances remain rigid to the being. Items with less than neutral buoyancy will sink until they encounter the first hard substance.

Creates a frosty, windy, semi-transparent column in a 3' radius from the caster, starting 6“ off of the ground and extending upwards to 10', with a 1“ perimiter. The circle has the following effects: 1) Anything touching the circle must make a Magic Resistance once per contact or suffer 1d4 per 4 Aura of the spell. Damage is only assessed once per 5 sec. per being/object. 2) All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit and have damage reduced by 1/2 before striking the target. 3) All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and lose 1 point per damage die rolled. 4) View is partially obstructed causing -2 initiative rolls for the caster. 5) Fire based spells cast through the column are reduced to 1/2 due to the frosty nature of the cold. 6) The frost remains trapped magically within the column and does not leave this area of effect regardless of circumstance. 7) Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause a temporary disappearance of that portion of the frost column. No other circle spell may be created while this circle is in effect.

Creates a fiery, windy, semi-transparent column in a 3' radius from the caster, starting 6“ off of the ground and extending upwards to 10', with a 1“ perimiter. The circle has the following effects: 1) Anything touching the circle must make a Magic Resistance once per contact or suffer 1d6 per 4 Aura of the spell. Damage is only assessed once per 5 sec. per being/object. 2) All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit and have damage reduced by 1/2 before striking the target. 3) All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and lose 1 point per damage die rolled. 4) View is partially obstructed causing -2 initiative rolls for the caster. 5) Cold based spells cast through the column are reduced to 1/2 due to the heat nature of the fire. 6) The fire remains trapped magically within the column and does not leave this area of effect regardless of circumstance. 7) Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause a temporary disappearance of that portion of the fire column. No other circle spell may be created while this circle is in effect.

Creates an invisible marker that allows the spell caster to use the spell Teleport to teleport directly back to this marker with a 100% chance of success, even if the Teleport spell is cast with only one Aura point. This marker can be seen with Detect Invisibility but its invisibility cannot be dispelled. Only one Recall Buoy can be in existence per caster. This spell does not grant the power to teleport it merely aids such power.

Allows the caster to close their visual sensing ability, then feel the movement of beings and objects around them within the area of effect. Truly stationary objects are not “seen” by this effect. If the caster opens their eyes, the spell duration ends immediately. Slight movement of small objects or extremely slow movement requires an lntelligence save to detect. Neither lnvisibility nor Non-Detection is proof against this spell. Only Vanish works against this spell's effects.

Creates a static-filled, windy, semi-transparent column in a 3' radius from the caster, starting 6“ off of the ground and extending upwards to 10', with a 1“ perimiter. The circle has the following effects: 1) Anything touching the circle must make a Magic Resistance once per contact or suffer 1d8 per 4 Aura of the spell. Damage is only assessed once per 5 sec. per being/object. 2) All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit and have damage reduced by 1/2 before striking the target. 3) All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and lose 1 point per damage die rolled. 4) View is partially obstructed causing -2 initiative rolls for the caster. 5) Cold based spells cast through the column are reduced to 1/2 due to the conductance of the electricity. 6) The electricity remains trapped magically within the column and does not leave this area of effect regardless of circumstance. 7) Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause a temporary disappearance of that portion of the electrical column. No other circle spell may be created while this circle is in effect.

Creates an invisible marker that grants the spell caster the ability to teleport directly back to the Teleport Buoy in 1 second, by thought, with a 100% success rate, without casting any spell, merely by using 1 Aura. This marker can be seen with Detect Invisibility but its invisibility cannot be dispelled. Only one Teleport Buoy can be in existence per Title of the spellcaster. This spell grants the power to teleport without the spell Teleport.

Allows the caster to close their visual sensing ability, then feel the movement of beings and objects around them within the area of effect without concentration. Truly stationary objects are not “seen” by this effect. Slight movement of small objects or extremely slow movement requires an lntelligence save to detect. Neither lnvisibility nor Non-Detection is proof against this spell. Only Vanish works against this spell's effects.

Creates an acidic, splashy, semi-transparent column in a 3' radius from the caster, starting 6“ off of the ground and extending upwards to 10', with a 1“ perimiter. The circle has the following effects: 1) Anything touching the circle must make a Magic Resistance once per contact or suffer 1d10 per 4 Aura of the spell. Damage is only assessed once per 5 sec. per being/object. 2) All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit and have damage reduced by 1/2 before striking the target. 3) All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and lose 1 point per damage die rolled. 4) View is partially obstructed causing -2 initiative rolls for the caster. 5) Fire based spells cast through the column are reduced to 1/2 due to the liquid nature of the acid. 6) The acid remains trapped magically within the column and does not leave this area of effect regardless of circumstance. 7) Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause a temporary disappearance of that portion of the acid column. No other circle spell may be created while this circle is in effect.

Creates a smoky, ruin of semi-transparent, negative energy in a column with a 3' radius from the caster, starting 6“ off of the ground and extending upwards to 10', with a 1“ perimiter. The circle has the following effects: 1) Anything touching the circle must make a Control Resistance once per contact or age 1/20th of the being's lifetime. Aging is only assessed once per 5 sec. per being. 2) All missile weapons fired into or out of the circle are at -4 to hit and have damage reduced by 1/2 before striking the target. 3) All melee attacks into or out of the circle are at -2 to hit and lose 1 point per damage die rolled. 4) View is partially obstructed causing -2 initiative rolls for the caster. 5) Healing effects through the column are reduced to 1/2 due to the negative energy. 6) The negative energy remains trapped magically within the column and does not leave this area of effect regardless of circumstance. 7) Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause a temporary disappearance of that portion of the deterioration column. No other circle spell may be created while this circle is in effect.

Creates a thin energy column with a 3' radius from the caster, starting 6“ off of the ground and extending upwards to 10', with a 1“ perimiter. The circle has the following effects: 1) Anything touching the circle must make a Magic Resistance once per contact or fall paralyzed for 1 min. Paralysis is only assessed once per 5 sec. per being. 2) Large objects (structures) that obstruct the circle merely cause a temporary disappearance of that portion of the paralysis column. No other circle spell may be created while this circle is in effect.

Creates a weapon of the caster's choice out of force material. It appears in the caster's hands and can be used by anyone for the duration of the spell. The force weapon is indestructible. It is +1 to hit and damage per 5 Aura used in the spell (+6 maximum). In addition, the spell has the properties of sharpness, accuracy, piercing and/or disruption (whichever would be applicable to the weapon type created). The weapon can be nullified with Dispel Magic or Disintegrate. Only one of these weapons can be created by a caster at a time. The force weapon can be made permanent with the spell Permanency for 2 Will Force points.

Protects an existing magic or divine item from outside influences. This is one of the few spells that can be cast on an existing magic or divine item. It grants the following effects: 1) The magic item now cannot be drained of Aura or lowered in Piety Level if divine. 2) Powers cannot be moved off of the item with skills like, Wood Lore, Empower, etc. 3) Dispel Magic and Dispel Divinity have 0% chance of destroying the item until this spell is dispelled. This effect can also be used during the construction of the magic or divine item at no additional Will Force cost.

In addition to normal eyesight, this spell allows the caster to see beings or objects move around them even if they are concealed by Invisibility, obstructing light cover (brush, etc.) or just hidden in shadows. Slight movement of small objects or extremely slow movement requires an Intelligence save to detect. Neither Invisibility nor Non-Detection is proof against this spell. Only Vanish works against this spell's effects.

This powerful spell makes the caster seem to vanish into thin air. They cannot be detected by any sense, magical or otherwise, including sight, hearing, heat patterns, odor, life sense, air movement, mental contact, detection effects, etc. To those with magical tracking abilities the caster has simply ceased to exist. This spell counts as Non-Detection as well. The effect lasts until the end of the duration or until the caster takes any form of hostile action. Detect Protection is the only effect that detects the caster and only detects that Vanish is in use.

Allows up to 4 objects per Aura point used in the spell to be moved as the Cantrip move but collectively. No single object can weigh more than 20 lb. per Aura point used in the spell. All the objects move as one. They can be moved into a pattern by making an Intelligence save -20% for complex patterns. If objects are released at the end of 10 seconds, new objects can be made to move. Failure indicates that some control was lost and the pattern was lost for at least the next 10 seconds. This spell has no effect on magical objects.

In order to cast this spell, the caster must be in a meditative state relatively free from danger. This spell causes the caster to be sent forward or backward in time. If the caster goes backward in time they will go back as a shade (ghost of the future) and will be able to return at any time. The caster's shade form may be able to alter the future, but this is up to individual GM's discretion. lf the caster goes forward in time, they will be actually sent forward in time, in body and with all carried possessions. There is, however, no return to the past, except as a time ghost. The maximum time travelled varies by the Aura used in the spell.

Changes the caster's eyes so that they see only the true forms. The caster can now see through illusions, glamours, invisibility, masked Aura, etc. Non-Detection protects the person, place or thing from being seen through by the spell caster. An invisible assassin with Non-Detection is still invisible to the caster.

Creates a perfect duplicate of any item, magical or otherwise. If the item is not permanent, then the duration is one day. To make the item permanent, the original Will Force cost necessary to create the item must be spent. Items that are non-magical or require no Will Force to make cost 1 Will Force to make permanent. Artifacts cannot be duplicated in this fashion.

Allows the caster to create a large number of objects at once. Each Aura placed in this spell is equivalent to casting 1 produce type spell (Fire, Fog, Food, Light, Metal, Shelter, Smoke, Stone, Water, or Wood, etc.) at the full Aura of the Mass Produce spell. The caster is not required to actually possess or have memorized any of these produce spells. Produce Poison is excluded for use with this spell. All objects created through the use of this spell can be made permanent at the cost of 1/10th of a Will Force per Aura spent on the spell.

Causes 1 being per Aura used in the spell to change into a statue, or a large rock of equal to their original mass at the caster's discretion. A Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the effects of this spell if so desired. If statue form is chosen, it is not required to resemble the original being-just be roughly the same size. If the caster desires the statues to appear as the original beings, they do. The beings inside do not age, and they are asleep. The invocation Awaken will cause them to stir for a day though they can only be contacted mentally during this time. The beings do not age or suffer harmful effects while in the Stone Sleep. The effect can be reversed in a limited number of ways. A Dispel Magic can be cast on any of the stones, freeing that individual if successful. Transmute to Flesh will work if the statue form was chosen and the beings retain their original form, otherwise the being dies when the rock or misshapen being becomes solid flesh. Unlike other permanent spell effects, if the caster dies, all those they has cast this spell on return to their true form and awaken. A further casting of Permanency will make this effect permanent without additional Will Force cost.
Grants the power of independent flight (per the Fly spell) to any individuals selected by the caster within range.

Causes all individuals selected by the caster within range to become invisible. They are treated as separate individuals for purposes of when they become visible by choice or offensive action. As with normal invisibility these beings are invisible to each other.

Allows the caster to actively effect the next morale check (within 1 hour) or allow a new roll for one that has just been rolled (last minute). The effect extends only to those beings who can see the spellcaster. Each of those beings is afforded a +/-5% to morale per 2 Aura used, depending on the declaration of the caster. Distinctions can also be made between friends or foes. Either foes could be forced to make a morale check or flee, or friends could obtain a bonus to continue fighting, but not both in the same casting. Only non-player beings roll morale checks.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost their personal attributes (all except Social Class) by draining them from another being. For every 6 Aura put into the spell, all personal attributes (but Social Class) of the caster are increased by 1 while all personal attributes (but Social Class) of the target are reduced by 1. If the caster designates a single personal attribute (Appearance or Charm) to be stolen, then for every 4 Aura put into the spell, that attribute of the caster is increased by 1 while that attribute of the target is reduced by 1. Attributes points fade from the caster immediately at duration's end, but are restored to the target at the rate of 1 per hour. Multiple castings of this spell are cumulative.

Causes 2 beings per Aura or object to come from anywhere if their true or given name, in its entirety, is spoken aloud by the caster. The summoned being will appear within 2' per Aura of the caster. Summoned beings are free to do as they please, but they must listen to the caster for at least one minute. The being will stay (on the same plane) for one day per Aura point, unless it has been brought to its native plane, in which case it will stay permanently. A Circle of Power can keep summoned creatures at bay (see Circles of Power at the beginning of this section). A Dispel Magic cast on a summoned being will return the being if it was summoned from another plane. Summon will not work on beings with 19 or greater average in personal attributes who wish to avoid being summoned.

Creates a continuous firestorm causing the following effects every 10 seconds from the fire and fury of the maelstrom: 1) 4d6 random areas take 1d6 per 2 Aura used in the spell. A successful Magic Resistance reduces the damage taken in each area by half. 2) All flammable objects on the being immediately burst into flame and will be consumed as with a normal fire. 3) Magical wooden objects and magical paper must make a Magic Resistance or burst into flames and be consumed. 4) All beings must make an Agility save at -3% per Aura in the spell or fall to the ground. 5) Combat of any kind is impossible within the storm. Beings immune to fire, or with the spell or power Endure Heat, are immune to the damage effects of this spell, as are their items. Repulsion provides some protection removing half damage and reducing the Agility save modifier by half. Invulnerability will protect againt the Agility save.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost their mental attributes by draining them from another being. For every 7 Aura put into the spell, all mental attributes of the caster are increased by 1 while all mental attributes of the target are reduced by 1. If the caster designates a single mental attribute (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Knowledge) to be stolen, then for every 5 Aura put into the spell, that attribute of the caster is increased by 1 while that attribute of the target is reduced by 1. Attributes points fade from the caster immediately at duration's end, but are restored to the target at the rate of 1 per hour. Multiple castings of this spell are cumulative.

Causes one person or object to be transformed from one substance or substances into another. The object can be no larger than 1 cubic foot per Aura. The substance transmuted to cannot be precious or magical. Beings are allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid the effects of this spell. The shape of the object or being may be changed as well but the mass remains the same. Beings can be returned to normal form by Dispel Magic or Transmute to Flesh or a further casting of Transmutation, provided the object transmuted into is still intact. Complex objects can be created this way.

Each casting creates 5 tokens or badges per Aura point used in the spell after a 1 hour casting. These tokens are meant to be carried by followers or members of an army or faction. A second, 1 minute casting of Call Army makes all who carry the badge be teleported to the caster. The spell caster can also cast Geas at the completion of the creation of the badges and it will cause a mission to be imprinted on the whoever holds the badges. The mission can be activated/deactivated by a 1 minute casting of Call Army.

Allows the caster and one individual per Aura used in the spell to be relocated as the spell Teleport with 100% success. The relocation can be another plane if Phase or Plane Shift is cast first. The area must have been viewed well at least once by the caster. Individuals will appear in roughly the same distance and location from the caster as before the Relocation. If an object is in the way the being will be displaced until safe.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost their physical attributes by draining them from another being. For every 8 Aura put into the spell, all physical attributes of the caster are increased by 1 while all physical attributes of the target are reduced by 1. If the caster designates a single physical attribute (Strength, Agility, or Vitality) to be stolen, then for every 6 Aura put into the spell, that attribute of the caster is increased by 1 while that attribute of the target is reduced by 1. Attributes points fade from the caster immediately at duration's end, but are restored to the target at the rate of 1 per hour. Multiple castings of this spell are cumulative.

Allows the caster to change one being per Aura into another being or animal. Essentially, this spell is a mass version of the Change Other spell and is used accordingly. It takes 4 Aura for each move away from the lowest Endurance being in the group. END (1-3): Rat/Bird. END (1-9): Dog/Pixie. END (1-19): Pony/Human. END (11-29): Horse/Grahl. END (11-49): Tiger/Ogre. END (26-74): Ox/Small Giant. END (51-99): Rhino/Giant. END (51-149): Elephant/Large Giant. END (101-199): Small Dragon. END (101-299): Dragon. END (201-599): Large Dragon. There can be distinguishing marks or slight variations between the creatures changed into but they must be of essentially the same type. The caster can change individuals back or all at once at a whim. The caster can change themselves as one of the beings. The mental and magical powers of the being or animal type are not available to the changed beings.

Causes 10 cubic feet per Aura used in the spell to be protected per the effects shown below. Area of effect must be a continuous area. 1) All friends are +1 to hit and damage per 5 Aura used in the spell. 2) All friends are +5% to resistances and saves per 5 Aura used. 3) All foes are -1 to hit and -1 damage per dice rolled regardless of source. 4) All foes save and make resistances at -5% per Aura in the spell. 5) Area acts as a Bane area against either evil or good depending on the caster's whim (See Spell or Invocation Bane). 6) Area acts as Warding against 1 type of creature per 5 Aura used in the spell. 7) All foes must make a Will Force save to start attacking in the area of effect. 8) Area protected can be permanent at a cost of l Will Force point.

Allows the caster to temporarily boost their mystical attributes by draining them from another being. For every 9 Aura put into the spell, all mystical attributes of the caster are increased by 1 while all mystical attributes of the target are reduced by 1. If the caster designates a single mystical attribute (Aura, Piety, or Will Force) to be stolen, then for every 7 Aura put into the spell, that attribute of the caster is increased by 1 while that attribute of the target is reduced by 1. Attributes points fade from the caster immediately at duration's end, but are restored to the target at the rate of 1 per hour. Multiple castings of this spell are cumulative.

Allows the caster to touch up to 1 person per 4 Aura. Each of these beings will be affected by any spells or powers, which affect the caster. This is an entirely one way process. The caster is unaffected by powers, feelings, damage, etc. that affect the beings touched. There is one catch; any damage or negative effect that the caster fails to avoid are distributed to the beings as well. If the caster is killed, then all of the affected beings must make a Will Force save to avoid being slain themselves. The being cannot distribute divine effects, such as the skill healing. Touch does not have to be maintained after the spell is cast.

Grants the caster complete immunity to all invocations, powers of divine magic items and divine skills. This cuts both ways as even the positive effects of divinity cannot be used or activated on/by the caster. On a deity's home plane this spell is ineffective against that deity.

Grants the caster complete immunity to all spells, powers of magic magic items and magical skills. This cuts both ways as even the positive effects of magic cannot be used or activated on/by the caster.

Grants the ability for the caster to actually move themselves or an object through time. Each casting of the spell drains 1 Will Force regardless of the distance travelled. Distance travelled is equal to the spell Time Shift but the effect is permanent. The maximum time travelled varies by the Aura used in the spell.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Con, Cre, Dth, Dim, Dis, Eng, Ill, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Sum, Tra, War
system.description: The mighty destructive power of a cataclysm appears in many forms; a great comet or asteroid that shatters a continent. A great heat that destroys most forms of life, earthquakes and upheaval of the lands, mighty floods, perhaps all of these things. All that matters is when a cataclysm is complete 70-90% of life is destroyed: civilizations fall, the landscape is remade and life must begin again. No more than 1/2 of one hemisphere of a world will ever be destroyed by a cataclysm. For every 10 Aura of the spell the cataclysm lasts 1 week and the land will be mostly uninhabitable for 100 years per 10 Aura after this time. Some small amount of life will survive (but just barely) as the land recovers from this mighty magic. When this spell is cast, 5 Will Force are immediately and permanently drained from the caster.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Con, Cre, Dth, Dim, Dis, Eng, Ill, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Sum, Tra, War
system.description: The great wheel of creation occasionally needs a little or a lot of urging. With this spell, the power of life is released on a continent or area previously devastated, devoid of life or sparsely populated. The area flowers with new life. Fertility and positive mutation of species advances at an unbelievable rate creating many new species of life per day each a little better than the previous. Within a week's time the landscape supports a wide variety of flora and is 30% wetter than it was before. Within a month's time the area has insects and primitive fish in the lakes, rivers and nearby oceans. Within two months flora is abundant the climate is 50% wetter than original and larger life forms are beginning to walk on land. After three months a dominate form of life begins to appear, at four months that dominate life form has forms that fly, climb, run, eat flora, insects, each other and combinations thereof. In five months 1-4 weaker but more adaptable forms appear. After six months and the climate begins to settle and the area dries out approximately 10% and reaches its final average temperature. One of the more adaptable forms is beginning to beat the dominating species because of the ability to eat different foods, survive different climates, organize, etc. In seven months the stronger versions of the dominate forms vanish and are replaced by the new dominate adaptable species. At eight months the new dominate group begins to get organized and work in concert. In nine months the rudiments of tool use and language appear. By ten months the dominate form drives out all other competing similar types. At eleven months breeding becomes slower  and knowledge begins to be passed from generation to generation. Finally, in one year's time the first villages are forming and the culture begins. The magical innuence releases the area and life slows to normal. The spell lasts 2 months per 5 Aura used in the spell and guarantees survival for the new dominate life form for 100 years per 10 Aura used in the spell. During this time, the area will adapt for this life form if they are in trouble for any reason. The initial area of genesis is no more than 1/4 of one hemisphere. When this spell is cast, 5 Will Force are immediately and permanently from the caster.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Con, Cre, Dth, Dim, Dis, Eng, Ill, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Sum, Tra, War
system.description: Allow the immortal caster to alter the very fabric of reality. Any one change can be made permanently and even retroactively. When this spell is cast 5 WIL are immediately and permanently drained from the caster. As such it is one of the most dangerous spells that exists. It is typically used by deities or anifacts to change the nature of reality. Under the current meta reality it is impossible save Wish to even get to 100 Aura Control as even an immortal caster. There are few actual limits, physical, and metaphysical laws cannot be altered, the universe cannot be destroyed, nor another created by casting this spell.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Con, Cre, Dth, Dim, Dis, Eng, Ill, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Sum, Tra, War
system.description: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE! THESE WORDS WERE NOT MEANT FOR YOU. DO NOT PUT THIS IN YOUR SILLY BOOK!...All things, good or bad, must have an ending. In the winking of an eye so finishes the universe and all its peoples, places, deities, etc. The end. Fini.

system.spellTypes: Alt, Con, Cre, Dth, Dim, Dis, Eng, Ill, Lif, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Sum, Tra, War
system.description: HOW DARE YOU! THIS POWER IS BEYOND YOU. THESE WORDS WERE NOT MEANT FOR YOU. DO NOT PUT THIS IN YOUR SILLY BOOK!...A spark, the opening of a new universe. Soon on a distant universe a strange sun shines on a world and the first creatures cavort beneath. A single being looks across the vastness of reality and calls it a good start.

Masks all odors given off by a being and carried possessions, or if cast on a single object, that object's smell is masked. Alternately, it could be used to change the odor given off by a particular being to something completely different. No trace of the object's true odor is left behind. It is completely masked by this spell.

Causes one being or object to appear visually equal in apparent temperature to the air around it. The being or object is thus undetectable to infravision. Alternately, a different heat could be set to be given off, ice cold or very hot, etc. The object's true temperature is not altered in anyway. When this spell is cast on very hot objects, whose heat would be visible even to the naked eye, this heat is masked to sight only. The object or being will still feel very hot.
Protects the user from being attacked by plants. Sapient plants are allowed a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the protected being. The spell has no effect versus magical plants.
Dismisses a bound familiar (bound by the spell Bind Familiar), returning the sacrificed Will Force point used in that spell. May only be cast on the caster's own familiar.

Causes one plant, sapient plant or magical plant to be held immobile for the duration of the effect. The plant is allowed a new Control Resistance at the end of each resolution stage to break free. Only sapient and magical plants are allowed a Control Resistance to avoid the effects.
Protects the user from being attacked by animals. Sapient animals are allowed a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the protected being. The spell has no effect versus magical animals.

Calls an animal or magical animal and transforms it temporarily into a familiar. An animal drawn randomly from within one mile of caster per Aura point and comes immediately to the caster. At 10 or higher a specific animal type can be called (if it exists in the area of effect.) At 15 or higher Aura an individual, known, animal can be called as a familiar. The animal can weigh no more than 5 pounds per Aura used in the spell. While the spell is in effect, the familiar desires to be in the presence of the caster and has a strong affinity for the caster at all times. Besides the animal's natural abilities, additional abilities are gained when the animal becomes a familiar. FAMILIAR: END x2, RESISTS: equal caster, MENTAL: equal caster, POWERS: Magic Voice, Message (x3 day), Telepathy (with caster), Summon (animal's type, 1x day). CASTER: END (+1 per 10 lb. of animal), SENSE: 1 is enhanced per 5 Aura, ABILITIES: 1 natural ability of the animal per 4 Aura. A caster can never have more than one familiar at a time. If the familiar is killed, the caster loses one point of Will Force permanently. The caster must make a Vitality save or lose 1d4 Endurance permanently. The caster also makes a Vitality save to avoid a heart attack.

Cause one animal, sapient animal or magical animal to be held motionless for the duration of the spell. The animal is allowed a new Control Resistance at the end of each Resolution stage to break free. Only magical and sapient animals are allowed a Control Resistance.

Protects the user from being attacked by creatures of type slime. Protection level is by Aura used in the spell. AUR 7 (Level 1 Slimes), AUR 9 (Level 2 Slimes), AUR 11 (Level 3 Slimes), AUR 13 (Level 4 Slimes), AUR 15 (Level 5 Slimes), AUR 17 (Level 6 Slimes), AUR 19 (Level 7 Slimes), AUR 20 (Level 8 Slimes). Greater slimes (levels 5 through 8) are allowed a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the protected being. The caster is protected from slimes of an equal to and lesser level that the Aura in the spell grants. The spell has no effect versus arch slimes (9+ level).
Protects the user from being attacked by creatures of type magical plant. Magical plants must make a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the protected being.

Causes one slime to follow the commands of the caster for the duration of the spell.  This spell will also work on plants, insects, and creatures which are driven by instinct (no greater than a 1 rating in mental attributes). The spell will not work if the slime is sapient. This spell does not grant the slime powers which it does not already possess. Control is absolute and the being will do whatever is ordered to the best of its capabilities.

Protects the user from being attacked by creatures of type Humanoid.  Sapient Humanoids are allowed a Control Resistance each time they wish to attack the protected being. The spell has no effect versus Magical Humanoids.

Calls an animal or magical animal and transforms it permanently into a familiar at the cost of 1 Will Force. An animal drawn randomly from within one mile of caster per Aura point and comes immediately to the caster. At 10 or higher a specific animal type can be called (if it exists in the area of effect.) At 15 or higher Aura an individual, known, animal can be called as a familiar. The animal can weigh no more than 5 pounds per Aura used in the spell. While the spell is in effect, the familiar desires to be in the presence of the caster and has a strong affinity for the caster at all times. Besides the animal's natural abilities, additional abilities are gained when the animal becomes a familiar. FAMILIAR: END x2, RESISTS: equal caster, MENTAL: equal caster, POWERS: Magic Voice, Message (x3 day), Telepathy (with caster), Summon (animal's type, 1x day). CASTER: END (+1 per 10 lb. of animal), SENSE: 1 is enhanced per 5 Aura, ABILITIES: 1 natural ability of the animal per 4 Aura. A caster can never have more than one familiar at a time. If the familiar is killed, the caster loses one point of Will Force permanently. The caster must make a Vitality save or lose 1d4+2 Endurance permanently. The caster also makes a Vitality save to avoid a heart attack.

Causes one humanoid or magical humanoid to make a Control Resistance or be held in place for the duration of the spell. The being is allowed a new Control Resistance at the end of each resolution stage to break free.

Causes one magical plant to follow the commands of the caster for the duration of the spell. This spell will also work on plants, insects, and creatures which are driven by instinct (no greater than a 1 rating in mental attributes), and these creatures are not allowed a Control Resistance. Control is absolute and the magical plant will do whatever is ordered to the best of its abilities.
Protects the user from being attacked by creatures of type magical animal. Magical animals must make a Control Resistance every time they wish to attack the protected being.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one magical animal. This spell will also affect normal animals, and they will get no Control Resistance. If an animal is already controlled, a contest of magics must be won to gain control of the magical animal.
Protects the user from being attacked by magical humanoids. Magical humanoids must make a Control Resistance every time they wish to attack the protected being.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one magical humanoid creature if it fails its Control Resistance. The controlled being will obey all suggestions, except those that are unduly dangerous or would go against the being's alignment.  If the controlled being is asked to obey one of these suggestions, it will get a new Control Resistance. This spell will also work on normal humanoids who fail a Control Resistance. If a magical humanoid is already controlled, a contest of magics must be won to gain control of the magical humanoid.

Causes the hands of the caster to be charged with a dark, cold energy. The next being touched must make a Magic Resistance or temporarily lose 1 Will Force point per 5 Aura and take 1d4 cold damage per 2 Aura to the body area touched.

Prevents a being from casting a shadow. Without actually altering any light sources, the caster creates a thin magical film around the target, allowing light to pass through and therefore cancel any shadow effects.

Causes the hands of the caster to be charged with a dark, cold energy. The next being touched must make a Magic Resistance or temporarily lose 1 Will Force point per 4 Aura and take 3d4 cold damage per 2 Aura to the body area touched.
Causes a being to be unable to sense life force, whether positive or negative, in any fashion.

Creates 1 section per Aura of a 10' x 10' wall composed of darkness. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall will appear, that section does not appear. Beings cannot see through the wall. This spell can only be destroyed by the caster or Dispel Magic.

Creates 1 section per Aura of a 10' x 10' wall composed of light. If any being is standing within the area where a section of the wall will appear, that section does not appear. Beings cannot see through the wall. The light is incapable of blinding, and each section illuminates up to 40' away on each side. This spell can only be destroyed by the caster or Dispel Magic.

Causes the hands of the caster to be charged with a putrid, greenish energy. The next being touched must make a Magic Resistance or succumb to the Ghoulism disease. Ghoulism is a cursed disease of the muscles that causes tightening and elongation of the muscles in the body. MILD: (01-50%): 3d4 days. -1d4 Strength and Agility for duration. SERIOUS: (51-75%): 5d4 days. -1d4 Strength and Agility permanently. TERMINAL: (76-00%): 2d4 weeks. Lose 1 Strength, Agility and Vitality  per day until dead. CURE: Submersion in holy water for 6 hours once per day for 30 days, and Cure Disease. REOCURRENCE: 20% chance every 2-7 months.

Allows the caster to work with, mold, and shape existing light. The caster can either move light from one place to another, or spread and concentrate the existing brightness. The light can be expanded by a rate of 25% per 5 Aura with a maximum of 100%, or be concentrated at a rate of 10% per 2 Aura down to a minimum of 10% its original size. A separate casting is required for each manipulation effect. If the light is concentrated into an area 50% of its original size, the brightness is considered to be a sphere of magical light, as per the spell Produce Light. If the light is concentrated into an area 10% of its original size, it is considered to be an area of Brilliance; all beings looking at the light must make a Magic Resistance or be blinded for 1 hour per Aura used in the spell, and there is a 1% chance per Aura that the blindness will be permanent (those with Enhanced Sight or Night Vision suffer double the effects). This spell does not affect shadows or light which is already magical or divine magical in nature, nor does it affect any heat or lack thereof generated by the existing light source.

Allows the caster to work with, mold, and shape existing shadows. The caster can either move shadows from one place to another, or spread and concentrate the existing darkness. The darkness can be expanded by a rate of 25% per 5 Aura with a maximum of 100%, or be concentrated at a rate of 10% per 2 Aura down to a minimum of 10% its original size. A separate casting is required for each manipulation effect. If the shadows are concentrated into an area 50% of its original size, the darkness is considered to be a sphere of Darkness, as per the spell. If the shadows are concentrated into an area 10% of its original size, the darkness is considered to be an area of True Night, as per the invocation. This spell does not affect shadows or light which is already magical or divine magical in nature, nor does it affect any chill generated by the existing shadows.

Allows the caster to discern the source of control on a target being. The caster is informed of the controller's basic characteristics (such as race, creature type, or class), as well as knowing in which general direction of the controller. The caster can also discern what the target has been controlled to do and for how long the control has been in effect. This spell does not provide the caster with the name of the controller.

Causes the hands of the caster to be charged with a strong blood-red glow. The next being touched must make a Magic Resistance or temporarily lose 1 Will Force point per 7 Aura and lose 3d6 per 5 Aura overall Endurance, similar to the effect of blood loss, although the victim does not actually lose any blood.

Causes a weapon to have a chance of passing through one Protection type spell (type War) or Warding effect (such as Reflection) on its target per 5 Aura. The target is allowed a separate Magic Resistance for each Protection or Warding effect. Success indicates that the weapon is affected by the protection as it would normally be. Failure signifies a breach in the magical defense, allowing the weapon to pass through unhindered. The protections subverted by this spell are so affected in the reverse order in which they were created. Protections affected by Avoid Protection do not dissipate; they are only passed through and remain in full effect for any future attacks. This spell has no effect on protections of a Divine nature.

system.spellTypes: Cre, Meta, Min, Nat, Sen, Tra
system.description: Provides the caster with a magical map of the underground layout below. As the caster walks through an above-ground area, its rough layout underneath (below the ground), is transferred to the caster's mind and then to a carried paper or book. The book, scroll or paper must never be more than 1 foot per Aura away from the caster, or the spell dissipates and the writing begins to slowly disappear. This spell detects the layout underground within a sphere of 10' per Aura from the caster, and is inscribed in a contrasting indelible magical ink, much like the spell Mystical Mapping. At the end of the spell's duration, the ink will disappear; however, it can be traced over with real ink before that time, and that ink will remain when the magical ink has faded. Any structure or object protected by magic or that is magical or divine in nature will not transfer to the map surface.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one Death Elemental if it fails its Control Resistance. If the Death Elemental is already controlled by another caster who used this spell at a higher Aura, then the new control spell fails automatically. If the amount of Aura for both spells are equivalent, then the spell works for the new caster and the previous caster loses control of the Death Elemental. Unlike some forms of control, this spell is absolute. The Elemental is controlled completely and may even be sent to its death without benefit of a second Control Resistance.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one Life Elemental if it fails its Control Resistance. If the Life Elemental is already controlled by another caster who used this spell at a higher Aura, then the new control spell fails automatically. If the amount of Aura for both spells are equivalent, then the spell works for the new caster and the previous caster loses control of the Life Elemental. Unlike some forms of control, this spell is absolute. The Elemental is controlled completely and may even be sent to its death without benefit of a second Control Resistance.

Allows the caster to place a form of illusion on a target, making the target believe that either the target has control or does not, or that they are being controlled, or are not, etc. The caster may create any form of Control illusion, but the illusion does not affect the actual control in any way.

Causes a current control effect to be reinforced, protecting it from being removed or altered. All effects that would remove or alter the control have a 5% per 2 Aura Control of the caster chance of failure, with a maximum of 99%. The duration of the original control is now equal to the duration of the reinforcement.

Allows the caster to take over control of a controlled being, adding an Illusion of Control on the previous controller. The previous controller still believes they are in control, and must make an Illusion Resistance to recognize that they are not. Once the duration of the Commandeer spell ends, the controlled being must make a new Control Resistance or is controlled again by the previous controller; otherwise, the control ends.

Causes a target's shadow to be attackable, and all damage done to the shadow is directly applied to the target in the matching body area. Since the target's shadow is cast upon a surface, that surface also takes damage from all attacks. If the target's shadow is cast upon the ground and stationary, it is considered to be prone, affording the attacker +6 to hit and twice the normal amount of damage.

Causes the caster to transform into a Death Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Death Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Causes the caster to transform into a Life Elemental form of a strength matching the Aura used in the spell. All normal items carried or stored on the caster temporarily disappear along with the caster's original body. All magical items and goods simply drop to the ground. When the spell ends, the caster reverts to normal form retaining all injuries received while in Elemental Life Form. If the caster dies in Elemental form the corpse reverts back to normal form.

Summons a Death Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Death Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Summons a Life Elemental of a strength and capability that depends on the Aura used in the spell. The Life Elemental is not automatically under the control of the caster. At the end of the spell duration or if the elemental takes lethal damage, it returns to its home plane.

Causes a weapon to automatically ignore 1 Protection type spell (type War) or Warding effect (such as Reflection) on its target per 6 Aura. The protections ignored by this spell are done so in the reverse order in which they were created. Protections affected by Ignore Protection do not dissipate; they are only passed through and remain in full effect for any future attacks. Weapons imbued with this spell may pass through protections of a Divine nature if the caster is successful in a contest of Piety against the invoker of the Divine protection.

Binds the caster's Soul to an object with at least one smooth, shiny surface.
