This spell takes 1 day to complete, during which the caster sacrifices a total of 3 Will Force points (2 in order to bind his Soul to an object, and 1 to make the effect permament). Once the casting is complete, the caster dies and rises as an undead being (i.e. liche). The caster's Soul may leave the phylactery and enter the physical body, but if the physical body is ever destroyed, the caster's Soul will flee back into the phylactery. The body will reform from even the smallest mote of dust that remains in 30 days minus 1 day per Will Force. Should the phylactery be destroyed, the undead caster will continue to exist until its physical form has been defeated.

Creates a bolt of negative life force with the following effects: 1) If the target is a living or a positive life force creature, it must make a Magic Resistance at -1% per Aura or be slain. If the save is made, the target will take 2d4 magical damage per 2 Aura to 1d4 body areas. 2) If the target is an undead or a negative life force being, 2d4 points per 2 Aura are healed to the targeted body area as well as 1d4 adjacent areas. 3) If this spell slays a living target, there is a 5% chance per 2 Aura that they will rise as an appropriate undead of the Game Master's choice. The target may resist this with a Will Force save at -2% per Aura used in the spell.

Creates a bolt of positive life force with the following effects: 1) If the target is a undead or a negative life force creature, it must make a Magic Resistance at -1% per Aura or be destroyed. If the save is made, the target will take 2d4 magical damage per 2 Aura to 1d4 body areas. 2) If the target is an living or a positive life force being, 2d4 points per 2 Aura are healed to the targeted body area as well as 1d4 adjacent areas. 3) If the target is a being that died in the last 1 minute per Aura, then the being may make a Half Will Force save to be ressurected. Even if this roll is failed, if one of the skills Resurrection, Recover, or True Recovery is begun on the deceased within 1 minute per 2 Aura, the being may make a new Will Force save with a bonus of +1% per 2 Aura used in the spell to be resurrected. If the target is resurrected by this spell, the caster and/or the resurrected being must temporarily contribute a total of 2 Will Force.

Creates a storm of negative life energy with the following effects: 1) All targeted living or positive life force beings must make a Magic Resistance at -2% per Aura or be slain. Even if the Magic Resistance is made, the being still takes 2d6 magical damage per 2 Aura to 5d4 body areas. 2) All targeted undead and negative life force beings are healed 2d6 points per 2 Aura to all body areas. 3) If this spell slays a living being, that being will rise as an undead of the Game Master's choice. The victim may resist this with a Will Force save at -4% per Aura used in the spell.

Creates a storm of positive life energy with the following effects: 1) All targeted undead and negative life force beings must make a Magic Resistance at -2% per Aura or be utterly destroyed. Even if the Magic Resistance is made, the being still takes 2d6 magical damage per Aura to 5d4 areas. 2) All targeted living beings are healed 2d6 points per 2 Aura to all areas. 3) If a targeted being has died within 1 minute per Aura used in the spell, the being may make a half Will Force save to be resurrected. Even if this roll is failed, if one of the skills Resurrection, Recover, or True Recovery is begun on the deceased within 1 minute per Aura, the being may make a new Will Force save with a bonus of 1% per Aura used in the spell to be resurrected. If a being is resurrected by this spell, the caster and/or the being must contribute a total of 2 Will Force. If multiple beings are resurrected by this spell, each being and/or the caster must contribute a total of 2 Will Force for each being resurrected with this spell.

Grants the caster the ability to detect the exact temperature of a being, object, or area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Aura. Those beings who not wishing their temperature be known are afforded a Magic Resistance.

The caster selects a tree or any large plant (over 3' feet in any dimension), places their palm upon the plant and thinks of an individual they have met or seen. They concentrate and think of a message of up to 2 words per Aura point used in the spell. When the individual imagined passes within 20 feet of a plant of that type anywhere on the same plane of existence, that person will hear the message sent in their mind as if it was spoken aloud next to their ear. No actual sound has been emitted so this cannot be overheard. There is a 25% -1% per Intelligence point of the caster that the message will be garbled and 1d4+1 words will be lost.

The caster casts this spell on the ground, ooze, rock, elemental, or plant that contains moisture and draws water from within it to the surface. The depth of that moisture can be up to 3 feet per Aura used in the spell. The amount of water produced and the effect on the object varies as shown below. The water boils forth from the object or area in a concentrated area selected by the caster. A ready container will need to be present to catch and hold the drawn water. WATER ELEMENTAL*: 2 gallons/AUR, 1d4 damage/4 AUR. EARTH(WET): 1 gallon/AUR, dries and cracks surface 3'/AUR. OOZE*: 1 gallon/AUR, 1d4 damage/4 AUR. EARTH: 1 quart/AUR, dries and cracks surface 3'/AUR. PLANT(SUCCULENT)*: 1 quart/AUR, 1d4 damage/4 AUR. ROCK(WET/LIMESTONE): 1 pint/AUR, dries and cracks surface 3'/AUR, reduces object values by half. PLANT*: 1 pint/AUR, 1d4 damage/4 AUR. ROCK: 1 cup/AUR, dries and cracks surface 3'/AUR, reduces object values by half. EARTH ELEMENTAL*: 1 cup/AUR, 1d4 damage/4 AUR. ROCK(DRY/VOLCANIC): 1/2 cup/AUR, dries and cracks surface 3'/AUR, reduces object values by half. *Elementals, oozes, and magical plants are afforded a MR to avoid the effects of this spell. If the MR is made no damage is taken and no water is produced.

Creates a static field on the caster's hand. The next being touched by the spell caster will be stunned for 1d4+1 Second per 4 Aura used in the spell unless a successful Magic Resistance is made. If used at under 4 Aura, 1-3 seconds of stunning occurs. This spell can be cast upon a metal blade (or object) for identical effects, in which case it is triggered by first contact with a target. The effect ends when the duration ends, even if nothing is touched.

The caster selects a tree or any large plant (over 3' feet in any dimension), then closes off the sense of hearing through concentration, projecting it instead through all of the trees (or large plants) of that type within the range, seeking a particular sound or voice listened for. An Intelligence save is required once per minute to locate the selected sound or voice. Sounds that emanate from people or places that are magical protected by non-detection or glamour cannot be heard.

Causes the being or object affected to pass through sand and dust as if passing through water. The affected being is not granted the ability to breathe while swimming in sand, nor are they granted immunity from the pressures encountered when swimming deeply therein.

Creates a static field on the target's Aura field. The next few target contacts (1 contact per 5 Aura) whether by touch or by being struck by a non-grounded metal object, will be stunned for 1d4+1 Second per 4 Aura used in the spell unless a successful Magic Resistance is made. if used at under 4 Aura 1-3 seconds of stunning occurs. The effect ends when the duration ends, even if nothing is touched.

Allows the caster to select an area of fog or water and cause evaporation. Fog in the area of effect is completely removed. Water is reduced in volume by one quarter in the area affected. The effect is additive, thus 4 castings would completely remove the water in the area affected. Areas, liquids, or fogs that are produced by magical or divine effects trigger a contest of magic at the Aura placed in the spell versus the Aura or Piety control of the spell or effect they are attempting to remove. Water elementals and other water based creatures take 1d4 per 4 Aura used in the spell if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Allows the caster to reach out with their mind and sense the nearest land mass greater than 100 feet in diameter within range. Areas that are magical or protected by Non-detection or Glamour cannot be detected.

The caster selects a tree or any large plant (over 3' feet in any dimension). The caster then closes their eyes and projects their vision rapidly through all of the trees (or large plants) of that type within range, seeking a particular image of a being, place, or object they are looking for. An Intelligence save is required once per minute to locate the selected sight or image. Persons, places, or things that are magical protected by Non-detection or Glamour cannot be seen.

The caster selects a tree or large plant (3 feet or more in any dimension) and plucks from it one leaf, flower petal, or fruit per 3 Aura of the spell, temporarily enchanting them with certain properties. The plant items effected in this way are connected to each other. Each bearer knows the health, distance, and direction of another bearer simply by holding the item and concentrating for 5 seconds. Beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be connected by Leaves of Marking.

The caster chooses a tree or large plant (3 feet or more in any dimension) and plucks up to one leaf, flower petal, or fruit per 3 Aura of the spell. Each becomes temporarily enchanted with certain properties becoming connected to each other. Each bearer of these gains fellowship with the other bearers, knowing the health, distance, and direction of another bearer simply by holding the item and concentrating for 5 seconds. Also, each being can concentrate (Intelligence save required) and mentally connect with another bearer. As well as receiving and projecting thoughts, they can close a sense and take in the sense of another bearer, allowing them to see, hear, smell, taste, feel, etc. what the bearer does. Beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be connected by Leaves of Fellowship.

The caster selects 1 identical small object per 3 Aura of the spell, temporarily enchanting these to connect to each other. These objects gain the following properties: each bearer knows the health, distance, and direction of another bearer simply by holding the item and concentrating. Beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be connected by Tokens of Marking.

The caster selects 1 identical small object per 3 Aura of the spell, temporarily enchanting these to connect to each other. These objects gain the following properties: each bearer knows the health, distance, and direction of another bearer simply by holding the item and concentrating. Also, each being can concentrate (Intelligence save required) and mentally connect with another bearer. As well as receiving and projecting thoughts, they can close a sense and take in the sense of another bearer, allowing them to see, hear, smell, taste, feel, etc. what the bearer does. Beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be connected by Tokens of Fellowship.

The caster selects 1 tree or any large plant (their size or larger in height). They then concentrate on a person within 10 feet per Aura of a tree or large plant of that type within 100 miles per Aura point used in the spell and then makes an Intelligence save. If the Intelligence save is made the caster has reached the being. The being then senses a magical portal, on the tree (or large plant) of the same type, has opened allowing that person and up to 1 being touching the target per 4 Aura to step through the tree or large plant and appear next to the tree (or large plant) the caster cast the original spell on. Beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be summoned by Tree Summon.

Summons an indestructible force weapon of any type that is +1 to hit per 5 Aura used in the spell (+6 maximum). May be combined with the spell Phase Weapon in successive castings. The lesser force weapon can be made permanent with the spell Permanency for 1 WIL point

Causes the being or object affected to pass through snow and ice as if passing through water. The affected being is not granted the ability to breathe while swimming in snow and ice, nor are they granted immunity from the pressures encountered when swimming deeply therein.

Allows the caster to reach out mentally, sensing ships or very large creatures on or below the surface of a body a water the caster is also on or near. Only ships and creatures over 10 feet in length or width are able to be detected. Submerged ships or creatures must be within 20 feet of the surface to be detected. Ships or creatures that are magical or protected by Non-detection or Glamour cannot be detected.

The caster selects a tree or large plant (3 feet or more in any dimension), places their palm upon the plant and thinks of an individual they have met or seen. The caster then concentrates and extends their mind outward, searching for that individual. If that individual is within 10 feet per Aura point used in the spell of a tree (or large plant) of that type the caster is able to make mental contact with the being and converse mentally as long as the being stays within range of a tree (or large plant) of that type. Persons, places, or things that are magical protected by Mind Set, Mind Change, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be contacted.

Envelops the caster's Aura in ice. In this form the caster is immune to cold as the spell Endure Cold. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d4 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Causes a magical wind to appear directly behind a ship and blow into the ship's sails. The speed of the wind can be up to 5 miles per hour per 2 Aura used in the spell. The caster can adjust the wind speed anywhere from 0 to maximum by concentrating for 10 seconds. At 20 or higher Aura the ship is also shielded from all other wind effects except the spell itself.

Allows the caster to create a token that can be placed anywhere. The form of the token is up to the caster but the object that appears as the token must be no more than an inch in diameter per Aura used. Whenever the caster wishes, they can blink to the token as long as they are within range, and there is a direct line of sight. The token will disappear after its use. If the token is not used within its duration it will simply vanish.

Creates an obscuring mist around a ship on a body of liquid. The mist extends 100 feet from the ship per 5 Aura used in the spell. Visibility is reduced to 100 feet. Ships are -8 to be hit by other ships weapons if farther than 100 feet, and -4 if at 100 feet or less. This mist can be seen through by the caster and up to 1 additional individual per 2 Aura used in the spell, as designated by the caster, aboard the ship that is targeted by the spell. Crew and passengers of the ship are also protected from weapon fire as noted above.

Each crystal wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The crystal walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but all the walls must touch another wall or be fixed onto a solid surface. As with all wall spells, any living being that is in the way of a the wall will cause that section to fail. The wall has an object threshold of 300 and an object strength of 600.

Each invisible wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The invisible walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but all the walls must touch another wall or be fixed onto a solid surface. As with all wall spells, any living being that is in the way of a the wall will cause that section to fail. The wall blocks all soundwaves hitting them from either direction. The wall is otherwise passable by physical objects and beings.

Envelops the caster's Aura in fire. In this form the caster is immune to heat as the spell Endure Heat. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d6 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Creates any sort of crystal (quartz, ice, diamond, etc.) the caster imagines in any shape the caster desires. If the caster wishes the crystal to be in the form of a fine work of art, however, they must have an appropriate skill (such as Sculpting) and make a successful skill roll. Any crystal created by this spell is magical +1/+5% per 5 Aura points used in the spell (+6 maximum). If the caster has Weapon Making or Armoring, weapons or armor may be created, respectively, if successful skill rolls are made. The crystal can have the refractive properties of any crystal of any desired known crystal type. It may as appear as having a mirrored baking and thus act as a mirror. Further if a successful Lens Making social skill roll is made the crystal can be produced as if ground to whatever shape or form as desired.

The caster selects 1 tree or any large plant (their size or larger in height). They then concentrate on a person, place or thing within 10 feet per Aura of a tree or large plant of that type and within 100 miles per Aura point used in the spell and then makes an Intelligence save. If the Intelligence save is made, the caster and up to 1 being touching her per 4 Aura used in the spell can step through the tree or large plant and appear out of the closest tree (or large plant) of that type within 10 feet per Aura of the desired person, place or thing. Persons, places, or things that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be tree walked to.
Causes the being or object to become immune to the effects of pressure in water and lava, and also grants the effects of the spells Endure Heat, Endure Cold, and Breathless.

Causes the next normal non-magical object stuck hard (1+ point of damage rolled) by the caster to be broken into two or more pieces. This effect destroys the object rendering it useless. Armor losses its protection, a door is broken open, etc. The object cannot be larger than 6” in average dimension per Aura used in the spell or weigh more than 10 lb. per Aura used in the spell. The spell can be cast on a weapon. So long as the weapon remains in the hands of the wielder and the duration holds, the next non-magical object struck by the weapon with any degree of force will be sundered.

Envelops the caster's Aura in electricity. In this form the caster is immune to electricity as the spell Endure Electricity. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d8 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Transforms the caster's body into magical snow, granting the following abilities: 1) Immunity to physical and magical damage except fire-based spells and Disintegrate. 2) The caster's snow body can be molded into any shape. 3) Gains the powers Chill, Snow Swim, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 4) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of snow per Aura used in the spell.

Charges the caster's hands with the effect of dry drowning. The next air breathing creature the caster contacts will need to make a Magic Resistance or be affected by dry drowning. The dry drowning condition is the loss of all oxygen exchange capability within the lungs or breathing apparatus of the being. Every 10 seconds after failing a Magic Resistance the target loses 1d4 base Endurance and lowers 1 level of fatigue. After the effect is applied the victim can make a new Magic Resistance to remove the effect, however the resistance roll (and subsequent rolls) must be made at half the normal chance. Failure indicates that the effect continues with the loss of base Endurance and advancing fatigue one per 10 seconds. When base Endurance reaches 0 or less the victim must begin making Vitality saves to stay conscious. The usual -5% chance per point under 0 applies to the save. When a victim's endurance drops below 0 minus Vitality, the victim has died of oxygen deprivation but can be revived by any form of magical healing if healed within 10 minutes +1 minute per Vitality of the victim. A successful Physiology roll can diagnose the condition that caused death, followed by a Churigeon skill roll to restart the victim's circulation if within the period described above. Beings that do not breathe, breathe oxygen, or are under the effect of the Breathless spell are immune to the effects of this spell.

Allows the caster to change places with another person in sight, or another person possessing an object that Interchange was cast upon earlier. If the target is unwilling, a Magic Resistance is allowed to avoid the effects of this spell. The duration on the interchange object is (until used) at which time the effect on the object ends. This counts as an external effect which is always limited to 1 per title for all external effects.

Transforms the caster's body into magical sand, granting the following abilities: 1) Immunity to physical, and magical damage except for the spells Dig (which acts as a Disintegrate spell) and Disintegrate itself. 2) The caster's sand body can be molded into any shape. 3) Gains the powers Sand Swim, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 4) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of sand per Aura used in the spell.

Envelops the caster's Aura in acid. In this form the caster is immune to acid as the spell Endure Acid. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d10 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Transforms the caster's body into magical fog, granting the following abilities: 1) Immunity to physical, and magical damage except for the spell Disintegrate. 2) The caster's fog body can be molded into any shape. 3) Gains the powers Produce Fog, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 4) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of fog per Aura used in the spell.

Transforms the caster's body into magical ice, granting the following abilities: 1) Both 1 point of ice hide and 1 additional Endurance per 2 Aura used in the spell. 2) Immunity to physical, and magical damage, save fire-based spells (-30% to Magic Resistance, and damage is doubled), and Disintegrate. 3) The caster's ice body can be molded into any shape. 4) Gains the powers Ice Swim, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 5) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of ice per Aura used in the spell.

Protects the being from the direct damaging effects of Aura from spells such as Aura Strike, skills such as Aurakinesis, or the damage from Aura of Chaos. As long as raw Aura is the direct source of the damage then this spell protects from it. This does not protect from all spells simply because they are Aura based.

Transforms the caster's body into magical rock, granting the following abilities: 1) Both 1 point of rock hide and 1 additional Endurance per Aura used in the spell. 2) Immunity to physical, and magical damage, save the spells Dig (causes 1d4 damage per Aura used in the Dig spell), and Disintegrate. 3) The caster's stone body can be molded into any shape. 4) Gains the powers Stone Swim, Speak to Stone, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 5) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of rock per Aura used in the spell.

Transforms the caster's body into magical ash, granting the following abilities: 1) 1 point of ashen hide per Aura used in the spell. 2) Immunity to physical, and magical damage, save the spells Dig (which acts as a Disintegrate spell), and Disintegrate itself. 3) The caster's ashen body can be molded into any shape. 4) Gains the powers Finger of Fire (at will), Speak to Stone, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 5) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of ashen per Aura used in the spell.

Allows the caster to create 1 true duplicate per 9 Aura. Each duplicate is independent, has all the attributes, characteristics, abilities, powers, and effects of the original. A true duplicate can operate outside of the sight of the other duplicates and the original caster. All duplicates and the caster gain improved telepathy with one another. The caster can block any sense and extend that sense to any one true duplicate. All items, clothing, etc. are copied as well, but will disappear after 1 minute of leaving the Aura field of a true duplicate unless returned to the duplicate's Aura field. At 20 or higher Aura, non-artifact magic items are duplicated as well but have some unique properties. Specifically, they are tuned to only be used by the true duplicate they were duplicated with and connected to the spell itself. Divine magic items or dual magic items that have a divine nature cannot be copied by this effect unless cast by a divine or supernatural being with the consent of the divine being who created the original items, so good luck with that. A Dispel Magic targeted on a true duplicate, if successful, dispels the duplicate targeted and all items, magical or otherwise, created with that true duplicate. If a Dispel Magic is cast on the caster to remove True Duplicate and is successful then all duplicates are dispelled. True Duplicate cannot be cast on a true duplicate and cannot be recast by the caster on a target while true duplicates of that target exist. Permanency cast on this spell requires 1 Will Force for the Permanency plus 1 Will Force for each True Duplicate to be made permanent. This Will Force cost cannot be paid by a true duplicate and must be paid by the caster. Beings using Divine Sight can identify a true duplicate as being such. They sense that the spirit and soul of the true duplicate is not original and is somehow marred. If the original being is killed, all true duplicates vanish as they have no true spirit or soul of their own but rather share a connected one with the caster. This spell when combined with Endow Intelligence and Permanency can cause a true duplicate to become a completely separate being with its own spirit and soul, as well as the memories of the being from which it was created. However, mental contact is broken from the caster from that point forward, and the being is no longer considered a true duplicate or under the effects of the spell. It should be noted that some deities, especially those with a sphere of influence centered on life and/or order may find this process extremely blasphemous and seek to end beings created in this way.

Envelops the caster's Aura in chaotic Aura. In this form the caster is immune to Aura attacks as the spell Endure Aura. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d12 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 2 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Transforms the caster's body into magical crystal, granting the following abilities: 1) Both 2 point of rock hide and 1 additional Endurance per Aura used in the spell. 2) Immunity to physical, and magical damage, save the spell Disintegrate. 3) The caster's crystal body can be molded into any shape. 4) Gains the powers Ice Swim, Stone Swim, Magical Voice, Magical Sight, and Magical Hearing (all constant). 5) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 Endurance per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of crystal (including ice) per Aura used in the spell.

Protects the being from the energy damage of death based and negative energy based powers, skills, spells and effects. Thus the effects that cause damage, aging, withering, or disfigurement due to negative energy or death based energy have no effect on the protected individual. This also stops the Will Force draining portions of any negative energy attack. Those are still applied in full, however, if the appropriate save or resistance is failed. This spell cannot be cast on a negative life force being.

Protects an undead, death elemental, etc., from the damage caused by life/positive based powers, skills, spells, and effects. Thus the effects that cause damage, blinding, burns, etc., from positive or life based attacks have no effect on the protected undead. This does not stop turning, banishment, or destruction based positive/life effects. This spell cannot be cast on a positive life force being.

Transforms the caster's body into magical lava, granting the following abilities: 1) Both 2 points of cooled lava hide per Aura and an additional 1 Endurance per Aura used in the spell. 2) Immunity to physical and magical damage, except for the spell Disintegrate. 3) The caster's lava body can be molded into any shape. 4) Gains the powers Finger of Fire, Molten Earth, Storm of Fire (at will), Magical Voice, Magical Sight and Magical Hearing (all constant). 5) Regeneration of previously inflicted wounds of 1 point per 5 seconds while touching at least 1 cubic foot of lava per Aura used in the spell.

Protects from Energy damage in all forms as if under the effects of all endure spells: Endure Aura, Acid, Cold, Dissonance, Electricity, Fire, Light, and Poison. If the being is alive, they are treated as being protected by Endure Death; if they are negative life force based, they are treated as being under the effects of Endure Life. Also protects against Obliteration effects.

The caster imagines a particular scent, creates it, and then chooses either to attach that scent to a specific being, place or object, or lets it remain free floating. Beings and creatures with a Magic Resistance are afforded one if they desire to be free of this attachment. If the scent is free floating, it will be carried in the environment based on wind conditions and air flow. Wet environments are easier to detect scents in than dryer ones, etc. At 20 or higher Aura, more than one scent can be produced and those scents may be as complex as desired. When cast at 20 or higher Aura the scent is permanent unless dispersed by wind. This spell cannot be used to remove a scent but may be used to overpower the existing scent with a stronger scent of something else. Winds over 20 miles per hour will disperse the scent quickly reducing duration by 1 minute per mile an hour of wind over 20. This is not an illusion; a real magical scent is produced for the duration. Those with smell have a +20% to sense the scent in question.

The caster imagines a particular taste, produces the taste, and then it is attached to a specific being, place, or object. Beings and creatures with a Magic Resistance are afforded one if they desire to be free of this attachment. The taste is observed when any tasting organ is placed against the object or if the object is consumed. At 20 or higher Aura, more than one taste can be produced and that taste may be as complex as desired. When cast at 20 or higher Aura the taste effect is permanent (though still can be diluted to uselessness by liquid). This spell cannot be used to remove a taste but may be used to overpower the existing taste with a stronger one. Immersion in liquid will remove the taste more quickly by washing it off. For every minute of immersion in a liquid, the taste's magical duration will be reduced by 5 minutes. This is not an illusion; a real magical taste is produced for the duration.

The caster selects a source of water (pond, stream, ocean, etc.), then submerges their hand and imagines an individual they have met or seen, concentrating and thinking of a message of up to 2 words per Aura point used in the spell. When the individual imagined passes within 20 feet of that same water source, they will hear the message in their mind as if spoken it aloud next to their ear. No actual sound is emitted so this cannot be overheard. There is a 25% chance -1% per Intelligence point of the caster that the message will be garbled and 1d4+1 words will be lost.

Protects the being from the damaging or debilitating effects of light. Specifically, this protects from skills, spells, invocations, powers, and effects which cause a being to be blinded, confused, stunned, or damaged by light. E.g., Brilliance is a spell which when cast can blind all who see it in the area of effect; Endure Light protects completely against this. This spell protects only against magical and divine effects; the effects of natural light (sunburn, Dark Elven sensitivity, etc.) are unaffected. Similarly, effects that function as natural light (True Day, etc.) are unaffected by this spell. Positive effects such as being able to see in a darkened area are preserved. Thus, the individual could carry a light which would be blinding to others but allow them to see in darkened places. Damage from laser light is not fully removed but is reduced by 1 point per die.

The caster imagines a particular sound, produces the sound, and then it is attached to a specific being, place, or object. Beings and creatures with a Magic Resistance are afforded one if they desire to be free of this attachment. The sound produced can be continuous, repeating, or a pattern; in all cases it must have a single pitch and tone. For instance, if someone wanted to recreate the spoken word they would have to layer in each sound with additional castings; most words would take several different sound effects to produce. The decibel level of the sound is never enough to deafen and cannot be louder than a moderate sized bell ringing or a shout. The distance the sound travels depends on the decibel level. At 20 or higher aura this limitation is removed, and the sound can be as complex as desired. When cast at 20 or higher Aura the sound effect is permanent. This spell cannot be used to remove a sound but may be used to overpower an existing sound with a louder one. Sound effects attached to beings or creatures reduce the ability to Move Unheard by 5-50% depending on the sound effect, based on GM discretion. This is not an illusion; a real magical sound is produced for the duration.

The caster imagines a particular texture, produces the texture, and then it is attached to a specific being, place, or object. Beings and creatures with a Magic Resistance are afforded one if they desire to be free of this attachment. The overall size of the texture can be up to 1 square foot per Aura used in the spell. The texture depth varies as desired within a range of a barely noticeable film to up to 1 inch deep. The texture can be anywhere from as smooth as glass to rough enough to provide a grip. The texture adds no additional damage, weight, or armor value to the object. All attacks and effects, both physical and mystical, pass completely through in both directions without damaging the texture. E.g., if a surface is covered in a contact poison and a texture is applied to that surface, the being touching that surface will contact the poison despite the texture's presence. Likewise, if a surface is electrified and a texture is applied to it, contacting that surface will impart the effects of the electricity to the person touching it. When cast at 20 or higher Aura the texture effect is permanent. In any case, if the object covered by the texture is broken, the spell ends. This is not an illusion; a real magical texture is produced for the duration. The texture can be removed with sufficient force and is considered adhered at 20 pounds per 2 Aura used in the spell. The texture can reduce or enhance climbing from -50% to +50% depending on the texture, at the GM's discretion. A suitable texture applied to a weapon's grip reduces the chance of being disarmed by 2% per Aura used in the spell.

The caster selects a source of water (pond, stream, ocean, etc.), submerges their hand, then closes off the sense of hearing through concentration, projecting it instead through the water, seeking a particular sound or voice listened for. An Intelligence save is required once per minute to locate the selected sound or voice. Sounds that emanate from people or places that are magical protected by non-detection or glamour cannot be heard.

Creates a bolt of concentrated sound, emanating from the caster's finger. The Finger of Dissonance strikes the body area desired if an Intelligence save is made. The Finger of Dissonance does 1d3 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage and a 1% chance per Aura used in the spell of being deafened for 10-40 minutes. Beings and objects which are immune to dissonace (sound) are unaffected by this spell. The spell Endure Dissonance is one such example. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor.

The caster focuses on a being or animal that possesses hair. At the end of the casting period the caster makes a downward flourish. The target is allowed a Magic Resistance and if that fails all their hair, including eyelashes, immediately fall out. This reduces Appearance in humanoids by 1d4+1 points. If the Magic Resistance roll succeeds the hair follicles are only mildly itchy for a minute per Aura. Lack of hair in animals and beings normally furred causes them to be colder and can cause clothes and armor to chafe, creating rashes and discomfort. Initiative is reduced by 1 for 2 weeks as the hair regrows. Hair grows back at a normal rate. Any furred being with hide has the hide reduced by half for two weeks. Creatures identified as Magical, Magical Animal, Slime, Magical Humanoid, or Undead are unaffected by this spell.

The caster focuses on a being or animal. At the end of the casting period the caster makes an upward flourish. The target is allowed a Magic Resistance and if that fails their entire body becomes covered in a thick animalistic hair. If they are already an animal the hair doubles in length and thickness. This reduces appearance in humanoids by 1d4+1 points. If the Magic Resistance roll succeeds the skin merely itches for a minute per Aura. Extra hair falls out after 1 day per Aura, leaving behind the unharmed, normal hair. Extra hair can make the wearing of armor difficult causing pulling and catching and reduces initiative by 1 until the extra hair is gone. 1d4+1 points of hide are added for the duration of the furry state. Creatures identified as Magical, Magical Animal, Slime, Magical Humanoid, or Undead are unaffected by this spell.

The caster focuses and envelopes an object in the caster's Aura causing the item to temporarily become magical. The magical plus of the item is +1 per 5 Aura used in the spell (+6 maximum). The item is considered magical for bonuses to hit, damage, etc., but the essence of the item isn't changed. For instance, the spell does not increase the armor rating of a piece of armor, but it adds a bonus to the wearer's Defensive Adjustment equal to the temporary plus of the item. If cast on a melee weapon, the grants a bonus to hit and damage, and is proof against the appropriate level of Physical immunities, but it does not gain the true properties of a magical weapon (lower weight, lower speed, double armor protection, etc.). When cast, 1/4 of 1 Will Force may be spent per plus of the item to make it permanently magical, also changing its essence to that of a magical item. Thus, armor would then gain additional armor strength and durability, and melee weapons would gain additional modifiers to weight and speed.

The caster focuses and calls into existence earth, dirt, sand, or a similar lose material, as desired. The amount produced is up to 10 cubic feet per 4 Aura used in the spell. The spell fails completely if any being, creature, or object with an Aura field is within the area of the earth to be created. The earth created is loose and will immediately deform, slide, or collapse based on where it is created. The earth must be created on or against a surface or the spell fails. It will not appear in midair. When cast at 20 or higher Aura the earth produced is permanent.

The caster selects a source of water (pond, stream, ocean, etc.), submerges their hand, then closes their eyes, projecting their vision rapidly through the water body, seeking a particular image of a being, place, or object they are looking for. An Intelligence save is required once per minute to locate the selected sight or image. Persons, places, or things that are magical protected by Non-detection or Glamour cannot be seen.

Protects the being from the damaging or debilitating effects of sound. Specifically, protection from skills, spells, invocations, powers, and effects which cause a being to be deafened, confused, or stunned by sound. E.g., Thunderclap is a spell which when cast can deafen those in the area of effect; Endure Dissonance protects completely against this.
Causes all carried objects, to reduce in weight by 5% per Aura point used in the spell, to a maximum of 99%. When the object leaves the being's Aura field, that object is no longer affected.

Allows the caster to touch a single object and cause it to adhere to the next phased being or object it touches. The object will be adhered at 20 pounds per 2 Aura points used in casting the spell. This means that for every 2 Aura points used, 20 pounds of pressure must be applied to pull the object free from whatever it has been adhered to. Otherwise, it remains stuck. A character may exert up to his load limit to pull himself or the adhered object free. A successful Force skill roll will also work. This spell allows a phased being to carry an unphased object. The target of the spell cannot be an object on the Phase Plane unless the caster is on the Phase Plane. If the adhered object touches flesh, the being gets a Magic Resistance to avoid the object sticking. If it sticks, the outer layer of skin will drop off 8-12 hours later, freeing the adhered creature. Characters attempting to pull free may do so if they possess enough strength, but will take 2d6 damage to adhered areas. Allows a phased caster to adhere a phased object to unphased-object or being. While phased an unphased-object cannot be the target of this spell.

Allows the caster to touch a single object and cause it to adhere to the next shadow-shifted being or object it touches. The object will be adhered at 20 pounds per 2 Aura points used in casting the spell. This means that for every 2 Aura points used, 20 pounds of pressure must be applied to pull the object free from whatever it has been adhered to. Otherwise, it remains stuck. A character may exert up to his load limit to pull himself or the adhered object free. A successful Force skill roll will also work. This spell allows a shadow-shifted being to carry an unshadow-shifted object. The target of the spell cannot be an object on the Shadow Plane unless the caster is on the Shadow Plane. If the adhered object touches flesh, the being gets a Magic Resistance to avoid the object sticking. If it sticks, the outer layer of skin will drop off 8-12 hours later, freeing the adhered creature. Characters attempting to pull free may do so if they possess enough strength, but will take 2d6 damage to adhered areas. Allows a shadow-shifted caster to adhere a shadow-shifted object to unshadow-shifted-object or being. While shadow-shifted an unshadow-shifted-object cannot be the target of this spell.

Creates a buffeting of focused sound waves at a fixed height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects:  1) Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d3 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to all exposed areas. (All body areas protected by less than five points of armor are considered exposed). Beings take 2 points of damage per 10 seconds to wherever area their hearing organs are contained in, usually the head. 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be deafened for 10-40 minutes blinded. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Dissonance always miss their target. 6) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Each sound wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The agitated sound wave walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall must touch another or an existing surface. Touching the wall with exposed flesh does 1d3 per 2 Aura points to 2d4 random areas. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If the roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. There is also a 1% per Aura that anyone coming into contact with the Wall of Dissonance must make a make a Magic Resistance or be deafened for 10-40 minutes. The wall itself will be impossible to remove can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic. If the wall cannot fit into the desired casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then that particular section of the wall will fail.
Dismisses a bound supernatural familiar (bound by the spell Bind Supernatural Familiar), returning the sacrificed Will Force point used in that spell. May only be cast on the caster's own familiar.

Creates a pocket dimension attached to the targeted being's Aura field. If they change form or are transformed into another substance, they may elect that all, some or none of their items go into the pocket dimension. This can also be done at the time of casting. After this the items can be called out from the pocket dimension one item at a time every 5 seconds. Items cannot be sent into the pocket dimension after it is formed or the first time a being transforms for the first time. Once a being returns to normal form or substance, all the items reappear on the effected being's body in the same place they were before the original transformation. If the duration expires, the pocket ends and all the items are likewise returned. If the being is still transformed at the time, the items appear on the ground in front of the being.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of dissonance or sonic energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 sonic energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 sonic damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the dissonance. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.

Envelops the caster's Aura in focused sound waves. In this form the caster is immune to dissonance the detrimental effects of loud and sudden sounds as the spell Endure Dissonance. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d3 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Calls low level supernatural (level 5 or less) and transforms it temporarily into a familiar. An supernatural being drawn randomly from within one mile of caster per Aura point and comes immediately to the caster. At 10 or higher a specific supernatural being type can be called (if it exists in the area of effect.) At 15 or higher Aura an individual, known, supernatural being can be called as a familiar. The supernatural being can be a lesser creature of level 5 or less. While the spell is in effect, the familiar desires to be in the presence of the caster and has a strong affinity for the caster at all times. Besides the supernatural being's abilities, additional abilities are gained when the supernatural being becomes a familiar. FAMILIAR: END x2, RESISTS: equal caster (if lower), MENTAL: equal caster (if lower), POWERS: Magic Voice, Message (x3 day), Telepathy (with caster), Summon (supernatural's type, 1x day). CASTER: END (+2 per level of the supernatural), SENSE: 1 is enhanced per 5 Aura, ABILITIES: 1 natural or supernatural ability of the familiar per 4 Aura. A caster can never have more than one familiar at a time. If the familiar is killed, the caster loses one point of Will Force permanently. The caster must make a Vitality save or lose 1d4 Endurance permanently. The caster also makes a Vitality save to avoid a heart attack.

Protects the being from the damaging or debilitating effects of pressure or lack of pressure in all forms, whether from earth, liquid or gas pressing in or from the lack of any pressure at all. Specifically, protection from skills, spells, invocations, powers and natural effects which cause a being to be damaged or effected by pressure. This spell would allow a being to survive the depth at the bottom of the ocean, or the depths of space without negative physical effects (though she would still die from lack of air in both examples).

Hides most of the visible light reflected from off the being, causing the affected being to fade from view. The physical body of the target is still present but light casts less color back off of the affected being. The affected being is not completely invisible and can be seen as a shadow or shades of gray depending on the light source. BRIGHT(SUNLIGHT): -2 defensive, Color faded. NORMAL(LANTERN/TORCH): -4 defensive, Shades of gray. DIM(CANDLELIGHT/GLOWSTONE): -6 defensive, Shadow. DIFFUSE(GLOW WORM/BIOLUMINESCENCE): -8 defensive, Dim shadow. DARKNESS: -8 defensive, Invisible. When this spell is in effect, a projection that sends the image of the being to some part of the Shadow Plane (even if the plane the person is on is not connected to the Shadow Plane). The faded being is not actually physically present on that plane; they have not shadow-shifted. However, this can alert the beings of the Shadow Plane to the presence of a being on the Natural Universe or other adjacent plane if applicable.
Protects the being from the any effects which would slow or stop movement, including hold, stasis, slow, etc. it does not remove these effects if cast on someone who is already under their effects.

Causing the affected being to completely invisible to life sensing, or life detection whether alive (positive life force) or undead (negative life force). Other forms of detection (detect evil, etc.) still function normally.

Causes a temporary and shallow mind reading of a primary target during the casting. When complete, a shallow copy of the target's mind is duplicated and placed on the caster or a focus target. Whenever mental contact is made with the secondary target of this spell, a perception check is required or the mind will appear to be the copy and not the actual mind of target (if they have encountered it before). Shallow mental contact such as from a Mind Touch does not grant a perception check to see through the effect. If the target engages or is engaged in mental combat with another being then the spell immediately fails. The secondary target is allowed a double perception check to get surface thoughts and emotions from the shallow copy that the target was thinking and feeling at the time of the original spell casting. As the spell is illusionary in nature, a requested successful Illusion Resistance sees through the effect as well.

The spell caster selects a source of water (pond, stream, ocean, etc.), then concentrates on a person within 10 feet per Aura of that same water source and makes an Intelligence save. If the Intelligence save is made, she has reached the being. The being then senses that a magical portal has opened in the water nearby, allowing that person and up to 1 being touching her target per 4 Aura to step into the water and appear in the water nearest to where the spell was cast. Persons protected by Mind Set, Mind Change, Non-Detection or Glamour cannot be seen.

Calls a supernatural being of low level (1-5) and transforms it permanently into a familiar at the cost of 1 Will Force. An supernatural being drawn randomly from within one mile of caster per Aura point and comes immediately to the caster. At 10 or higher a specific supernatural being type can be called (if it exists in the area of effect.) At 15 or higher Aura an individual, known, supernatural being can be called as a familiar. The supernatural being can be no more thasn 5th level. While the spell is in effect, the familiar desires to be in the presence of the caster and has a strong affinity for the caster at all times. Besides the supernatural being's abilities, additional abilities are gained when the supernatural being becomes a familiar. FAMILIAR: END x2, RESISTS: equal caster (if lower), MENTAL: equal caster (if lower), POWERS: Magic Voice, Message (x3 day), Telepathy (with caster), Summon (supernatural's type, 1x day). CASTER: END (+2 per level of the supernatural), SENSE: 1 is enhanced per 5 Aura, ABILITIES: 1 natural or supernatural ability of the familiar per 4 Aura. A caster can never have more than one familiar at a time. If the familiar is killed, the caster loses one point of Will Force permanently. The caster must make a Vitality save or lose 1d4+2 Endurance permanently. The caster also makes a Vitality save to avoid a heart attack.

Causes one weapon to be projected into the demi-plane of Shadow. All creatures/beings that are shadow-shifted can be struck for the weapon's normal damage. If the weapon was not already magical, it is given the bonus of +1 to hit per 5 Aura points, against shadow-shifted creatures. If the weapon enters an Anti-Magic zone, it will shadow-shifted in.

The caster selects a source of water (pond, stream, ocean, etc.), submerges their hand, and thinks of an individual they have met or seen. The caster then concentrates and extends their mind outward, searching for that individual. If that individual is within 10 feet per Aura point used in the spell of the water source and within 100 miles per aura of the spell, then the caster is able to make mental contact with the being and converse mentally as long as the being stays within range. Persons, places, or things that are magical protected by Mind Set, Mind Change, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be contacted.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of cold or frost energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 cold energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 cold damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the frost. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.

Causes one humanoid, magical humanoid, animal or magical animal to change sex for the duration of the spell. If the target is male they take on female characteristics and vice versa. This includes any gender dimorphism. For most humanoids this is a means females lose 1 Strength but gain 1 Agility. Thus, becoming male will give a female +1 Strength and -1 Agility. Becoming female will grant +1 Agility and -1 Strength. Fertility is affected as follows, if fertilization occurs in a male changed into a female that fertilization and any in process gestation vanish at the end of the duration of this spell.

Creates a magical mental block between a being and his or her Proprioception (sense of their body belonging to them). This has a profound impact on how they direct their limbs and movement. If the target fails a Control Resistance, then the following effects are applied. 1) Movement is reduced to walking or jogging, the being cannot run or use other faster forms of physical movement. This includes flying if having non-magical wings. Although gliding can be achieved by making an Intelligence Save once per 10 seconds in tense (combat) situations or once per minute in normal ones. 2) Initiative modifier is now +4. 3) Agility saves are reduced by 50%. 4) Damage produced by weapons or physically striking an opponent is reduced by 1 point per die rolled. Overall damage modifier is reduced by 4, even if this produces a negative modifier. Negative damage is treated as zero damage. 5) All skills that use either Strength or Agility are reduced by 20% for the duration. This affected being can add an additional 2 seconds to most actions to remove one of the above penalties if they make an Intelligence save to overcome this impaired sense. Thus, to forego the initiative penalty, the first two seconds of a combat round must be spent getting control of the body, then an Intelligence save must be made or the affected being loses the 2 seconds spent and still suffers the penalty. Likewise taking an extra 2 seconds to swing a weapon and making an Intelligence save will remove all penalties related to striking with the weapon (both the damage reduction penalty and the skill modifier if a skill was being used with this weapon strike). In some cases, there is no opportunity to add seconds, such as when an Agility save occurs to avoid falling in a pit. Under those circumstances an Intelligence Save can be made to reduce the penalty by half (Agility save modifier becomes -25%).

Allows the caster to target one distinct area (up to 100 cubic feet per Aura), object (up to 20 lb. per Aura), or being (up to 25 lb. per Aura.) That being, place or object gets a Magic Resistance. If the resistance is made by half, then no effect occurs. If the resistance is made but by more than half then all magical movement effects (flight, propel, levitate, etc.) are converted into float which will last until the being touches a surface considered ground or floor or up to 1 hour per Aura. If the Magic Resistance fails, then all magical movement effects are immediately canceled and they fall if in the air. Beings, creatures and objects that fail or make resistance by less than half and touch the ground after floating find that they cannot have any magical air movement effects cast upon them for the duration of the spell. Nor can they leave the surface of the ground/floor even by natural means other than to fall to a lower floor/or ground.

Allows the caster to listen in on one person, place or thing named allowed by the caster as if their sense of hearing was within hearing of the person, place or thing. The maximum distance equals 25 miles per Aura point. However, if the spell is cast at higher than 15 Aura, there is no limit to the distance. If the spell is cast at 20 Aura, it will have a 3% chance per Will Force point of the caster extending the eavesdrop spell into other dimensions. If that which is eavesdropped upon is protected by any of the following, they will not be able to be detected: Non-Detection, Sphere of Protection (Wall of Protection if between eavesdroppee & eavesdropper), Mind Set, Mind Change, Silence, or the skill Thought Projection block this effect. Beings with Life Sense or Sense Projection are given an Intelligence save to feel the eavesdrop. Notes: Beings who are around the caster will hear nothing as the caster eavesdrops, unless they can make an Illusion Resistance, in which case they hear fainter sounds of what the caster hears. When used with an existing Scrying spell or skill, the casting time becomes 1 second and the need to name the person, place or thing is no longer required. The eavesdrop spells duration will end if the Scrying skill or spell does first. Otherwise, duration is as normal.

Creates a magical mental augmentation of a being's Proprioception (sense of their body belonging to them) that allows the target being to experience dramatically improved physical coordination due to an improved spatial awareness. This augmentation affords the target being the following bonuses: 1) All non-magical movement penalties are negated. 2) Initiative rolls receive a -4 bonus. 3) Agility saves receive a +50% bonus. 4) +1 to hit with melee and missile weapons per 4 Aura used in the spell. 5) -1 bonus to Defensive Adjustment per 4 Aura used in the spell. 6) Skills that require physical action receive a +20% bonus and cannot be critically failed. Treat critical failures as simple failures. Repeat failures, however, can still produce a critical failure if applicable; see the rule for the skill in question. The GM's discretion is absolute in determining whether or not this benefit applies to a given skill. The initiative bonus stacks with the target's normal modifier, and is therefore able to grant speed seconds if applicable.

Causes a magical adjustment of weight within the weapon as it is swung. So that it is both easier to swing and weight distributes to the end of the weapon as it reaches the apex of its swing or thrust. This spell only works on melee weapons and cannot be cast on missile weapons. The effects are as follows: weapon speed and minimum weapon speed are reduced by 1, +1 additional die of damage is added to die type the weapon uses. Small weapons are not large enough to have the fulcrum effect operate on them to any effect. Thus, any weapon which has an unadjusted minimum weapon speed of less than 3 seconds cannot be the spell target.

This spell has two forms of casting. INNER: acts as padding for armor, reducing armor modifiers by 1 level (-10% skills, becomes -5%, +2 defensive becomes +1, etc. OUTER: provides a kinetic barrier to damage reducing incoming damage it by 1 point per 5 Aura in the spell. Both under armor and over armor targets of this spell cannot be cast on the same being at once. This spell does not count toward stacking armor rules. It also can be combined with Force Armor, or Spiritual Armor (or both). SPECIAL: if using Inner Kinetic Armor check the box on the Combat Sheet. If using Outer Kinetic Armor set the amount in the Temporary Modifiers under Combat Modifiers (Outer Kinetic Armor).

Surrounds a being's Aura creating a nearly invisible stasis shield. When a fast, physical attack (melee or missile, under 5 seconds unadjusted) strikes the being's Aura, The shield reacts, showing a translucent crystalline effect during the second it is struck, at the place of impact, removing 1 point of physical damage per Aura point used in the spell. The remainder of damage passes through. This works against normal and magical physical attacks but has no effect on energy attacks (save for Repulsion energy which is removed completely). Thus, spells like Repulsion or Finger of Repulsion have no effect on the protected being while the shield is in effect. Any weapon that has an unadjusted attack speed of 5 seconds or more strikes as normal, doing standard damage. Those under this speed can be increased to a 5 second (or more) attack times. For all attacks this reduces the damage by 1 dice for each second it is increased over the normal, unadjusted attack speed. Thus a 3 second attack from a weapon speed which has an unadjusted attack speed of 4 seconds and does 4d6 weapon loses 1d6 when slowed to 5 seconds to avoid the shield. This represents a loss in kinetic force necessary to bypass the shield. Effects which add time to the weapon speed such as Critical or Focused attack do not affect the unadjusted weapon speed and thus are affected by the shield.

Creates a bolt of force, emanating from the caster's finger. The Finger of Repulsion strikes the body area desired if an Intelligence save is made. The Finger of Repulsion does 1d4+1 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Whether damage is taken or not an Agility save must be made at -20% if the save fails the being or creature struck is thrown back 1 foot per Aura and must make a second Agility save to avoid being knocked prone. Beings and objects which are immune to repulsion are unaffected by this spell. The spell Endure Repulsion is one such example. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor.

Uses a sketch, painting, tapestry, etching, bas-relief or even model of an existing area to teleport to the area depicted. Chance of the spell's success is based on the quality of the item. MASTER: 95%, HIGH: 75%, GOOD: 50%, AVERAGE: 25%, POOR: 10%, SHODDY: 5%. If the chance is rolled then the item becomes charged with the magic effect and anyone touching it is teleported (if desired) to the area depicted. The portal remains in effect for the duration of the spell. If the chance fails then the spell fails immediately. If the art item does not become charged with teleportation, the spell cannot be cast again that day on that item unless the Aura Control of the caster is increased by at least one point or the quality of the art is increased by at least 5%. If the area changes dramatically that the scene is no longer even reminiscent of the area then the spell chance is reduced to 1%.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of heat or fire energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 heat energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 fire damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the fire. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.
