system.description: Charges the caster's hands to cause the next being or creature touched to be effected by chaos. The being or creature) makes a Magic Resistance or is affected randomly. The duration of the spell is for the amount of time the caster's hands remain charged after the first touch. Each effect has its own duration.

Causes a temporary and deep mind reading of a primary target during the casting. When complete, a near complete mental copy of the target's mind is duplicated and placed on the caster or a focus target. Whenever mental contact is made with the secondary target of this spell, they sense the duplicated mind and not the secondary target's actual mind. If the target engages or is engaged in mental combat with another being then the spell immediately fails. The secondary target is allowed a double perception check to get thoughts, emotions and details from the mental copy that the target was thinking and feeling at the time of the original spell casting. Spells, magical mental effects and the ability to use or even understand magical or divine skills is not transferred to the copy. This is not an illusion as the mimic mind spell and cannot be seen through with an Illusion Resistance.

Uses a sketch, painting, tapestry, etching, bas-relief or even statue of an existing being to teleport to the being depicted. Chance of the spell's success is based on the quality of the item. MASTER: 95%, HIGH: 75%, GOOD: 50%, AVERAGE: 25%, POOR: 10%, SHODDY: 5%. If the chance is rolled then the item becomes charged with the magic effect and anyone touching it is teleported (if desired) to the being depicted. The portal remains in effect for the duration of the spell. If the chance fails then the spell fails immediately. If the art item does not become charged with teleportation, the spell cannot be cast again that day on that item unless the Aura Control of the caster is increased by at least one point or the quality of the art is increased by at least 5%. If the being dies or is no longer on the current plane then the spell automatically fails.

The caster selects a source of water (pond, stream, ocean, etc.), submerges their hand. They then concentrate on a person, place, or thing within 10 feet per Aura of the same body of water, and within 100 miles per Aura point used in the spell and then makes an Intelligence save. If the Intelligence save is made, the caster and up to 1 being touching her per 4 Aura used in the spell can step through the water portal, and appear within 10 feet per Aura of the desired person, place or thing. Persons, places, or things that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, Non-detection, or Glamour cannot be water walked to.

Reduces the original amount of Aura directed into an active spell (or power in a magic item). Spells will lose 1 additional Aura point in power for every 2 Aura points used in the Dampen spell. Magic item powers will lose 1 additional Aura point per 4 Aura points used in the Dampen spell, temporarily. Thus, if a spell was originally cast at 10 Aura and Dampen was cast at 10 Aura, the spell would be treated as though 5 Aura had been put into it. The number of Aura points subtracted by Dampen cannot be more than the original number put into the spell. This spell can be cast on a being with no effects. The next spell that would affect them is then reduced by the Dampen.

Protects the being from the damaging or depilating effects of repulsion. Specifically, protection from skills, spells, invocations, powers and effects which cause a being to be pushed or buffed by invisible force such as the damage inducing aspects of Telekinesis. Finger of Repulsion and Repulsion are also spells which produce this effect. Endure Repulsion protects completely against these effects.

Uses a sketch, painting, tapestry, etching, bas-relief or even statue of an existing being to summon that being to the nearest open area within 10 feet of the art object. Chance of the spell's success is based on the quality of the item. MASTER: 95%, HIGH: 75%, GOOD: 50%, AVERAGE: 25%, POOR: 10%, SHODDY: 5%. If the person changes so dramatically that the depiction is no longer even reminiscent of the being then the spell chance is reduced to 1%. If the being dies or is no longer on the current plane then the spell automatically fails.

Causes the being, and all carried possessions, to become insubstantial and then enter the Shadow Plane. The being appears as a shadowy, faded version of themselves. All physical actions against the being will have no effect whatsoever, but the reverse also holds true. Entering an Anti-Magic zone will cause the being to return from the Shadow Plane. It is hard to move on the Shadow Plane and requires some form of magical propulsion unless there are objects to push off of. Should the character drop an object; it will remain shadow-shifted and can only be retrieved by another shadow-shifted being. Alternately, the spell can simply be cast on an object causing it to shadow-shifted out until retrieved by another shadow-shifted being. All mental powers held by the caster or enemies thereof will freely pass onto the Shadow Plane so that mental combat is possible (see also Shadow Weapon). If a living being is killed on the Shadow Plane, its body will stay phased and may become a ghost trapped forever between dimensions. However, if the being is merely unconscious, it will return at the end of the duration of the spell. This spell does not work on planes that are not connected to the Shadow Plane.

Creates a pocket dimension attached to the targeted being's Aura field. If they change form or are transformed into another substance, they may elect that all, some or none of their items go into the pocket dimension. This can also be done at the time of casting. After this they can be called out from the pocket dimension one item at a time per 2 seconds. Items in contact with the transformed being can also be added at a rate of one item per 2 seconds. Once a being returns to normal form or substance, all the items reappear on the effected being's body in the same place they were before the original transformation, if possible. If the duration expires the pocket ends and all the items are likewise returned. If the being is still transformed at the time, the items appear on the ground in front of the being as do any items which do not fit into their original destination locations.

Creates a buffeting of bolts of force at a fixed height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects: 1) Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d4+1 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to all exposed areas. (All body areas protected by less than five points of armor are considered exposed). Beings take 2 points of damage per 10 seconds to wherever area their hearing organs are contained in, usually the head. 2) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 3) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 4) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Repulsion always miss their target. 5) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Each shimmering air wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The rending force walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall must touch another or an existing surface. Touching the wall with exposed flesh does 1d4+1 per 2 Aura points to 2d4 random areas, and requires an Agility save at -20% to avoid being thrown back 1 foot per Aura from the wall. If this fails a second Agility save is required to avoid being knocked prone. Trying to enter the field takes a Strength save at -20% and even then, if a being becomes immersed in the field, it will take the above listed damage to 2d4 random areas and suffer the Agility save effects from touching the wall (Save at -20% or knock back and then save to avoid being knocked prone). The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If the roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. There is also a 1% per Aura that anyone coming into contact with the Wall of Dissonance must make a make a Magic Resistance or be deafened for 10-40 minutes. The wall itself will be impossible to remove can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic. If the wall cannot fit into the desired casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then that particular section of the wall will fail.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of repulsive, magical, or divine kinetic damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 repulsion energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 repulsion damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the repulsion. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.

Creates a breathable air shroud with a set pressure, temp, etc. that is centered on the target and moves with the target. The shroud extends outward from the affected being, to 2' radius per Aura point. The air within the shroud is renewed constantly, making the air breathable. The edge of the shroud is a permeable, translucent membrane that allows beings, energy, weapons, etc. to enter and exit but keeps breathable air and safe pressure and temperature changes from entering the shroud. Temperature is regulated but external factors such as a fire within the shroud can have an effect on the temperature. Beings with this shroud would float on water, and other liquids, etc. The target can enter a cave or enclosed space as the barrier will condense to fit in the space available as the target passes through it and expands again when space is once again available.

Creates an Illusion of Sight as the spell Illusion of Sight but without the required concentration to control. The illusion will appear to perform  a set of planned actions or movements (within the range) and then will reset and perform them again. The total amount of time available for the planned actions is 1 minute per Aura used in the spell after which the simulacrum can repeat its programmed actions immediately, or reappear after a specific delay which can be 1 second later or up to 10 minutes later per Aura used in the spell, or vanish never to reappear (spell's duration then ends). Other illusions spells; feeling, sound, smell, taste, and sensing can be added to the Simulacrum by casting of those spells into the existing Simulacrum. As always, a requested and successful Illusion Resistance or other effects that see through illusions will reveal the illusionary nature of the simulacrum. The simulacrum can cause illusionary damage as appropriate. The Set spell, when cast on this spell, allows a specific action or actions to trigger the simulacrum. Once triggered the set spell does not expire on the Simulacrum until the Simulacrum spell itself ends. This allows for an action to trigger the simulacrum multiple times within the Simulacrum spell's duration. Permanency can be cast on an existing simulacrum or a set enhanced simulacrum at a cost of 1/4 Will Force.

Envelops the caster's Aura in bolts of force. In this form the caster is immune to repulsion or magical kinetic energy as the spell Endure Repulsion. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d4+1 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Creates a pocket dimension attached to the targeted being's Aura field. It allows them to place items in or call them out from the pocket dimension one item at a time per 2 seconds. If the duration expires the pocket ends and all the items are immediately returned. If the items do not fit into their original locations, they appear on the ground in front of the being.

This spell has several uses. EXISTING PRODUCE SPELL: the ability to act as any of the existing produce spells, producing substances as any other produce spell. Even if the caster has not learned those spells. NEW TYPE PRODUCE SPELL: the ability is to create something which is not specifically named in any current produce spell, so long what is being produced is naturally occurring in nature and does not take extraordinary power to create or maintain. You cannot use this spell to create neutron star metals or dense plasma from the interior of a sun or any kind of exotic material that would not occur without intense forces operating on it. COMPLEX OBJECTS: As a complex object made up of parts of produce-type spells, but cast as once. The item will be serviceable but will be only as good as whatever crafting skill the caster has for that type of object. As with other produce spells, no matter what type of thing or things are created by the spell within the area of effect it is considered magical at +1 per 5 Aura placed in the spell.

Allows a being to walk on any surface or no surface at all, gaining the effect Adhere on their feet (or similar appendage) when they are placed on any surface. If no surface is available then a crystal one appears about an inch larger than the affected being's foot and is held in place until the limb is lifted. This allows the being to walk (or run) even through air, or void.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of electrical energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 electrical energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 electrical damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the electricity. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.

Allows an object to be improved from its current state to an upgraded version of what it was. On magical items this spell may cost the user permanent Will Force loss. Objects improved cannot add additional parts of a different makeup or material, unless an amount of that part is touched to the item before it is improved. Thus, a branch alone cannot be improved into an iron tipped spear, but if a spike is added it can then be improved into an iron tipped spear. By means of this spell, additional material of the existing object type(s) can be added to improve it. Casting time varies by quality. USEFUL: 10 sec., 0 WIL, Stick into a stake, rock into cutting tool, rock with minerals into crude hammer, etc. SHODDY: 20 sec., 0 WIL, Lump of metal into shoddy knife, branch with spike into shoddy spear, etc. POOR: 30 sec., 0 WIL, Silver cutlery into hand mirror, Scissors into a dagger, etc. AVERAGE: 45 sec., 0 WIL, Broken sword pieces into sword, pile of spears into cage, rusty scimitar in average one, etc. GOOD: 1 min., 0 WIL, Wooden sign into shield, bucket into helmet, chipped sword into good one, etc. HIGH: 5 min., 0 WIL, Costume jewelry with flecks of gems into valuable jewelry, iron pry bar into cutlass, etc. MASTER: 10 min., 0 WIL, Pile of wood & some metal into tower shield, pile of metal and leather into sword, etc. MAGIC(+1): 30 min., 1/10th WIL, Sword into low grade, Mithreel sword, bow into low grade, white wood bow, etc. MAGIC(+2): 1 hour, 1/5th WIL, Sword into high grade, Mithreel sword, bow into high grade, white wood bow, etc. MAGIC(+3): 2 hours, 1/4 WIL, Sword into low grade, Adamantium sword, bow into low grade, Grent wood bow, etc. MAGIC(+4): 6 hours, 1/2 WIL, Sword into high grade, Adamantium sword, bow into high grade, Grent wood bow, etc. MAGIC(+5): 1 day, 1 WIL, Sword into low grade, Crysteel sword, bow into low grade, silver wood bow, etc. The object cannot increase more than twice its starting size and weight. This spell also counts as a Repair spell permanently fixing any broken parts if even a trace of the material remains. Object's improved by this spell are detectable by magic, even if they were not improved into the magical range. Optional quality or magical object rules apply. Items cannot be improved past +5.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of acid or chemical energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 acidic energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 acid damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the acid. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.

Creates a large air pocket with a set pressure, temp, etc. that is fixed at the time of casting and has up to a 10' radius per Aura used in the spell. The air within the pocket is constantly renewed, keeping it breathable. The edge of the shroud is a permeable, translucent membrane that allows beings, energy, weapons, etc. to enter and exit but keeps breathable air and safe pressure and temperature changes from entering the shroud. Temperature is regulated, but factors such as a fire within the pocket can have an effect on the temperature. The pocket will float on water and other liquids. It does not however float up or down, remaining fixed.

Protects the being from the damaging or depilating effects of deterioration. This includes withering effects as well as the damage caused by these negative energy, magical effects. Finger of Deterioration is a spell which produces this effect. Endure Deterioration protects completely against this spell and others that have the same effects. This spell does not protect against the draining power of negative life force nor the damage that is listed as death-based. Only those that are listed as deterioration, withering, or aging.

Create a false memory or an illusionary mental experience. FALSE MEMORY: 30 sec. Control Resistance followed by Illusion Resistance if requested. Plants a false memory. This can be elaborate or simple but the caster has to have a clear idea of the memory before casting. The affected being is then afforded a Control Resistance and if this fails the illusionary memory is instantly implanted. If it is them doing something Good if Evil or being friends with someone they would not be friends with, then all resistances are made at +20%. Beings immune to magic, control or illusions are unaffected by this form of casting. ILLUSIONARY EXPERIENCE: up to 1 hour per Aura. Offers an illusionary experience. The experience can be something the caster actually experienced or something they vividly imagine, requiring an Intelligence save every hour of the casting or the experience ends at that point. The experience is then stored by the caster for up to one day per Aura, until they choose a target or targets to instantly give illusionary experience to. In that split second when the caster releases the experience, the receiver can choose to make a Magic Resistance or let it happen. Those that fail the Magic Resistance or opt to allow it to happen, experience the entire illusionary experience even if it is hours long in that split second. For them no time has passed. An observer might notice a momentary look of concentration or wonder but otherwise the targets have no ill effects other than the illusionary experience. During the experience they can also make an Illusion Resistance to break the effect. Some experiences can be mind-warping enough to cause Will Force saves to avoid insanity at the discretion of the GM. These experiences cause the being to sense that they will possibly be negatively affected at the time of the Magic Resistance, thus allowing them to choose to take the Magic Resistance as they might be mentally harmed. Beings immune to magic, or illusions are unaffected by this form of casting. Neither casting will work if the target being's mind is protected by effects such as Mind Set, Non-detection, etc.

The caster selects up to 1 sapient being within sight per Aura used in the spell. Each targeted being is invited to join the interconnected whole. This is unlike the skill Mass-Mind or like effects where the being loses their self-identity and is compelled to stay in the group. With this effect beings are free to not join or leave at any time and even though they have the mental connections shown below they can leave the group and rejoin at will so long as the number of participants is not greater than the Aura points used in the original spell. Each member maintains their individual self-identity. Each being interconnected knows the health, distance and direction of every other being in the interconnection simply by concentrating on any one of them. Also, each being can concentrate make an Intelligence save and mentally contact another being who is interconnected. As well as hearing and projecting thoughts they can close a sense and take in the sense of another interconnected being, seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, feeling, etc. what the interconnected being does. In addition, any member of the interconnected circle can invite another being within sight into the circle up to the maximum of 1 total interconnected being per Aura used in the original spell. Interconnected beings can also block all connections for up to 1 minute per Will Force point. Each minute after this they must make a Will Force save and subtract -5% to the chance for each minute longer than their Will Force. Alternately, they can simply leave the interconnection and get another interconnected to reunite them at a later time. beings that are magically protected by Mind Change, Mind Set, or Non-detection cannot be interconnected. Other interconnected casters cannot recast this spell to add more members. However Combined mages casting together by the spell Combine may cast or recast spell such that the Aura is much higher. The spell can be recast by the original caster(s) to retain the interconnectedness without it being interrupted at any time during the duration.

Creates a glob of magical electrified acid that flies at an opponent. If the caster makes a successful Intelligence save. Targets are allowed two Magic Resistances to avoid the effects of this spell, the first for the acid, and the second for the electricity. If either roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. A roll is made for the acid first, and if the target takes damage from the acid, a roll is then made for the electrical. If the target takes damage from the acid and then also takes damage from the electrical, the acid damage will be doubled from the sensitive acid burned skin. The damages are 1d10+1 per 2 Aura for the acid and 1d8+1 per 2 Aura for the electrical. Magical items are allowed a single Magic Resistance to avoid both the effects of this spell.

Creates a bolt of pure Aura, emanating from the caster's finger. The Finger of Chaos strikes the body area desired if an Intelligence save is made. The Finger of Chaos does 1d12 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. Beings and objects which are immune to chaos are unaffected by this spell. The spell Endure Chaos is one such example. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor.

Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. system.description: Envelops the caster's Aura in withering force. In this form the caster is immune to effects of withering, magical aging or deterioration as the spell Endure Deterioration. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will be affected by type. PLANT(SMALL): instant death. PLANT(MED.): Wilt. PLANT(LARGE): lose foliage. PLANTS(INTELLIGENT): 1d4 END/3 AUR. ANIMAL(SMALL): instant death. ANIMAL(AVERAGE): 1d4 END/5 AUR. ANIMAL(INTELLIGENT): Age 1d6 years/5 AUR. ELF: Age 10-60 years/5 AUR. DWARF: Age 2d6 years/5 AUR. AVIAN: Age 1d10 years/5 AUR. MIDFOLK: Age 1d8 years/5 AUR. HUMAN: Age 1d6 years/5 AUR. GOBLIN/WILDONE: Age 1d4 years/5 AUR. STONE: -1 object strength/2 AUR. METAL: -1d4 object strength/5 AUR. WOOD: -1d6 object strength/5 AUR. LEATHER: -1d10 object strength/5 AUR. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of negative death energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb.
