Thus if 20 death energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 death damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the negative energy. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being. An undead or negative life force being cannot be the target of this spell as these are already unaffected by negative life energy.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of positive life energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 life energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 life damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the positive energy. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being. The usual targets for this spell are magical beings like Death Elementals and Undead.

Envelops the caster's Aura in negative life force. In this form the caster is immune to negative energy damage as the spell Endure Death. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d20 points of negative energy damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor. This spell can be cast on positive or negative life force beings.

Envelops the caster's Aura in positive life force. In this form the caster is immune to positive energy damage as the spell Endure Life. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d20 points of positive energy damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 3 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor. This spell can be cast on positive or negative life force beings.

Creates a buffeting miasma of chromatic pure Aura fire at a fixed height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects: 1) Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d12 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to all exposed areas. (All body areas protected by less than five points of armor are considered exposed). 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be blinded and deafened by the chaotic lights and roar. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Chaos always miss their target. 5) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Each scintillating, passable translucent wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The fire walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall must touch another or an existing surface. Touching the wall with exposed flesh does 1d12 per 2 Aura points to 2d4 random areas. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If the roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. The wall itself, while passable, will be impossible to remove for the entire spell duration, and can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic. If the wall cannot fit into the desired casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then that particular section of the wall will fail.

Allows externalizing of Aura Control focus for spell casting, boosting the ability to cast spells with some tradeoffs and generally requires rare or valuable focus items like staves, wands, rods, orbs, daggers, etc. Each requires a different Aura cost cast into them by type or value to produce better results. Because this focus is external it can stack fully with other Aura control modifiers that are on or from the caster bypassing the general +1 only stacking rule. This is one of the only Aura Control bonuses that has this feature. There is risk to casting this spell that needs to be weighed. The ability to shape aura pockets has now been externalized and during the duration of the spell, additional spells can only be achieved by holding the focus and using it to form, open, fill, and tie off the Aura pocket. Thus, loss of the focus item, means literally loss of the ability to cast spells altogether until the duration ends and the externalized focus returns to the caster or the item is recovered. These items are deeply personal and must be owned by the caster and not under any true ownership dispute by any other sentient being. Also, when the spell is cast, they are attuned only to the caster and/or to direct descendants. If an external focus is destroyed while this spell is active then an Aura save is required or no further casting is allowed that day. Even if the save is made focus does not return until the spell duration itself expires or the next day dawns, whichever comes first. If the Aura save fails then a psychic shock occurs and a Will Force save is required. Failure of this Will Force save results in the permanent loss of all spell casting ability permanently. While an external focus can increase the power of a spell caster it can also end their careers. Wish, Miracle, or Restore Mystical are the only ways to restore spell casting ability if it has been lost due to psychic shock. AURA 4, Focus Item: Rare wood staff/wand/rod, highly polished orb, jeweled dagger. Value: 100 gp., Aura Control: +1. AURA 8, Focus Item: +1/+2 wood staff/wand/rod/orb/dagger (with no powers). Value: 250 gp., Aura Control: +2. AURA 12, Focus Item: +3/+4 wood staff/wand/rod/orb/dagger (with no powers). Value: 500 gp., Aura Control: +3. AURA 16, Focus Item: +5/+6 wood staff/wand/rod/orb/dagger (with no powers). Value: 1000 gp., Aura Control: +4. AURA 20, Focus Item: +7 (or more) wood staff/wand/rod/orb/dagger (with no powers). Value: 2000 gp., Aura Control: +5. AURA 21, Focus Item: Any personal handheld item (with no powers). Value: N/A gp., Aura Control: +6. An external focus cannot be used to create another external focus or recast the spell on itself. The spell external focus must be cast by the caster with the normal internal focus they possess. Also, external focus only works with those who are using Scroll Knowledge, Shadowfrost Knowledge or Lightfire Knowledge. Magical ability from Wild Magic, Hermetic Lore, etc. cannot be externalized. Dispel magic cast by someone other than the creator of the focus on the focus ends the effect and returns casting focus back to the caster immediately. Also, the spell Intensify cannot be cast with an external focus. Spell failures that occur while casting spells with an external focus result in the following: MAGICAL MISHAP: 01-75% CASTING ABILITY LOSS(1 Day): 76-99%. PERMANENT CASTING LOST: 100%.

Creates an invisible string between two items, one the caster is holding and a distant object pointed to. It is visible to the caster as a thin silver line but invisible to all others. Alternately one item can be pointed at, and then a handle is created in the caster's hand connecting the tether between the two points. The item tethered is up to 10' long per Aura placed in the spell. When the held object (or handle) is manipulated then the far object is likewise affected. Turning the held object (or handle) turns the tethered object. Pulling it pulls the tethered object and pushing it does so as well as the tether remains perfectly stiff. The caster can also will the tether to shrink by thought, drawing the tethered object to them until the tether shrinks to 1“ per 10' of original size. The tether can also be reextended so as to move out to its maximum length of 10' Aura. The tethered object is considered to be under levitation from the moment tethered and cannot weigh more than 20 lb. per Aura used in the spell. Objects with an Aura field (being's, magic items, etc.) cannot be tethered by this spell. The tether is passable by all beings, and objects and only effects the objects that are tethered.

Creates a magical layer of flexible, padding-like armor on a being. The armor forms in any color desired and appears in the lowest, inner armor layer under other armor or clothing. If there is no space for the armor to appear because the 1st armor layer is filled then the spell simply fails. The armor produced is flexible, has 1 armor value per 3 Aura placed in the spell, and is +1 value per 5 Aura placed in the spell (+6 maximum). The armor cannot be damaged, only dispelled. This armor is weightless. Magic Underlayment acts as leather for armor effects like absorbing cold and electricity, etc.

Causes one target being to be affected by the Shadow Plane such that while in shadows in the earthly realm the target's visual appearance is moved to the Shadow Plane making the target effectively invisible. As long as the target remains in shadow then they stay invisible. When more than 50% of the target is outside of shadow visibility returns until the target is once again in shadow. The maximum target size is 5 cubic feet per Aura.

Creates a magical layer of semi-flexible, chain-like armor on a being. The armor forms in any color desired and appears in the middle armor layer. If there is no space for the armor to appear because the 2nd armor layer is filled then the spell simply fails. The armor produced is semi-flexible, and 1 armor value per 2 Aura placed in the spell, and is +1 value per 5 Aura placed in the spell (+6 maximum). The armor cannot be damaged, only dispelled. This armor is weightless. Magic Mail acts as chainmail for armor effects like absorbing cold and electricity, etc.

Creates a magical layer of rigid, plate-like armor on a being. The armor forms in any color desired and appears in the outer armor layer. If there is no space for the armor to appear because the 3rd armor layer is filled then the spell simply fails. The armor produced is rigid, and 1 armor value per Aura placed in the spell, and is +1 value per 5 Aura placed in the spell (+6 maximum). The armor cannot be damaged, only dispelled. This armor is weightless. Magic Plate acts as plate for armor effects like absorbing cold and electricity, etc.

Allows the caster to target one completely shadow shifted being or object and force a return to the earthly plane (assuming that it shadow shifted from the earthly plane). Individuals are allowed a Magic Resistance to avoid the effects of this spell.

Duplicates 1 existing item with a force duplicate. The duplicate is a perfect copy, except it is a transparent, force replica. Magical items can be copied by this spell. The constant abilities of the original magical item and the force duplicate can be on at once but powers, and usages can only be used by one or the other at the same time, unless the wielder of the duplicate is concentrating solely on the duplicate while activating it. Also, if the holder of the original item concentrates solely on the original item and activates it or does something with it, then the duplicate is activated or moves as the original does. Only one force duplicate can exist of any item.

Provides the caster complete mental control of one magical creature or being if it fails its Control Resistance. The victim obeys all suggestions, except those that are overly dangerous or would go against its alignment.  If the controlled victim is asked to submit to one of these suggestions, it will get a new Control Resistance. This spell will also work on any other creature as this is the highest form of control, if their Control Resistance fails. If a magical being or creature is already controlled, a contest of magics must be won to gain control of the victim. Being's immune to control are unaffected by this skill which is often the case with beings and creatures of type magical.

Grants the weapon special effectiveness against a named foe type doing extra damage and allowing for the chance of doubling damage. For each 5 Aura points put into the spell, the weapon will be +1 to hit and +1 to damage vs the foe type, and will grant an additional 1d6 to damage vs the foe type as well. In addition, the weapon has a chance of doing double damage vs the foe type if a natural 21 minus 1, per 5 Aura points of the spell is rolled. So, at 15 Aura, the weapon would be +3 to hit, do an additional 3d6+3 damage, and do double total damage on an unmodified roll of 18 or higher. One of the following type and subtype is selected at casting time. HUMANOID: subtypes; Mundane (all Human and Midfolk), Fae (all Elves, and Fairies), Goblinkin (all Goblins, Geebra, Ogres, and Trolls), Earthkin (all Dwarves, and Giants), Wildones 1 subtype (Furred, Scaled, or Insectoid). HUMANOID(MAGICAL): 1 subtype (Brok, Djinn, or Ifirit, etc.). SLIMES: all. ANIMALS: all. ANIMAL(MAGICAL): all. MAGICAL: 1 subtype (Dragons, Eye-Terrors, Golems, Mechanicals, or Wisps, etc.). PLANTS: all. PLANTS(MAGICAL): all. UNDEAD: all. SUPERNATURAL: 1 subtype by 1 plane of orgin (Air, Fire, Junk, Balance, Dream, etc.). Weapons that are already magical are subject to the magical cumulative effect rules except that bonus damage dice stack completely.

Summons a powerful being of will that will attempt to destroy the mind of one opponent with their own horrors. The caster releases the Mind Horror in the direction of the chosen victim and points at the target and the Horror appears in the victims mind. Mental combat ensues. The Mind Horror is given 5 Will Force +1 Will Force per point of Aura used in the spell. The Mind Horror can use any mental combat attack, with the ultimate purpose of causing the victim to go insane. Every time the victim loses Will Force half (rounded down) is drained into the Mind Horror, making it stronger. If the Mind Horror wins, the victim's mind is destroyed. If the victim wins the mental combat, the Mind Horror turns and mentally attacks the caster with its Will Force reset (to the starting value). If the target survives the mental combat, they must make a CR after, or suffer a permanent psychosis no matter what the final mental attack type was.

Causes a melee weapon striking the protected caster to be rebounded back at the attacker. When anyone attacks the caster with a melee weapon and would strike a body area (successful roll to hit), the weapon used rebounds back at the attacker. The attacker must make a half Strength save to hold on to the weapon. Either way the weapon then strikes the same body area on the attacker as was the original target on the rebound protected being with equal force and with no to hit roll required. Damage is rolled with all the damage modifiers that would have been used against the protected target with the damage applied to themselves. Rebounded weapons that are not held onto bury themselves in the being (if doing 10 or more actual Endurance damage) or fall to the ground in front of the attacker taking 1d4+1 seconds to recover. The maximum weight of the weapon that can be affected by rebound is 5 lb. per Aura points placed in the spell. Those over that weight limit are unaffected. If the attacker makes their Strength save to hold on to their weapon as it is rebounding, they may then spend 2 seconds using the Force skill to stop the rebound but they must make a successful Force skill roll to do so. If the both the original target, and the attacker are protected by rebound then use the special Reflection vs Reflection table to determine the outcome. If the protected being and the attacker have dissimilar bodies types then use the closest approximation while matching a vital to a vital or a limb to a limb. For example, if a rebound protected giant lizard was struck in the tail, and the attacker has no tail, then their leg would be struck. Natural weapons, claws, teeth, etc. Can still be rebounded if the attacker fails a Magic Resistance and the being attacking weighs under the 5 lb. per Aura point weapon limit as they count as the weapon. They cannot be rebounded unto themselves for obvious reasons; claws cannot hit the hand they come from nor the forearm, arm etc. of the same appendage. Common sense applies, so they will hit another random area on the body. A successful Force can still stop the rebounded natural attack and takes the additional 2 seconds whether successful or not.

The caster selects one magical effect, power or ability, or one divine magical effect, power or ability, magical by name on the being, object or area and nullifies it for the duration. If the spell is cast at a higher Aura than the effect or the Aura used in the spell was greater than 2 times the Title/Level of the being or creature who created the effect, power or ability then the nullification is automatic. Otherwise treat as Dispel Magic against the effect, power or ability and it becomes a contest between the Aura used in the spell and the effect where the amount of Aura put into the focus spell is compared to the amount of Aura put into Dispel Magic. Each amount is multiplied by 5%, and percentage dice are rolled for each. The roll which succeeds by the most wins. If the Nullify roll wins, the focus spell is dispelled, otherwise the Nullify fails. A tie result produces no effect. The modifier for permanent spells (-75%) does not apply with nullify as it is specifically designed to overcome this, albeit temporarily.

A lesser form of Enchantment. It behaves exactly as the Enchantment Spell with the following differences. 1) Enchantment casting time is halved. 2) Will Force costs are halved. 3) One ability/power/usage/effect of the enchanted item is gained per title or creature level of the item's user. The spell caster decides the order of ability/power/usage/effect gained by the item user at the time of Enchantment. 4) The item is considered at base 2 Aura per Title or creature level (for all abilities/powers/usages/effects) until it reaches the enchanted base Aura level and then it does not exceed that. 5) There is no failure chance for an under powered ability/power/usage/effect. If the effect produces nothing at a lower Aura, then nothing happens (it just fizzles out).

Causes one being to make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to hard, steel-like metal. All possessions (except magic items) carried by beings who are turned to metal are likewise turned to metal. Damaging the metal is difficult but will cause harm and even death if the areas destroyed are vital areas of the being's body. A Transmute to Flesh spell will reverse the process on a being. A Dispel Magic spell will reverse it on an object or being.

The caster takes one emblem, jewel or item embellishment, and enchants it similarly to the spell enchantment. Then this enchanted emblem can be applied to a normal item to give it the powers of the emblem, turning it into a magical item or applied to an existing magical item providing it the new powers or abilities of the enchanted emblem. The costs in time, money and Will Force are reduced by 1 level (not to go below the first level) on the costs table (see enchantment). A magical item can only have one enchanted emblem for each level of the item type. Artifacts cannot be enhanced with enchanted Emblems unless the emblems themselves are also artifacts. The number of emblems useable on an item is based on how magical (or not) the item is. NORMAL: 1 emblem. MAGICAL(MINOR): 2 emblems. MAGICAL(MAJOR): 3 emblems. MAGICAL(ARCH): 4 emblems. MAGICAL(ARTIFACT): 5 emblems*. *Only artifact emblems may be placed on an artifact. Enchant Emblem can be cast on a magical material emblem at no cost, but 6 hours enchantment time, if no powers are added just leaving it as powerless magical emblem at the specific magic + of the material. The Emblem material enchants an item it is placed on to the magic + of the emblem material if it is normal or if the emblem material + is greater than the magical item plus of the item before the emblem is applied. The same applies to base magical item aura level. Whichever is greater applies. If the magical item material plus ties or surpasses the magical emblem, then the overall + is unaffected. There is no magical stacking effect for items and emblems material + or base aura level.  If the emblem has a power that the item already has then the usage is added. So, if one is useable once per week and the other three times per day, then usage becomes 1 per week and 3 times per day. Meaning only when it used a 4th time in a single day is the once per week power utilized. If one is a power and one is a constant ability, then the constant ability overrides the power.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of pure divine energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 divine energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 divine damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the divine. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being.

Causes one being, object or area (one definable area of no more than 100 feet radius per Aura) to be affected as the spell Non-detection but not targetable by the spells Detect Protection, Avoid Protection, or Dispel Protection. This also effects other magical senses. If a being is invisible, they cannot be seen by Detect Invisibility, Divine Sight, or True Sight, etc. If they are inscrutable then their Aura cannot be read or revealed. This effects all magical senses except plain sight, if a being is visible. One of the few exceptions are Illusions. If a being is affected by illusions then Inscrutable will block the ability to simply see (or use other senses) through the illusion with effects like Detect Illusion, Divine Sight, or True Sight but the beings are still allowed a requested Illusion Resistance to avoid any illusionary ill  effects. The being, object, or area can only be observed with magical senses by a being with a perfect 30 Knowledge.

When cast up to one being per 5 Aura enters a special recursive time loop. Initially this creates an alternate reality and places the being(s), and a copy of everyone and everything in the area of effect into it with them. The alternate reality also starts at a point backwards in time from the casting, selected by the caster so that they will relive events. It will then continue forward until a set escape condition has been met by the being(s), set by the caster. The duration is permanent until the set condition is met. 1 Will Force is spent permanently when this spell is cast. If the condition is not met when the beings reach the same time in the alternate reality as the time they were recursed from in the natural universe, then the Alternate reality resets back to the first time point and everything starts over for the being(s). Once the escape condition is met then the alternate reality collapses and all transported beings are returned to the exact moment and place the spell was first cast from in their normal universe with nothing changed but their experiences. In most recursions, no effects, items, damage or results from the alternate reality transfer over save the experiences they had (this does give them any experienced earned.). The escape condition must be achievable within the recursion window. The caster cannot create an impossible escape condition or the spell fails. Recursion spell specifics are affected by Aura, as follows. AURA(UNDER 25):	recursion starts up to 1 hour ago per Aura, 1 room or area up to 1000-foot radius. AURA(25-99): recursion starts up to 1 day ago per 5 Aura, Up to 1 mile per Aura. AURA(100-999): recursion starts up to 1 year ago per 50 Aura, 1 plane (all of the natural universe, the elemental plane they are traveling on, etc.). AURA(1000+): recursion starts up to to the being's lifetime, All of the multiverse they came from. Exit condition examples: CHANGE OUTCOME: Stop things that occurred in reality from occurring, or make things occur that didn't, or make specific things happen in a way they didn't in reality. MATCH OUTCOME: When the real being(s) repeat the actions they took in reality (as close as they can). LEARN A LESSON:	Set something thing the being(s) should learn from the recursion. When they understand this, they are released. LETTING GO:	When all participating real beings are willing to let the recursion go. DISCOVER THE REAL:	Only applies if more than 1 real being is within the recursion. Gather them all before the recursion restarts and have all accept that they are trapped in the alternate reality and be willing to escape. WE'RE ALL GOING TO DIE: Everyone has to die before the recursion resets. STOP THE MADNESS: Find the alternate reality copy of the spell caster who casts the Recursion spell and stop her from casting it in the alternate reality. In the alternate reality when the caster casts the spell it just resets this alternate reality back to the starting point. When the caster is stopped from casting the recursion ends. FIND THE THINGY: Find special object(s) or token(s) within the alternate reality and carry it(them) to the point in time the recursion would normally reset to escape. See special usage. BRING THE THINGY: Find special object(s) or token(s) within the alternate reality and carry it(them) to a special designated place to escape. See special usage. FIND THE CASTER: Find the real caster within the alternate reality and convince them to release you (and themselves.) See special usage. There are several special additions to the spell that change how it works. Powerful deities (or the creator) in reality can nullify any or all of these spell effects (GM Discretion). ADD ITEMS: The caster can decide that there are special real item(s) or token(s) that they want to place in the alternate reality. The item(s) or token(s) must be on the caster when she casts the spell and then these items are also sent into the alternate reality in places imagined by the caster. When the recursion effected being's escape, they return with any of these items they have gathered in their possession. If some of the items are not carried by real beings then when the spell ends, each item returns to the feet of the caster. The items are not required to be part of the escape condition, but their existence allows them to be so.  ADD ME: The caster can also cast themselves into the alternate reality as one of the beings. In these alternate realities they can always scry and eavesdrop on all other real beings they have recursed through any reflective surface and this cannot be blocked by any means even Inscrutable. Each of the real beings has telepathy with the caster which cannot be blocked. Though she decides if this is one-way by listening to what they think, or she decides to speak back to them. At the point just before resetting, the real caster finds themselves teleported to the point they were at when they cast the Recursion spell and they must recast (without the Will Force cost) each time to keep it going. They cannot add anything or change anything about the recursion in this “casting”. ADD A REAL CHANGE: The escape condition is set to be a specific change. The caster spends an additional, 2 full Will Force permanently (3 total.) When the escape condition change is met, then the real beings return and the change they made to escape, has also occurred in reality. All the other things they did differently in the alternate reality, that didn't bear on the changed escape condition, do not occur in reality. For these changes only their memories remain. In this version of the spell the caster cannot add themselves as part of the casting, nor can they indicate to the effected being in anyway what the escape condition is or anything about the change that can be made. Attempting to do so cause the spell to fail as it is attempted to be cast and the caster to wink out of existence.  STAY FOREVER: The caster can spend 19 additional Will Force (20 total) to trap all the real beings in the recursion forever. There is no escape condition defined in this casting. All of the target beings wink out of existence in reality at the point of the casting and are trapped forever in the alternate reality recursion and can only be found from reality by opening a special planar portal or gateway to the alternate reality by someone who knows them truly (their deity, knowing their truename, having a special bonding, or a family relationship, etc.).

When cast on a being, object, or area (one definable area of no more than 100-foot radius per Aura) to be unaffected by shifts in time or allow for beings and effects from other times to have any impact on it. Any paradoxes this cause resolve in favor of the protected being and against the source of the time shift. This means the being themselves cannot use time shifting effects.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of pure obliteration energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 obliteration energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 obliteration damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the obliteration energy. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being. If the target of damage from this spell takes enough damage to die, they are removed from reality as if they never existed, and may create paradoxes or other destabilizing effects depending on setting.

Creates a bolt of pure destructive energy, emanating from the caster's finger. The Finger of Obliteration strikes the body area desired if an Intelligence save is made. The Finger of Obliteration does 1d100 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. Beings and objects which are immune to chaos are unaffected by this spell. The spell Endure Obliteration is one such example. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor. If the target of damage from this spell takes enough damage to die (or be destroyed), they are removed from reality, as if they never existed, and may create paradoxes or other destabilizing effects depending on setting.

By means of this spell the caster creates a pocket dimension, attached to the current one. The doorway is described and can be anything from a physical doorway or an object that is in the current plane. The dimension is considered a separate plane but it has all the physical and metaphysical rules of the plane it is attached to. The size of the space can be no larger than a 1-mile radius per Aura used in the spell. The doorway/portal has to have a specific way to be opened and closed and this can be keyed to the caster. If 2 full Will Force are spent the pocket dimension can be made permanent. This form must have a door/portal not keyed directly to the caster but some defined way of opening. The space is shaped as the caster sees fit and may contain any normal, non-valuable objects and places the caster can devise within the week casting window. If the caster does not have the appropriate skill or drawings, maps or architectural plans from someone who does have the necessary skills, then whatever is produced within it will appear misshapen, wrong, etc. Nothing made in the pocket dimension can leave it. Though objects and beings that enter it can go in and out as long as the door/portal is open. The door/portal detects as both magical and supernatural. It can only be identified as some kind of supernatural key. The dimension spell can increase the size by double, but it also doubles the casting time to two weeks.

Allows the affected being to absorb up to 2 points of literally any energy damage per Aura point used in the spell. Half of the absorbed energy is stored and half dissipates immediately. Damage over the energy limits is not absorbed and is taken as damage of that energy type. Attacks with that energy type against the protected object/being thereafter will only absorb the difference between the amount of energy stored and the amount it can absorb. The energy stored can be used and expelled outward in the next attack by hand or weapon that strikes an opponent or object. The damage done is equal to the damage stored. Thus if 20 any energy is absorbed and 10 held, then 10 energy of that type damage will be done in the next attack. The being or object struck is afforded a Magic Resistance to avoid the extra damage caused by the energy type. The amount of energy to use in each attack is from 0 to the amount stored. The amount used is under the control of the being effected by the spell. When the spell ends the stored energy is dissipated and radiates harmlessly from the affected being. If the target of obliteration damage from this spell takes enough damage to die (or be destroyed), they are removed from reality, as if they never existed, and may create paradoxes or other destabilizing effects depending on setting.

Protects the being from the massive destructive power of obliteration. Finger of Obliteration is one spell which produces this effect. Endure Obliteration protects completely against all damage and destructive effects of this spell and others that create that effect.

For every action, there is a reaction. For every cause, there is an effect. Obliterate rends reality to remove a cause. Establish shoves itself into reality to add a cause. No matter what, there will be unintended consequences. It is unavoidable. This spell cannot target anything. It cannot choose a cause to alter, nor an effect to change the outcome of. It can only bring something into existence, and choose its path, up to this moment. The more Aura you put in, the more you can override stubborn reality's whims, and control the history of the thing you create. This spell however is more prone to unintended consequences than obliterate. You must make a half Knowledge roll to make it work as intended, and a Wisdom roll to avoid making large mistakes with dire consequences. If Wisdom roll fails, only a successful Fortune roll can save the spell from dire consequences (GM discretion). This leads to many hard choices. If the caster wishes to save an ally, they might have to condemn another, or create one to condemn. If the caster were to create an enemy to take an arrow for them, its time outside the caster's control could be disastrous. Cleverness is essential to having much impact. If you do it right, you can seem to have impossible luck, and it'll be like it always happened. At under 5 Aura, the caster can only choose the history for its past minute. Every 5 Aura after that ups a time unit: 10 Aura is a day, 15 Aura is a week, 20 Aura is a month, 25 Aura is a year, and 30 Aura is 100 years (or the lifetime of a being if more). Will Force must also be spent based on the time unit. 1/10th of a Will Force for 1 minute Establish, 1/5th of a Will Force for 1 hour Establish, 1/2 of a Will Force for 1 day Establish, 1 Will Force for 1 week establish, 2 Will Force for 1 month establish, 3 Will Force for 1 year establish, and 4 Will Force for 100 year (or lifetime) Establish spells. The more the caster tries to do unreasonable things, the more likely they are to have unintended consequences. If they, for example, created a secret codeword. Something they never planned on telling anyone, in order to be able to know when they had used Establish. That would require them to have personally interacted with the established thing or being. The spell truly just makes an effect through creating a cause. The additional Aura and Will Force to improve the controlled time is simply to fine tune it and to avoid as many paradoxical consequences as possible.

This spell requires a container before the casting of this spell. The container can be a reflective surface, bottle, box or even a flawless gem. Once this spell is cast, each victim who touches it or gazes on it closely (within 10 feet) must make a Magic Resistance or suffer the effects of Obliteration with one difference; The being is entirely stored in the object, (body, mind, spirit, and soul) unbeknownst to the multiverse, even the caster. When this spell is cast it takes 2 Will Force from the caster permanently. Even the spell Mind Set or Mind Change (or like effects) will not make the victim immune. If the object is destroyed or dispelled the fate of the being inside will be restored as well as their full self (body, mind, being, and soul). If there is a being inside the item and the spell is cast and another being goes inside the first being is truly obliterated, forever and replaced by the new being. A victim inside the fate container is considered inscrutable to the Multiverse (see the spell Inscrutable). Only a being with a 30 wisdom (All Seeing) will know the victim exists within the item. While fate trapped, a being is inert, they do not have awareness of any kind, nor do they age as they have no real existence save for a trace magical concept trapped in the fate container.

Envelops the caster's Aura in pure destructive force. In this form the caster is immune to obliteration energy as the spell Endure Obliteration. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will take 1d100 points of damage per 2 Aura. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 2 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. If the target of damage from this spell take enough damage to die (or be destroyed), they are removed from reality, as if they never existed, and may create paradoxes or other destabilizing effects depending on setting. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

Creates a buffeting miasma of pure destructive force at a fixed height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects: 1) Make a Magic Resistance or take 1d100 damage per 4 Aura points per 10 seconds to all exposed areas. (All body areas protected by less than five points of armor are considered exposed). 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be blinded and deafened by the chaotic effects. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of Obliteration always miss their target. 5) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance. If the targets of damage from this spell take enough damage to die (or be destroyed), they are removed from reality, as if they never existed, and may create paradoxes or other destabilizing effects depending on setting.

Each shimmering, passable, void wall created by this spell is 10' high, 10' long, and 6“ thick. The void walls may be produced anywhere there is room for them, but each wall must touch another or an existing surface. Touching the wall with exposed flesh does 1d100 per 2 Aura points to 2d4 random areas. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If the roll is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than 1/2 the chance, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. The wall itself, while passable, will be impossible to remove for the entire spell duration, and can only be destroyed by a Dispel Magic. If the wall cannot fit into the desired casting area, or if there is a living being in this area, then that particular section of the wall will fail. If the targets of damage from this spell take enough damage to die (or be destroyed), they are removed from reality, as if they never existed, and may create paradoxes or other destabilizing effects depending on setting.

Envelops the caster's Aura to be charged with all magical energies. In this form the caster is immune to all energy types as the spell Endure All. Anything entering the caster's Aura while this spell is in effect will be affected by two different energy types and be affected accordingly: Roll a d10 twice: 1=Dissonance(Sonic, Xd3), 2=Cold(Frost, Xd4), 3=Heat(Fire, Xd6), 4=Repulsion(Kinetic, Xd4+X), 5=Electricity(Xd8), 6=Deterioration(Withering/Aging), 7=Acid(Xd10), 8=Chaos(Aura, Xd12), 9-Life/Death(positive/negative, Xd20)*, 10=Obliteration(Removal, Xd100). *Living casters emit Life, undead/negative emit Death. This spell also grants Force Armor at 1 point per 2 Aura. This spell applies force in only one direction away from the caster, allowing energy and matter to pass outward through the field without penalty. This spell cannot be used with the spell Force Armor.

The power of all magical energies at once. This finger spell emits a spinning bolt that moves between all states of energies as it flies towards it target. If an Intelligence save is successful, the Finger of All strikes the victim with two types of energy at once. These are determined by rolling a d10 twice: 1=Dissonance(Sonic, Xd3), 2=Cold(Frost, Xd4), 3=Heat(Fire, Xd6), 4=Repulsion(Kinetic, Xd4+X), 5=Electricity(Xd8), 6=Deterioration(Withering/Aging), 7=Acid(Xd10), 8=Chaos(Aura, Xd12), 9-Life/Death(positive/negative, Xd20)*, 10=Obliteration(Removal, Xd100). *Living casters emit Life, undead/negative emit Death. The Finger of Obliteration does 1d100 damage per 2 Aura used in the spell. Each energy tyupe is resisted individually. The being affected is allowed a Magic Resistance. If resistance is made by less than or equal to 1/2 the chance, no damage is taken. If the resistance was made, but was greater than a 1/2 save, then half damage is taken. Failure indicates full damage. Magical armor will absorb the damage if a Magic Resistance is made for the armor.

Creates a powerful storm powered all magical energies together at a fixed height of 10' and a radius of 2' per Aura. The storm causes all who are caught within its radius to suffer the following effects: 1) Make a 2 Magic Resistances (1 for each energy type) or take damage and be affected by that type of energy. Energy types are determined by rolling a d10 twice:  1=Dissonance(Sonic, Xd3), 2=Cold(Frost, Xd4), 3=Heat(Fire, Xd6), 4=Repulsion(Kinetic, Xd4+X), 5=Electricity(Xd8), 6=Deterioration(Withering/Aging), 7=Acid(Xd10), 8=Chaos(Aura, Xd12), 9-Life/Death(positive/negative, Xd20)*, 10=Obliteration(Removal, Xd100). *Living casters emit Life, undead/negative emit Death. 2) Make a Magic Resistance or be blinded and deafened by the chaotic effects. 3) Make an Agility save every 10 seconds. A failure indicates the being has lost footing and has fallen to the ground. 4) Make a Strength save to combat normally. An unsuccessful save results in a penalty of -4 to hit and half damage to attacks. and -20% to all combat skills. 5) Missile weapons fired within a Storm of All always miss their target. 5) Missile weapons fired into the storm have an equal chance of striking any being within the area of effect. The caster must concentrate on this spell to keep it maintained, and the caster may move this storm at walking speed (but no further than 3' per Aura point away from themselves). Effects 1 and 2 are dependent on only one Magic Resistance.

Has a slow and subtle impact on all intelligent beings in the area of effect. A single idea or action request is radiated outwards. That idea must be simple in concept, like be as peaceful as you can, or gather at some point, or accept Gregor Pendergast as the rightful king. Everyone in the area of effect is then afforded a Control Resistance or if they are not normally inclined to agree or take the persuaded action or belief, etc. The saves are easy to make at first as they begin at +20% for the first casting and are reduced by 5% after each casting at the same location. Thus, each recasting of the spell lowers the chance of making the save and increasing the likelihood that the intelligent beings will be persuaded. Although any being with 21 Will Force is unaffected. Because any number of beings can be affected 1 Will Force must be spent for each casting. At 1000 Aura this spell works on all people who identify themselves as being of one country, kingdom, empire, people, etc. on that plane of existence, If 5 Will force is also expended the effect is permanent. The spell's power can be used for evil or good but it can have dangerous and disastrous unforeseen consequences either way. If an empire wanted to keep his people from rebellion and urged them not to resist authority, over time this would likely work but then make them ripe for invasion from foreign lands and the empire's defenders would probably dwindle as they would only be made up of those that had resisted the mass persuasion. People cannot be made to knowingly harm themselves with this spell.

Creates a pocket universe, attached to the current one. The doorway is described and can be anything from a physical doorway or an object that is in the current plane with a defined way of opening and closing. The new pocket universe is considered a completely separate universe with its own physical and metaphysical rules. The size of the space can be no larger than a 10-mile radius per Aura used in the spell. If 5 full Will Force are spent the pocket universe can be made permanent. The space is shaped as the caster sees fit and may contain any objects and places the caster can devise within the month casting window. If the caster does not have the appropriate skill or drawings, maps or architectural plans from someone who does have the necessary skills, then whatever is produced within it will appear misshapen, wrong, etc. Things made in the pocket universe can leave it but they will be considered supernatural here and banishiable back to the pocket universe. The caster can also decide that the universe created is an alternate reality of the existing one with one or more changes but this requires an additional 15 Will Force (20 total). The door/portal detects as both magical and supernatural. It can only be identified as some kind of supernatural key. The dimension spell can increase the size by double but also doubles the casting time to two months. The pocket universe starts with the same physical and metaphysical laws as the caster's universe unless the being creating it has the physics Social Skill, in which case they can alter the physical laws, or has the metaphysics Social Skill in which case they can alter metaphysical laws. In both cases a skill roll success is required. A being with 30 Knowledge needs no skills to alter the pocket universe during casting and also makes perfect objects and structures without any necessary skills.

The target focuses on the containing object eight or more hours a day for a year and a day at the end of this time the object in question becomes a Soul Jar. What happened next depends on the caster. Casting this spell is considered an evil act in and of itself. SOULED CASTER: If the caster was a normal being before this (mortal or immortal) then caster's soul is stripped away and becomes the first soul in the jar. Also, the caster becomes a demon albeit one with no additional powers other than the ones coming from the soul jar (see below). NON-SOULED CASTER: If the being had no soul (demonic, etc.) then the jar is created but is empty and requires a sacrifice (death) of a souled being to complete at the end of a year and a day. That soul becomes the first soul within the jar. The mind and spirit of this first sacrificed being does not enter the jar and is freed to move on. ALL SOUL JAR ABILITIES: 1) The caster is now considered immortal and needs neither food nor water to continue existing. Nor does the caster age from the moment the jar is created. 2) The caster is immune to control and fear. 3) If the caster is killed then he is reborn from the container as the spell rebirth with no penalties or loss of Will Force. 4) Each soul jar is considered an artifact and thus is indestructible and undetectable by any method while the caster is alive. If the caster is killed for any reason, then soul jar becomes temporarily vulnerable (while the caster is being reborn) and can be destroyed as a normal object of whatever type the container is. If the jar is destroyed during this period, then all the souls are released along with any remnants of spirit and minds attached that have not yet been used up. The intact souls (with at least some spirit and mind) become New Ghosts. The Souls that have lost their spirits, minds or both become lost souls. The caster is also destroyed utterly and is never reborn. If the caster was once a souled being (before creating the jar) then their soul is lost (Plane of Time, or somewhere else depending on the setting). The caster cannot be resurrected even by wish or miracle unless their soul is recovered from the Plane of Time or wherever lost souls go in the current setting. 5) The caster gains a power called Sunder Soul while within 100' of the soul jar. This power takes an hour to perform and strips the soul, spirit and mind away from the being it is performed on if that target fails both a Control Resistance and a Magic Resistance, leaving a lifeless husk. However, if either resistance is made then the target is immune to a further use of this power for 1 week. Immortal beings cannot be the target of Sunder Soul. 6) The caster gains a Will Reservoir that starts at 1 and grows for each additional soul sundered and placed into the jar.7) Each mind placed in the jar (with a soul) can be drained of 1 permanent attribute point from its Intelligence, Wisdom, or Knowledge to fuel healing of 5 points to any damage taken. This process can be done once per 10 seconds and any number of points to can be drained from minds stored in the jar. The minds do not get a save or resistance to avoid this effect. If any of the mind's attributes reached 0 it is then considered destroyed, lost to the soul and cannot be drained further. 8) Each Spirit placed in the jar (with a soul) can be drained of 1 permanent attribute point from its Appearance, Charm, or Social Class to fuel spell casting ability adding a temporary +1 to Aura Control and +1 to available Aura for every point spent. This process can be done once per 10 seconds and any number of points to can be drained from spirits stored in the jar. The spirits do not get a save or resistance to avoid this effect. If any of the spirit's attributes reached 0 it is then considered destroyed, lost to the soul and cannot be drained further. 9) A soul (and any mind/spirit remnant) can be released from the jar (except for the initial one) and doing so causes the jar to lose 1 point of its Will Reservoir. If the mind or spirit has been destroyed then the soul may be confused and become lost, otherwise it becomes a New Ghost. 10) Will Force (in any amount up to the maximum available) can drained from the souls and placed in the Will Reservoir for use as needed in effects like the creation of magic items, permanent spells or bindings, etc. However, if all the Will Force from a soul is drained it is released. This draining for use in items is permanent until the item is destroyed or the effect removed or dispelled. In such cases the lost Will Force returns to the soul in the jar and can be reused. 11) The caster of the jar can always sense where the jar is even across planar boundaries. 12) The caster can teleport, no error to the soul jar even across planar boundaries after concentrating for 5 seconds. 13) The caster can summon the jar to him after 1 minute of concentration even across planar boundaries. 14) The soul jar cannot be dispelled nor is it affected by anti-magic fields or areas. Those who have the rare ability Null Magic are unaffected by this jar and cannot be sundered.

Causes the aging effects of time to accelerate in a 10-mile radius per Aura used in the spell. This includes 1' below the ground per Aura, and 10' above the ground per Aura used. All beings, objects, and even natural features must make a Magic Resistance once per hour in the area of effect or age a year. Those beings, items or things which have no Magic Resistance simple age at rate of 1 year per hour for the duration of the spell. Movement through the land is unaffected except for the collapse of structures and natural features. Both Spiritual Sphere and Sphere of Protection will protect from this effect. Long duration spells (those over an hour) are effectively dispelled once per hour in the area affected. Invocations, constant effects and magical items are not affected. This effect can be made permanent with the spell permanency at the cost of 3 Will Force.

Causes aging time to slow in a 10-mile radius per Aura used in the spell, This includes 1' below the ground per Aura and 10' above the ground per Aura used. All beings, objects, and even natural features will age at a rate of 2 hours per day for the duration of the spell. Movement through the land is unaffected. Both Spiritual Sphere and Sphere of Protection will protect from this effect. Long duration spells (those over an hour) are increased twelvefold within the area of effect. Invocations, constant effects and magical items are not affected. This effect can be made permanent with the spell permanency at the cost of 3 Will Force.

system.description: THIS IS NOT FOR YOU! MEDDLING WITH THE LAWS OF NATURE AND MAGIC ARE NOT FOR YOU. STOP NOW BEFORE YOU ERASE YOUR WHOLE EXISTANCE. Creates a single change in the multiverse. Takes half of the caster’s current Will Force which must be at least 10 or the caster is instantly Obliterated with no changes made. If the caster wants to change one physical law, they must also make a successful Physics Social Skill roll. Failure results in Obliteration. If the caster wants to change one metaphysical law, they must also make a successful Metaphysics Social Skill roll. Failure results in Obliteration. Each change takes 1 day of the casting time and does not occur until the end of it. Each change can be for a single plane, set of planes, or across all planes in the multiverse as desired. If the effect is going to cross Planar boundaries, then a Planar Lore Skill roll is required. Failure results in Obliteration. At the end of the casting time, if the caster has not been Obliterated then they spend their Will Force and some great change occurs. The Caster must also be an immortal being or they are instantly disintegrated, no resistance. If the caster gets obliterated no change occurs. This is because the multi-universe protects itself against changes which would destroy it or harm it. The GM could also determine the change is to great and then obliterate the caster anyway. The caster must make a Will Force save at the end of this casting. If they fail then having half their spiritual energy used in one go has caused them to have an instant spiritual death. The spirit dies. The mind is gone and the Soul goes to whatever destination it is destined for, immediately, irrevocable and without further resistance or save.
